title: Data Analyst III, Provider Incentives
description:
Position Purpose: Responsible for analytic data needs of the business unit, with a focus on provider incentive program performance, forecasting, reporting, and payment analytics. Handles complex data projects and acts as a lead for other Data Analysts.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

SQL experience, including complex queries, joins, data transformation, and working with large datasets, highly preferred.

Healthcare analytics experience, including claims, provider, member, clinical, quality, or financial data, highly preferred.

Experience with forecasting, financial analysis, performance analysis, and data validation/reconciliation highly preferred.

R experience, including statistical analysis, data manipulation, automation, reporting, or Shiny app development, highly preferred.

Snowflake experience, including querying and analyzing large datasets, highly preferred.

Health plan or managed care experience, including Medicaid and/or Medicare, provider quality performance, or provider incentive programs, highly preferred.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into analytical solutions, preferred.


  • Interpret and analyze data from multiple sources including claims, provider, member, and encounters data. Identify and assess the business impact of trends.
  • Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot complex scripts and reports developed using SQL, Microsoft Excel, or other analytics tools.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of large-scale projects with limited direction from leadership.
  • Assist in the design, testing, and implementation of process enhancements and identify opportunities for automation.
  • Identify and perform root-cause analysis of data irregularities and present findings and proposed solutions to leadership and/or customers.
  • Manage multiple, variable tasks and data review processes with limited supervision within targeted timelines and thrive in a demanding, quickly changing environment.
  • Demonstrate a sense of ownership over projects and ask probing questions to understand the business value of tasks.
  • Apply expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how customers interact with analytic products.
  • Partner cross-functionally at all levels of the organization and effectively, both verbally and visually, communicate findings and insights to non-technical business partners.
  • Independently engage with customers and business partners to gather requirements and validate results.
  • Communicate and present data-driven insights and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders, soliciting and incorporating feedback when required.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior analysts.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, public health, health informatics, healthcare administration, finance or related field or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience working with large databases, data verification, and data management or 2+ years of IT experience.
  • Healthcare analytics experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SQL/querying languages.
  • Preferred knowledge of programmatic coding languages such as Python and R.
  • Knowledge of statistical, analytical, or data mining techniques including basic data modeling, trend analysis, and root-cause analysis preferred.
  • Preferred knowledge of modern business intelligence and visualization tools including Microsoft PowerBI.

By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and understand that you may be considered for other job opportunities for which Centene believes you may be qualified

Pay Range: $70,100.00 - $126,200.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Manufacturing Technologist Engineering
description:

Our company develops, manufactures and markets innovative programmable power supplies for the global industry. The company employs about 300 employees including R&D team, of 60 people, which has special dynamic and innovative atmosphere that encourage change, challenges and self-developing.


What is unique about us?

•In the last decade the company has doubled its activity due to continues development of new high end products utilizing advance power and digital technologies developed by its R&D, and the plans are to continue the sharp growth in the coming years.

•We emphasize our Japanese roots by preserving and strengthening our long-term relationship with our employees by providing attractive employment packages and creating job security and a future horizon.

•We also encourage our employees to develop their education and professional knowledge by funding them university studies, training programs, TDK prestigious management programs around the world and more.

The following position offers you an opportunity to join a team that not only develops tomorrow's products but also has the possibility to be involved in a complete product development and to see the manufacturing of these products.

Working with us will allow you to always see and think about the future!


Central activities, responsibilities, goals and tasks within the framework of the Position

Lead NPI activities for production aspects (process definition, stencil, automations programming, penalization, design review, temp profile, etc.)

Production improvements - initiate process changes for efficiency & quality improvement of various products

Technological Innovations - Suggestions for integrating mechanization/ technological innovations that will improve product quality/operational efficiency

New automation - Defining organization's needs, lead market research for applicable options, write SOW requirements, option selection, Process validation& implementation including procedures, work instructions & operator training

PLM life cycle management - implementation and approvals of engineering change orders by providing Guidelines, instructions, process effects/ technological influences

Investigation of process failures


Job requirements (education, professional experience, languages, professional training)

  • Software knowledge - AutoCAD, FAB3000, SolidWorks, Kic/ Mole, PLM, Priority.
  • Knowledge with IPC standards, cabling standards, PCBs manufacturing and design, materials data sheets, components limitations etc.
  • Experience with X-RAY (operation and decoding)
  • Experience with different technologies in the electronics industry (SPI, BGA Rebelling and Replacement, wire Bonding, Rework stations, press fit…etc.)


Required features, personality traits and skills

Flexibility - Multitasking and tasks prioritizing

High level of Hebrew & English – both reading and writing.

Dynamics Ability to lead processes and people , locally and remote - Good interpersonal skills

Creativity and innovation – out of the box thinker.

Analytical skills

Orderly and organized - Ability to organize data and draw conclusions from it


Additional Information

  • This position is open to both women and men.

title: Senior Analyst, Energy & Utilities
description:
WHO WE ARE:


Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, is the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences across Neiman Marcus, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Driven by a relentless devotion to our customers and powered by our talented colleagues, we offer expertly curated product assortments, unparalleled service and personalized experiences across our integrated retail model. Through strong partnerships with the world's most desired luxury brands and deep customer relationships enhanced by data-rich insights, Exemplar Luxury Group is committed to setting the standard of excellence for luxury retail.

Job Description:


Role Summary:-

The Senior Analyst, Energy & Utilities serves as the data expert of the ELG Energy & Operational

Stewardship team. Reporting to the AVP, Energy Mgmt & Operational Stewardship works directly with the

US-based energy and sustainability team and is responsible for the integrity of the organization’s utility

data, invoice auditing, and procurement analytics. The Senior Analyst is a hands-on data specialist who

executes the daily operations—from billing reconciliation to regulatory filings—ensuring the company’s

energy portfolio remains compliant, accurate, and cost-optimized.

Responsibilities:-

Utility Data Management & amp; Accounting

  • Develop robust plan for and execute the technical migration of hundreds of utility accounts from legacy providers to the new bill pay platform, including mapping account hierarchies, validating site metadata, and transferring historical payment records.
  • Execute monthly reporting from third-party bill pay providers to maintain the global portfolio’s actual cost and consumption trackers.
  • Input and reconcile cost, usage, and annual true-up data from landlord-billed utilities into central tracking systems.
  • Ensure consolidated invoices are accurately coded in financial systems, routed through Accounts Payable, and processed on schedule.
  • Conduct monthly variance analyses comparing actual expenditures against budget plans, proactively identifying and resolving anomalies.
  • Develop annual utilities forecasting documents, in partnership with Energy Managers, to ensure accurate financial planning and tracking for the fiscal year.

Utility Operations

  • Serve as the primary liaison with utility providers and third-party suppliers to resolve billing delays, meter errors, and statement discrepancies.
  • Assist the Manager in identifying, preparing, and submitting applications for Energy Conservation Measure (ECM) incentives and utility rebates.
  • Partner closely with Facilities, Store Ops, Real Estate, Legal and Finance to support benchmarking and compliance reporting.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Your Life and Career at Exemplar Luxury Group:-

  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation.
  • Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate.
  • Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees.

Exemplar Luxury Group is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Exemplar Luxury Group and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact candidatesupport@exemplarluxury.com.

title: Kierownik / Kierowniczka Działu
company: H&M Hennes & Mauritz sp. z o.o.
description:
Twój zakres obowiązków

Jako Kierownik/Kierowniczka Działu będziesz zarządzać, wspierać i motywować swój zespół. Tworząc inkluzywną kulturę opartą na współpracy i przedsiębiorczym podejściu, zapewnisz środowisko, w którym każdy może się rozwijać. Działając zgodnie z naszymi wartościami, przyczynisz się zarówno do własnego sukcesu, jak i sukcesu całej firmy.

Twoje zadania będą obejmować:

• Kierowanie zespołem i dbanie o to, by każdy klient czuł się wyjątkowo – poprzez utrzymywanie wysokiego poziomu obsługi i atrakcyjnego wyglądu sklepu.

• Odpowiedzialność za wyniki sklepu i Twojego działu – poprzez analizę wyników sprzedaży, szukanie nowych możliwości i wyznaczanie celów, które pomogą osiągnąć jeszcze lepsze rezultaty.

• Planowanie pracy zespołu – układanie grafików, organizacja dnia i dbanie o płynne funkcjonowanie sklepu.

• Rekrutację, szkolenia oraz rozwój pracowników – z troską o inkluzywne środowisko pracy, w którym każdy głos ma znaczenie.

• Budowanie pozytywnego wizerunku marki – w każdej interakcji z klientem.

• Aktywne promowanie programu lojalnościowego – tak, by zakupy były dla klientów nie tylko przyjemnością, ale też korzyścią.

Nasze wymagania

Szukamy osób z…

• Doświadczeniem w zarządzaniu sprzedażą detaliczną.

• Wiedzą w zakresie planowania, analizy i monitorowania wyników sprzedaży, przy użyciu odpowiednich narzędzi raportowania.

Oraz osób, które…

• Czują się pewnie w roli liderów. Potrafią inspirować, szkolić i rozwijać swoje zespoły w zgodzie z wartościami i kulturą firmy.

• Chcą rozwijać się w dynamicznych i zróżnicowanych zespołach, gdzie podstawę stanowi współpraca.

• Są zmotywowane, aby zapewnić klientom wspaniałe doświadczenia zakupowe poprzez promocję i sprzedaż naszych produktów.

• Są zainteresowane modą, sprzedażą oraz monitorowaniem działań konkurencji w celu zwiększania sprzedaży.

• Potrafią jasno się komunikować, myślą nieszablonowo i z entuzjazmem podchodzą do nowych wyzwań.

• Są elastyczne, analityczne i ambitne. Potrafią pracować ze statystykami oraz danymi.

• Posługują się językiem polskim na poziomie zaawansowanym, zarówno w mowie, jak i w piśmie.

To oferujemy

W Grupie H&M jesteśmy dumni z tego, że tworzymy otwarte i pełne energii miejsce pracy. Oferujemy naszym pracownikom atrakcyjne świadczenia oraz szerokie możliwości rozwoju na całym świecie.

Zapewniamy:

• Umowę o pracę.

• Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości 200 PLN.

• Możliwość otrzymania premii za wyniki sprzedażowe.

• 25% zniżki dla Ciebie i jednej bliskiej osoby na zakupy we wszystkich markach Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).

• Program motywacyjny H&M HIP.

• Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz).

• Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku.

• Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej.

• Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej.

• Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie.

• Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit.

• Dodatkowy dzień wolny (jubileuszowy).

• Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych.

Benefity

  • dofinansowanie zajęć sportowych
  • prywatna opieka medyczna
  • zniżki na firmowe produkty i usługi
  • brak dress code’u
  • kawa / herbata
  • karty przedpłacone
  • program rekomendacji pracowników
  • Platforma MyBenefit

Z kim będziesz współpracować

​Nasze sklepy stanowią fundament firmy — to właśnie w nich klienci bezpośrednio doświadczają naszej marki. Jako część dynamicznego zespołu sklepowego, każde stanowisko — od doradców/doradczyń sprzedaży, przez kierowników/kierowniczki działów i sklepów, po dekoratorów/dekoratorki i kontrolerów/-ki administracyjno-kasowych/-e — przyczynia się do tworzenia inspirującej i przyjaznej atmosfery. Współpracując z innymi sklepami oraz zespołem regionalnym, będziesz dzielić się spostrzeżeniami i osiągać wspólne sukcesy. Wraz z członkami swojego zespołu będziesz pełnić kluczową rolę, pomagając klientom czuć się pewnie i wyrażać swoją indywidualność dzięki najnowszym trendom i ponadczasowym fasonom. Budując relacje z klientami, sprawiamy, że moda staje się dostępna i zrównoważona dla każdego.

Dołącz do nas

Nasza wyjątkowość wynika z połączenia wielu czynników — inkluzywnej kultury opartej na współpracy, silnych wartościach i możliwościach rozwoju. Jednak to przede wszystkim nasi pracownicy tworzą tożsamość Grupy H&M.

Jest to stanowisko w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy. Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV tak szybko, jak to możliwe.

Zrób z nami kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Twoja podróż zaczyna się tutaj.

* Dążymy do tego, aby proces rekrutacji był uczciwy, sprawiedliwy i oparty na kompetencjach. W związku z tym prosimy o niezałączanie listu motywacyjnego do swojej aplikacji.

H&M Hennes & Mauritz sp. z o.o.

Grupa H&M to globalna firma, która łączy silne marki modowe. Naszym celem jest pokazanie, że wyjątkowy design, przystępne ceny i zrównoważone rozwiązania mogą iść w parze. Chcemy, by moda była dostępna dla jak najszerszej grupy osób, dlatego nasi klienci stoją w centrum każdej decyzji, którą podejmujemy.

Wspieramy rozwój tysięcy współpracowników pełnych pasji i talentów, których łączy wspólna kultura i wartości. Razem chcemy wykorzystać naszą siłę, zasoby i wiedzę, aby kształtować bardziej inkluzywną i zrównoważoną przyszłość branży modowej.

Tak się u nas pracuje

title: JB-108 New Product Introduction Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced NPI & Production Engineer to lead the transition of UAV products from development to full-scale production.

Introduce and continue supporting products in a professional, cost-effective and timely manner from concept through prototype, qualification, pre and full production stages, controlling configuration throughout and ensuring productivity targets for stable manufacturing are met. Supporting Quality, Commercial, Engineering, Projects and Operations teams with engineering excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) processes from prototype to serial production
  • Collaborate with R&D, Design, and System Engineering teams to ensure Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Serviceability
  • Develop and implement manufacturing processes, work instructions, and production documentation
  • Support tooling design, test equipment, and production line setup
  • Drive process validation and first article inspections (FAI)
  • Identify and resolve production issues, root cause analysis, and corrective actions (CAPA)
  • Manage Engineering Change Orders (ECO) and ensure smooth implementation in production
  • Work closely with suppliers to ensure component quality and availability
  • Improve production efficiency through lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Support integration, testing, and troubleshooting of UAV systems (mechanical, electrical, and embedded systems)
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Practical Engineering degree in Mechanical or Electrical disciplines, or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in NPI and/or Production engineering, preferably in UAV, aerospace, or defence industries
  • Hands-on experience with UAV systems, drones, or aerospace assemblies
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Mechanical assemblies (composites, structures, precision parts)
  • Electrical systems (wiring, harnessing, PCB integration)
  • System integration and testing
  • Experience with PLM/ERP systems (e.g., Teamcenter, Priority, SAP)
  • Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks)
  • Proficiency in English (verbal and written)


Preferred Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience in UAV platforms, preference to VTOL and/or Fixed-Wing systems
  • Familiarity with flight testing, ground control systems, and payload integration
  • Knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ISO9001, AS9100)
  • Experience in military or commercial UAV programs
  • Experience with composite materials and lightweight structures
  • Background in electronics manufacturing or embedded systems
  • Experience working in high-mix, low-volume production environments


Key Skills and Personal Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, startup or scale-up environments
  • Hands-on, “can-do” attitude
  • Strong communication and documentation skills

title: Manager, Field Learning
description:
Who we are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

What We Need

As the Manager, Field Learning, you will lead learning for field employees and customers and manage trainers supporting foundational learning programs across the organization. As part of the Field Learning Center of Excellence (COE), this manager leads and delivers classroom, simulation, and other structured learning experiences that prepare learners before they progress to onsite application and coaching. This role is responsible for delivery of quality, instructor capability, learner readiness, and program localization across its assigned foundational learning portfolio.


As Symbotic expands, trainers hired to support foundational learning and other learning needs in new geographies; business verticals, acquisitions and expansion initiatives will report into this role. Working with the broader COE and local business leaders, you will implement Symbotic’s broader learning strategies, coordinates delivery, supports localization, and integrates new trainers supporting foundational learning programs into established learning programs, standards, and practices. This position reports to the Director, Field Learning, and partners closely with Learning Leadership, Technical Documentation, Engineering, HR, and Operations.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and facilitate classroom and simulation as part of approved learning programs that prepare employees and customers to understand, operate, and support Symbotic systems and technologies.
  • Coordinate schedules, instructor assignments, learning environments, and resources to support foundational learning programs.
  • Use learner assessments, feedback, and relevant operational performance signals to improve delivery and recommend content updates to the learning design team.
  • Lead train-the-trainer activities and evaluate instructor readiness for trainers supporting foundational learning programs.
  • Partner with Learning Program Design & Strategy and local teams to implement approved localization while maintaining program standards.
  • Coordinate foundational learning delivery for new markets, products, solutions, and business initiatives, partnering with Operations where onsite application, coaching, or field support is required.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Learning and Development, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in technical learning, training delivery, workforce development, or a related discipline within technical, operational, or industrial environments.
  • Minimum of 3 years of people management experience, including coaching and developing trainers or instructors.
  • Experience managing global training programs and bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating classroom and simulation-based learning for adult learners.
  • Ability to learn complex technical systems and translate technical information into clear, practical instruction for audiences with varying experience levels.
  • Experience managing learning delivery across locations, including instructor assignments, schedules, and resources.
  • Experience leading and auditing train-the-trainer programs, observing delivery, assessing instructor and learner readiness.
  • Strong project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate competing priorities and resolve delivery challenges.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with customers, operational leaders, technical experts, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience with LMS platforms, simulation tools, and digital learning technologies.
  • Remote opportunity

Our Environment:

  • Up to 50% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
  • Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.

title: Prime Vendor Analyst - 2293
description:
About Medline

Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.com.

Medline India

Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.

Job Summary

Under general supervision, analyze and present business related trends and results to identify opportunities for improvement/solutions in support of the customer and sales organization.<br>Work with internal and external customers to drive results tied to defined distribution metrics and reporting requirements.<br>Meet with sales and the customer to identify, prioritize, track and manage projects and KPI performance.

Job Description

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Create, maintain, and develop relationships with the customer, sales teams, and vendor community. Lead/participate in various meetings on behalf of customer (ex. value analysis committee).
  • Meet with vendors to discuss products, pricing and terms. Present findings to key contacts in the customer’s procurement team.
  • Measure the trends, efficiencies and effectiveness of the overall pricing and inventory KPIs.
  • Support sales team by managing contract terms, assisting with brand conversions, and tracking all savings and projects. Make presentations regarding project updates, business results, committee findings, etc.
  • Review pricing to determine and identify discrepancies. Ensure new pricing rules are reviewed and approved by respective sales teams.
  • Provide issue resolution in the following areas (not limited to): inventory surplus, backorders, outstanding invoices. Initiate and partner with the internal teams. Communicate resolution in a timely manner.
  • Host weekly meetings with supply chain, materials services, and Medline Sales teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, IS and Finance to develop, create and maintain reporting requirements and ensure systems provide accurate and timely data.

Education:

Certification / Licensure:

Work Experience:

  • None

  • Experience developing and delivering presentations to various audience levels within, and external to, an organization.
  • Experience analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
  • Experience establishing & maintaining relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization, in the business community & with vendors.
  • Intermediate level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using SUM function, setting borders, setting column width, inserting charts, using text wrap, sorting, setting headers and footers and/or print scaling).
  • Willingness to travel for business related needs (i.e. training, accounts meetings, development, etc).

Education:

Certification / Licensure:

  • None

Work Experience:

  • Previous analytics experience in the healthcare industry.
  • Previous inventory or supply chain analytics experience.
  • Experience providing training and developing process documentation/user manuals.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • None

Asiakkaastamme, kohteesta, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!

Jos koet, että osaamisesi täsmää tähän paikkaan, mutta mielessä on kysymyksiä, voit kysyä niistä suoraan Whatsappilla tai tavallisella tekstiviestillä. Numero on 050 542 1894.



---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Growth Architect
description:
Job Description:

As the Growth Architect, you lead the solution on Merkle’s most complex pursuits and connect our capabilities into one growth story a client can say yes to.


Why this role exists

Requests for solution leadership are rising, and deals now cut across more capabilities and business units than any single expert can carry. Growth Architects lead inbound RFPs and growth pitches for new and existing accounts, partnering with Enterprise Sales Leads (ESLs) and Client Partners (CPs). About 20% of your time is client-billed, sitting with named clients to drive longer-term growth.


How we work

This is a team sport. We win together, share credit and make the organization look good, inside Merkle and in front of clients. Lone wolves and heroes need not apply.


Reports to the Head of Growth Architecture, Enterprise Solutions and Alliances (ES&A).


Attunement: understand the problem first

  • Align with the client’s business problem before proposing anything
  • Run discovery and ideation workshops that turn stakeholder input into clear priorities
  • Read the buyer and the room, then choose the frame that fits: the CMO’s story is not the CFO’s story
  • See how Merkle can solve the problem across commerce, data, technology, experience and media

Brevity: say what is needed

  • Make the case on one page before you build the deck
  • Give clients and teams what they need to decide, and nothing that slows them down
  • Take the time to edit; short takes longer to write

Clarity: make the solution clear to everyone

  • Frame the current state, the future state and the path between them
  • Translate the solution into measurable outcomes the client’s executives can fund
  • Engage at the depth each pursuit needs: lead the solution, influence the story alongside another Solution Lead, or review and pressure-test the work
  • Shape scope and inform pricing with the sales lead, who owns the final call
  • Turn winning solutions into repeatable use cases other teams can deploy

You are a T-shaped marketer

You can go deep in digital business transformation and you carry working knowledge of marketing operations, campaign management, commerce, digital experiences and analytics. Around that core, you carry a set of tools you reach for as each pursuit demands:

  • Storytelling that goes beyond a single category solution
  • Facilitation of workshops with senior stakeholders internal and external
  • Networking across Merkle, dentsu and partner ecosystems
  • Public speaking and leadership presence
  • Marketing acumen grounded in outcomes, not outputs
  • A quick study of new industries, platforms and problems
  • AI fluency applied to pursuit craft (preferred)

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in consultative selling, solution architecture, strategy consulting or strategic sales
  • A record of leading complex, multi-capability pursuits from framing to win
  • An understanding of how marketing agencies and services businesses create value; consulting or platform backgrounds are welcome
  • Preferred: Adobe and Salesforce technology experience; a bachelor’s degree, with a Master’s a plus

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and

strengthen our teams. Many of our employees who live within commuting distance (90 minutes) from one of our Headquarter or Hub Offices (New York, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles) are required to work in the office 2-3 days per week including one Team Day. The minimum number of days may vary by office and role. Dentsu may designate other HQ or Hub offices at any time. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect you to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office from time to time.


The annual base salary range for this position is $163,000-$225,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.


Benefits available with this position include:

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,

• Life insurance,

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,

• 401k,

• Flexible paid time off,

• At least 15 paid holidays per year,

• Paid sick and safe leave, and

• Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. title: Reporting & Controlling Analyst with French
description:
Your responsibilities

  • Prepare, coordinate, and deliver controlling, financial reporting, and performance analysis reports for internal stakeholders.
  • Oversee report production in dedicated reporting tools, provide first-level analyses, and support more advanced analyses when required.

  • Drive data consistency across reporting tools by performing regular controls, identifying discrepancies, coordinating corrective actions with stakeholders, and ensuring alignment between financial systems.
  • Support proforma and scope transfer activities, including data collection and validation, stakeholder coordination, impact assessments, reporting preparation, and monthly reconciliations.

title: Ultrasound Technologist
description:
Job Description:

The Ultrasound Tech provides excellent customer service by performing ultrasound examinations under the direction of a physician for identification of abnormalities leading to patient diagnosis.

Posting Specifics

Shift Details: Full-time (40 Hours), Variable, 4 10's, call

Unit/Location: St. Mary’s Regional Hospital

Additional Details: Please review Minimum Qualifications listed below before applying.


Are you interested in advancing your career while helping people live the healthiest lives possible? As an Ultrasound Technologist at Intermountain Health, you will play a vital role in supporting our clinical team, ensuring our patients receive the best care. At Intermountain, you will be part of a team that values career advancement, innovation and collaboration, where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a lasting impact.


What does it mean to be a caregiver with Intermountain? Check out this video and learn more and discover the “Power of We.”


As an Ultrasound Technologist at Intermountain Health, you will play a vital role in supporting our clinical team, ensuring our patients receive the best care by:


Essential Functions

  • Maintains American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) and modality-specific competency in all clinical and technical functions.
  • Ensures proper patient identification, order verification, and prepares the patient for the exam.
  • Performs exams per department protocol and reviews images for quality, clarity, and accuracy.
  • Completes studies within acceptable time limits without compromising patient care or quality.
  • Assists and instructs students and other Sonographers in exam protocols, procedures, positioning, and equipment.
  • Provides appropriate patient education, ensures patient comfort, and addresses concerns.
  • Practices appropriate infection control and sterile techniques.
  • Understands and operates equipment and related information systems to ensure quality images.
  • Keeps accurate records of patient information, procedures performed, and any adverse reactions.
  • Follows protocols for medical necessity, coding, charging, consents, QC programs, and reporting equipment failures.

Skills

  • Following Protocols
  • Equipment operation
  • Patient Identification
  • Documentations
  • Customer Service
  • Management Reporting
  • Vascular
  • Cleaning
  • Imaging Techniques
  • Anatomical Knowledge
  • Prioritize Tasks
  • Effective communication
  • Independent work
  • Teamwork
  • Emergency response
  • Image evaluation
  • Equipment operation


Minimum Qualifications Ultrasound Tech I

  • Registered with the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) - Successful completion of one registry pertinent to the department beyond physics (options include OB, abdominal, neuro, breast, pediatric, and vascular)
  • Health Services\BCLS - Basic life support (Certification for Healthcare Providers)

Preferred Qualifications Ultrasound Tech I

  • 1 or more years of experience.

Minimum Qualifications Ultrasound Tech II

  • Must have completed a minimum of two additional years of experience relevant to the department post obtaining Ultrasound Tech I. (Primary Children’s one of the two years must be pediatric experience)
  • American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) Registry - Successful completion of one additional registry pertinent to the department beyond Ultrasound Technologist I or (SPI + 2 registries). Options include Obstetrics and Gynecology (OB/GYN), abdominal, neuro, breast, pediatric, Vascular, or Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS). (Primary Children’s one of the two registries must be pediatric)
  • Health Services\BCLS - Basic life support (Certification for Healthcare Providers)

Preferred Qualifications Ultrasound Tech II

  • Additional experience
  • Additional registries
  • Vascular experience

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.
  • Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately, particularly during emergency situations.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing for documenting patient care, accessing needed information, medication preparation, etc.
  • Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transfer patients. Will also bend to retrieve, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.
  • Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)
  • May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.

Location:

St. Marys Regional Hospital

Work City:

Grand Junction

Work State:

Colorado

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

The hourly range for this position is listed below. Actual hourly rate dependent upon experience.

$39.16 - $60.42

title: Senior Scheduler Planner, Growth
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity

The Project Scheduler-Planner supports project management through analysis and ownership of the project schedule / plan within our Growth capital portfolio. Programs within this portfolio range from $50 million USD to $1 billion USD total installed cost. Responsibilities include creating and maintaining the overall owner's schedule as well as managing a detailed construction schedule.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to create and maintain the integrated master schedule from pre-feed to project commercial in-service.
  • Update project schedules, provide a schedule summary report, and facilitate schedule review meetings.
  • Review, monitor, and assess the accuracy of all schedules, including checking for critical path accuracy, constraints, durations, logic sequencing, scope of work, etc.
  • Accountable for ensuring construction progress measurement process is followed by Prime Contractors, which may include building and maintaining manual excel-based progress measurement tools for projects.
  • Communicate to the Project Team the impacts to the schedule due to obstacles and/or changes in the work execution plan.
  • Identify and track external and internal scheduling issues and document lessons learned.
  • Participate in team meetings to capture changes to critical and near-critical path activities.
  • Provide support to the Project Manager by assessing and documenting delays and impacts; discuss what-if scenarios, offer alternate work plans, and provide recommendations.
  • Support the Project Manager by providing schedule, progress, and earned value reporting requirements used in the construction bid packages, bid evaluations, and administration of construction contracts and perform analysis and reporting of progress and EVM during the execution of the contracts.
  • Participate in qualitative and quantitative cost and schedule risk assessments.
  • Partner with the Project Manager to adjust work management based on financial implications, construction progress performance, compliance issues, and/or availability of resources.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement to procedures and processes.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in project scheduling, planning, project controls, or construction planning, preferably supporting large-scale capital projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and Project Management skills (analytical and organizational)
  • Demonstrated knowledge and ability to quickly assess and make sound decisions
  • Advanced Primavera P6 user
  • Basic proficiency in MS Project
  • Ability to gather and analyze data to make informed decisions; ability to accurately obtain, interpret, and transcribe a variety of communications and instructions; works with others to develop their ability to analyze schedule data and communicate that analysis to others
  • Able to recognize and evaluate risks, hazards, losses and prevent conflicts between activities

To remain competitive, support our high-performance culture and allow for more flexibility in the way we work, we offer a hybrid work model and flexible dress code for our eligible office-based workforce in Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. #LI-Hybrid


About our business


We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs. Every day, we move more than 30 per cent of the natural gas used across the continent and connect LNG exports to global markets, powering communities and industries. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure delivers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy across North America. Our field operations span seven Canadian provinces, 34 U.S. states and seven Mexican states. Together, we strengthen the connections that deliver the energy the world relies on-every day.


TC Energy is an equal opportunity employer and participates in the E-Verify program supervised by the US government. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, age, sex, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability. We are also committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Applicants requiring accommodations or accessible formats are encouraged to contact us at careers@tcenergy.com for support.


All applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based, without restrictions. Background screening is required for all positions, which may include criminal and/or credit checks. Offers may be extended at a different level or job title that best aligns with the successful candidate's qualifications.


Learn more


Visit us at TCEnergy.com and connect with us on our social media channels for our latest news, employee stories, community activities, and other updates.


Thank you for considering TC Energy in your career journey.

title: Coordinator of Sport Clubs & Youth Programing
description:
Job Title

Coordinator of Sport Clubs & Youth Programing

Agency

Tarleton State University

Department

Campus Recreation

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

Stephenville, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Tarleton State University, a distinguished Doctoral National Comprehensive University, invites applications for the position of Coordinator of Sport Clubs & Youth Programing in the Department of Campus Recreation. As part of a vibrant academic community dedicated to excellence in teaching, research, and service, this role offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a university that values innovation, collaboration, and inclusive growth. Join us in advancing knowledge and transforming lives—on campus and beyond. Tarleton State University continues to grow its impact across Texas, with four distinct campuses located in Stephenville, Fort Worth, RELLIS-Bryan and Waco, along with a robust online community that extends our reach even further.

At the heart of it all is Stephenville, where Tarleton State offers a dynamic environment for faculty and staff. From a lively live music scene and numerous local festivals to rich traditions rooted in the surrounding community, Stephenville provides a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere.

No matter where you're located—on campus or online—you are part of a mission that transforms lives and makes a difference across the state of Texas and beyond.

________________________________________________________________________

Important Immigration Information:

A Presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025. Please be advised that Tarleton State University will NOT pay this fee. Therefore, if you need immigration sponsorship for your employment, we recommend that you consult with your private immigration counsel at your own expense to ascertain whether your current immigration status would make a potential offer of employment from Tarleton State University subject to this fee.

In addition, on January 27, 2026, Texas Governor Abbot issued a moratorium on the filing of any new H-1B unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate.

________________________________________________________________________


The Coordinator of Sport Clubs and Youth Programming, under unit supervision, prepares and organizes the Sport Club program and assists in the administration of youth programming for Campus Recreation. The coordinator is responsible for providing excellent customer service to all Campus Recreation programming participants, while serving as an ambassador of Campus Recreation by working to increase student engagement and promote programs throughout campus. This position reports directly to the Associate Director of Programs for Campus Recreation.


This is an on-site position located in Stephenville, Texas with normal work hours of Monday to Friday; from 8 AM to 5PM or as business needs indicate. This position requires a flexible work schedule which at times will require frequent attendance during evenings, weekends and some holidays. Additional hours may be required during peak periods.


Sport Club Administration (50%):

  • Hire, train, supervise, and evaluate 6-10 Sport Club student staff.
  • Coordinate Sport Club officer meetings and committee selections.
  • Recruit students for Sport Club participation and facilitate the development and implementation of new clubs.
  • Collaborate with various campus and community partners to support club operations, registration, and organizational needs.
  • Create and maintain Sport Club strategic and assessment plans.
  • Develop and administer participant assessments to evaluate program effectiveness.

Youth Programming Support (20%):

  • Assist the Assistant Director of Intramural Sports and Youth Programming with Kids Camp and Spring Break Camp operations.
  • Support Youth Programming through student staff training and supervision.
  • Assist with participant registration processes and program administration.
  • Evaluate and improve Youth Programming risk management practices.

Risk Management & Compliance (10%):

  • Monitor club adherence to established safety standards, risk management protocols, and university policies.
  • Ensure staff compliance with industry best practices related to safety, facility inspections, and risk management.
  • Evaluate and enhance risk management processes for Sport Clubs and Youth Programming.
  • Ensure compliance with all Campus Recreation, Student Engagement and Success, and university policies and procedures.

Financial Management (5%):

  • Oversee financial operations for more than 20 Sport Clubs, including budgeting, expense tracking, fund appropriations, and fiscal reporting.
  • Manage the Sport Club funding allocation process.
  • Assist clubs in planning and implementing fundraising initiatives.
  • Administer the annual Sport Club operating budget of approximately $60,000.
  • Manage all university Sport Club account deposits and expenditures.
  • Process and manage student employee payroll.

Program Operations & Event Coordination (5%):

  • Coordinate scheduling of Sport Club practices and events in collaboration with Facility Operations and Field Maintenance staff.
  • Organize and oversee Sport Club travel, including transportation arrangements, lodging and registration payments, travel documentation, and compliance with university travel policies.
  • Support the overall operation and administration of Sport Club programs and events.

Marketing & Communications (5%):

  • Collaborate with the Marketing Coordinator to develop and implement promotional strategies.
  • Assist with the creation and distribution of marketing materials, including print publications, social media content, website updates, digital signage, and promotional campaigns for tryouts, competitions, fundraisers, and special events.

Professional Involvement & Additional Responsibilities (5%):

  • Serve on departmental and/or divisional committees.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of the Campus Recreation Department and the Division of Student Engagement and Success Strategic Plan.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in recreation, physical education, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • One year of related experience.


Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Master’s degree in Recreation, Physical Education or related field with two years professional experience in the management of Sport Club programs at the college or university level.
  • Minimum of three years working experience in the recreation field as well as supervision of personnel and participants, purchasing processes, and payroll management.
  • Current CPR, AED & First Aid certifications or ability to obtain within 90 days.
  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others while also maintaining the ability to work independently on projects; Interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Planning and organizational skills.
  • Supervisory skills.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: Commensurate with experience

Salary Range:

The target base annual salary range is $41,000 up to $50,761 and may be negotiable based on funding availability and candidate experience/skillset in relation to the minimum requirements of this position.

We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time and qualifying part-time employees. Our Careers Page offers an overview of the great benefits we offer; for detailed information visit our Benefits Information page.

title: Front Line Care Clinician - Hartford, CT
description:
Job Summary

Job Description

Own clinical support activities related to retaining and growing Medline Front Line Care business, including customer support, clinical troubleshooting, trial and implementation support, and clinical solutions execution while collaborating with OneMedline partners.


Objective of the Front Line Care team is to partner with health systems on improving outcomes of main Hospital Acquired Conditions (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI and Fall Prevention).


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Provide clinical subject matter expertise on clinical practice related to safe and effective use of products. Use strong clinical acumen to present and educate on the safe and effective use of Front Line Care products. Objective is to partner with health systems on key quality metrics related to nursing (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI, Fall Prevention).
  • Build and maintain strong account-level relationships with stakeholders involved in clinical decision-making, including but not limited to CNO, ACNO, ICU, key unit leaders, Infection Prevention, WOCN, Quality/Patient Safety, and other relevant clinical stakeholders.
  • Support retention activities in the assigned geography and participate in trials, implementations, and post-implementation support in assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with Front Line Care Specialists to pitch, perform assessments, and implement and maintain clinical solutions.
  • Collaborate in the field with Acute Care, IDN, Front Line Care Strategic Account Managers and Front Line Care Reps, and other partners to bring the right solutions to customer needs and retain and grow business.
  • Lead or attend local trade shows, educational dinners, chapter events or product events as needed.
  • Ensure an appropriate frequency of touchpoints with priority accounts.
  • Perform account activities including in-services, just-in-time education, clinical troubleshooting, bedside audits, trial support, clinical solutions workshops, and protocol reviews with clinical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer expectations, internal resources, clinical evaluations, implementation needs, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in Front Line Care Clinical business reviews.
  • Initiate and facilitate communication and collaboration among relevant internal stakeholders.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS

Experience

  • At least 3 years of clinical experience (patient care, education, or medical sales/support).

Education


  • Per certification requirements.

Certification / Licensure


Position requires at least one of the following certifications or meeting state-specific requirements to practice:


  • RN (Registered Nurse)
  • CCRN (Critical Care Registered Nurse)
  • APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse)
  • VA-BC (Vascular Access Board Certified)
  • CRNI (Certified Registered Nurse of Infusion)
  • CWOCN (Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nursing Certification)
  • CWCN (Certified Wound Care Nurse)
  • WCC (Wound Care Certification)

description:

As the VP, Data & Identity, you will play a key part in enabling growth within the identity, data, analytics and AI space reporting directly to the CTO. The key responsibilities include managing a set of clients enterprise data transformation programs, provide guidance on platform, tooling, data approach, identity and AI. Thus enabling our clients to stay current with tech and derive value from their data assets.


We are looking for an experienced Data Growth / Solutions Architect to lead a set of accounts for our diverse portfolio of US and global clients. You will be responsible for enabling a future ready architecture, bringing thought leadership while ensuring seamless execution across multiple teams, geographies, and client stakeholders. You will have experience speaking with C-Level and n-1s and managing high-visibility programs in a fast-paced agency environment.


You will work on cutting-edge programs for world-class brands while developing your career at one of the industry's leading marketing agencies. If you are someone who excels in a client-focused environment and can balance strategic thinking, growing the accounts and some hands-on execution excellence, come join us!


You will report to Head of Technology Advisory Services.


Responsibilities:


Overall Account Growth

  • Develop account plans based on client's current plans for data, technology and AI
  • Enable thought leadership discussions at key points within client's data journey
  • Bring forward the right stories needed to take forward with the right stakeholders
  • Be comfortable holding a target of $10M

Program Strategy & Planning

  • Develop comprehensive program strategies and roadmaps as needed for clients

Client Relationship Management

  • Be the primary contact for assigned client stakeholders, building trust and maintaining strategic relationships across multiple markets
  • Facilitate regular client communications, including client stakeholder presentations, program reviews, and weekly status sessions
  • Help the working team navigate complex client organizational structures and cultural considerations for global programs

Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Lead matrixed teams of 15-30 professionals across multiple disciplines, including creative directors, strategists, data scientists, developers, and media planners
  • Foster collaboration between our teams and external partners, including vendors, production companies, and technology providers

Program Execution & Delivery

  • Oversee program execution, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and deadlines across all workstreams
  • Manage program budgets ranging from $3M+, including forecasting, tracking, and optimization recommendations
  • Implement risk man
  • agement strategies and contingency planning for complex, multi-phase programs

Required Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of IT experience with background on enabling growth on accounts in the data, cloud, analytics and AI space
  • 3+ years with marketing data value chain experience
  • Strong understanding of identity and its value across marketing, campaigns and growth
  • Some hands-on experience or a very strong understanding of data management and AI capabilities in one or more of Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks and Snowflake

  • Track record managing programs exceeding $3M in total investment

  • Familiarity with marketing technology stack including CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, data management and eCommerce tools
  • Experience managing large, diverse teams in matrixed environments

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. title: Literacy Specialist 008K
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs—including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access—help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

Extended Day Activity Instructors lead after-school programming for children and teens at New York Edge after-school program sites. The activity instructor will teach or co-lead activities in one of the following areas: STEM, visual art, performing art, literacy, student leadership and character development, sports, health and wellness, business, finance and entrepreneurship, math, media arts, journalism, botany, and urban agriculture, history. The activity instructor has a dual reporting role, supporting the curriculum and instruction department team by designing lesson plans and implementing curricula across New York Edge program sites. They will also support the program director by preparing activity materials and explaining principles, techniques, and safety procedures to student participants. The Literacy Specialist is a multi-site instructional leader who collaborates closely with a team of Site Directors to support front-line staff (Academic Enrichment Coaches and Activity Specialists) in delivering Literacy-based curricula and thematic projects.


Schedule:

Part-Time

Monday – Friday

2:00 pm – 6:00 pm (Days/shifts vary depending on site needs)

This role requires you to be in person.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Build strong relationships with and among students

  • Teach or co-lead daily activities

  • Establish clear objectives for all lessons, units, and projects and communicate those objectives to students.

  • Participate in ongoing professional development activities

  • Prepare materials for daily activities

  • Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet students' needs and interests.

  • Support the coordination of program events

  • Input data and prepare reports

  • Administer pre and post-assessments and evaluations for student activities

QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Demonstrated ability to lead activities with children and teens

  • Creativity

  • Knowledge of state and National Literacy efforts

  • Must have excellent communication, organizational, and time management skills

  • Experience working with children and/or teens

  • Ability to multitask and manage workflow in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with program staff, school personnel, parents

  • Sensitive to social-emotional needs and characteristics of students

  • Self-starter who takes initiative

  • Flexibility, reliability, and sound judgment

  • Other duties as assigned


 REQUIREMENTS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Must be at least 18 years of age

  • College credits and/or degrees are highly preferred

  • Experience working with children strongly preferred

  • Broad knowledge of the principles and practices of current educational trends in Literacy curriculum and experience successfully teaching and instructing youth.

  • May be required to walk up and down stairs.

  • May have to lift or move objects/materials as needed.

  • Work is permitted mostly within a New York City Public School but may be required to interact with community-at-large during trips or events.

Specialists will be required to report to the school building and interact with staff, students, parents, and school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and the Department of Health.

title: NPI Product Engineer
description:
Wolfspeed is seeking an experienced and highly collaborative Product Development Engineer to lead outsourced product development activities across our external manufacturing ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving new product development, qualification, and production ramp activities with foundries, OSATs, and other strategic manufacturing partners. The successful candidate will serve as the primary technical interface between Wolfspeed business, R&D, quality, and operations teams and external partners to ensure products are successfully developed, qualified, and launched on schedule while meeting cost, quality, reliability, and performance objectives.

This cross-functional role requires strong technical leadership, project management, and supplier engagement skills to coordinate complex development programs across multiple organizations and geographic locations.

What can we do for you?

  • High visibility, cross-functional role in a fast-growing business unit.
  • Exposure and direct interaction with all levels of the organization including marketing, operations, development and business leadership
  • Potential for upward mobility in a growing organization

What can you do for us?

  • Lead outsourced product development programs from concept through qualification and production release, coordinating activities between Wolfspeed teams and external manufacturing partners.
  • Serve as the primary technical and program management interface with foundries, OSATs, material suppliers, and other development partners.
  • Manage external development schedules and actively negotiate priorities, resources, and timelines to align partner capabilities with business and customer commitments.
  • Lead technical reviews with external suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve development challenges, qualification issues, and manufacturing risks.
  • Monitor program progress, identify risks, and drive mitigation plans to achieve milestone commitments related to qualification, ramp, yield, quality, and cost.
  • Support supplier capability assessments, process transfers, and manufacturing readiness activities for new technologies and products.
  • Provide technical leadership and engineering guidance to project teams while influencing outcomes across organizations without direct authority.

Requirements:

  • B.S. in Engineering or a related technical discipline with 5+ years of semiconductor industry experience, or M.S. in Engineering or a related discipline with 3+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident.
  • Experience leading semiconductor product development, NPI, process transfer, qualification, or supplier management activities.
  • Working knowledge of semiconductor wafer fabrication, assembly, and test methods.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills with demonstrated ability to drive complex programs to completion.
  • Experience analyzing process, yield, reliability, and manufacturing data using JMP, Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
  • Self-motivated individual with strong organizational skills, technical curiosity, and the ability to effectively influence stakeholders across multiple organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with external manufacturing partners such as foundries, OSATs, contract manufacturers, or material suppliers.
  • 7+ years of experience in semiconductor product development, technology development, process integration, package development, or supplier engineering roles.
  • Experience managing technology transfers, manufacturing outsourcing programs, and supplier qualification activities.
  • Familiarity with automotive, industrial, power semiconductor, or high-reliability qualification requirements.
  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions across internal and external organizations.
  • Strong track record of problem solving, engineering judgment, risk management, and successful program execution in a fast-paced development environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Program Manager

Job Description:

The Program Manager in the Project Management Office partners with project sponsor(s)/leader(s) to oversee the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of large or complex projects and/or multi-project programs.

Posting Specifics

  • Benefits Eligible: Yes
  • Shift Details: Monday - Friday 8am to 5pm

We are committed to offering flexible work options where approved and stated in the job posting. However, we are currently not considering candidates who reside or plan to reside in the following states: California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia and Washington.

Please note that a video interview through Microsoft Teams will be required as well as potential onsite interviews and meetings.


Essential Functions

  • Oversee all aspects of Project Life Cycle – single accountable party for program/project execution. Responsible for assembling and managing the project team, planning, organizing, identification of required resources for a project and the acquisition of those resources to achieve the project objectives.
  • Rigorously manage scope, budget, schedule, risks to include mitigation strategies and management of up to 5+ projects, depending on scale and scope of projects.
  • Oversee all aspects of Program Life Cycle within the assigned program portfolio – responsible to coordinate across projects and their associated dependencies, including resource coordination and milestones. Provides capacity management oversight for program level projects and teams.
  • Leads project managers in best practice execution, adherence to standards, and project performance. Leads team of project managers if more than one project manager is required for larger projects or programs.
  • Responsible to develop, monitor, and track multiple project and program-level projects simultaneously including measurements for benefit-value realization and return on investment metrics.
  • Validate financial forecasts and expected benefits – reconciles resources and other project expenses and tracks actual value to expected results.
  • Serves as a mentor and coach for other project management roles within and across teams.
  • Lead and collaborate with others in the development, implementation, and adoption of standards, processes and tools related to program and project management and associated governance.
  • Project Managers assigned within a unique service area designated as a technical specialty area for project management (e.g., information technology, construction management, etc.) are accountable to apply specific technical specialty area requirements and skills necessary to successfully plan and deliver for projects in that area.

Skills

  • Project Management and Project Management life cycle.
  • Leadership.
  • Decision making.
  • People management
  • Change management.
  • Program/project implementation.
  • Leading project teams.
  • Finance
  • Communication.
  • Budgeting and reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated program and project management experience overseeing 5 or more simultaneous complex projects is required.
  • Demonstrated executive presence and the ability to skillfully collaborate with senior and executive leaders and teams is required.
  • Expert-level experience in stakeholder management and engagement with both strategic and operational elements of the enterprise is required.
  • Prior financial, budgetary, and capacity management experience with the ability to develop, manage, and track project budgets and associated value realization is required.
  • Proven extensive leadership experience including non-supervisory roles is required.
  • Expert Level Certified Program or Project Management designation is required. Qualifying certifications include: Option 1: PMI-PMP, PMI-PgMP, PMI-PfMP, AHA-CHC, IAPM-CSPM, IAPM-CSAPM, AAPM-Master Project Manager, or GAQM-Certified Project Director OR Option 2 - PMI-ACP, PMI-DASSM, PMI-DAC, or PMI-DAVSC AND a minimum of 8-years’ project management experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Compensation for the Service Desk Technician II role is between $27.03/hr - 37.03/hr based on a combination of factors including but not limited to education and relevant work experience.


For more details, review the full job details and requirements below.

A Service Desk Technician I provides first-line technical support to internal staff. The primary responsibility will be to provide audiovisual, desktop and mobile support, as well as answer inquiries. This job is part of a two-level career progression of Service Desk Technician I and II.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides IT Support and assistance to ensure audiovisual (AV) systems function seamlessly during meetings, presentations, and events, as well as conferencing applications such as Zoom, Teams, TeamViewers, etc.; provided IT support related to technical issues involving Microsoft’s Suite of Business Applications.

An associate degree or two years of college coursework in information technology, computer science, or a related field may be substituted for experience.


Education: A high school diploma or equivalent is required. Preference is given to candidates with an associate degree in information technology, computer science, or related field.

Licenses & Certifications: A valid driver's license and favorable driving record are required.

Language: Proficiency with verbal and written English language is required. Additional proficiency with Spanish and American Sign Language is preferred.
