title: Director, Platform Strategy & Analytics
description:
The purpose of this role is to facilitate delivery of best in class analytic and data assessments and roadmaps per established processes and templates in concert with other business disciplines, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.

Job Description:

Merkle is a global data-driven, technology-enabled performance marketing agency and the largest independent agency in the US for CRM, digital, and search. For more than 28 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with us to build and maximize the value of their customer portfolios. We work with brands like Walgreens, Geico, Regions, Albertsons, AARP, Lilly, NBC Universal, AT&T, American Express, American Cancer Society and many others to build and execute customer centric business strategies.

Role Purpose:
This role is part of Merkle’s expanding Audience Platform Analytics practice, helping clients unlock value from their data and marketing technology investments. The practice supports the strategic implementation, adoption, measurement, and optimization of leading platforms across Customer Data Platforms solutions (such as Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce etc.), Content Supply Chain, CMS, Planning & Workflow Management. Our goal is to help clients rapidly deploy and maximize the value of these platforms by establishing right strategic initiatives, robust measurement frameworks, driving adoption, enabling data-driven decision-making, and demonstrating ROI. Through audience intelligence, real-time personalization, omnichannel orchestration, content performance analytics, and operational insights, we help organizations improve efficiency, accelerate business outcomes, and realize measurable value across the end-to-end customer and content lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead CDP engagements by providing expertise in the strategy, design, development and activation of marketing omni-channel use cases and customer journeys within Adobe Experience Platform
  • Develop and execute roadmap for Adobe tech stack, ensuring alignment with business objectives, integration with organization’s Martech ecosystem, and deliver measurables results that drive incremental benefits.
  • Build frameworks required to define use cases based on a detailed understanding of clients’ needs and goals.
  • Conduct audience analyses using data attributes and business knowledge, developing audiences based on testing and targeting strategies.
  • Manage transformation through journey mapping, insight development, development of transformational roadmaps, and value quantification.
  • Lead client engagements by providing expertise across Content Supply Chain Analytics, audience platforms, data strategy, measurement, testing, and cross-channel customer engagement.
  • Define and implement measurement frameworks, KPI strategies to track performance, operational efficiency, adoption, and business value realization.
  • Lead the development of use cases and value hypotheses based on client objectives, platform capabilities, data availability, and organizational readiness.
  • Provide solutioning and strategic guidance to connect Content Supply Chain capabilities with audience activation, personalization, and omnichannel marketing execution.
  • Design and govern taxonomies, metadata frameworks, and measurement requirements.
  • Establish baseline metrics and measurement methodologies to quantify the impact of Content Supply Chain, and audience platform investments.
  • Build reporting frameworks, and insights programs that connect operational, content, and marketing performance metrics to business outcomes and ROI.
  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams to develop strategic and analytics solutions for CDP and Content Supply Chain initiatives.
  • Develop Merkle points of view (POVs), thought leadership, and industry content related to Audience Platforms, Content Supply Chain Analytics, measurement, and value realization.
  • Possess a deep understanding of the nuances in marketing to customers across different verticals and environments.
  • Collaborate with leadership, key stakeholders and partner agencies to turn ideas into actionable plans.

Skills and Experience:

  • MUST HAVE experience with Adobe Experience Platform. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar enterprise marketing technologies preferred.
  • Proven experience developing content taxonomies, metadata strategies, and data governance frameworks.
  • 8+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, CDPs, Content Supply Chain, MarTech, AdTech, consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experienced with planning and execution of digital campaigns in one or many channels including search, display, email, site, mobile
  • Experience defining and implementing measurement frameworks, KPI strategies, and reporting solutions to evaluate content performance, operational efficiency, audience engagement, and business impact.
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills, and the ability to quickly learn new technologies, influence stakeholders, and lead strategic client engagements.

Qualifications & Additional Skills:

  • Graduate or bachelor’s degree in related fields preferred: Statistics, Technology or Marketing
  • Excellent presentation skills including creating client-facing PowerPoint
  • Client Management: Ability to manage client expectations, delivery and provide thought leadership
  • Ability to provide clear brief to onshore and offshore analysts
  • Possess ability to summarize key findings/insights and make actionable recommendations
  • trong data-driven mentality, strong problem solving, consulting skills and ability to take initiatives

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000-$190,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Here’s the Gist:

As a Tool Installation Manager, you will be responsible for the management of multiple programs of tool installation ranging from single tool installations to tool installation programs including up to 150 pieces of equipment. If Wolfspeed deems it necessary for the completion of a given project, this management may involve the overseeing of an EPCM firm or an internal team made up of individuals. Part of this role will be to maintain a direct hire team for ongoing tool installations and relocations, development of installation procedures and process to be followed during these installations and methodology for both cost and schedule reporting.

The Day-to-Day:

  • Drive tool install EHS standard to zero injuries and zero harm to the environment. Adopt and enforce a “see it & own it” attitude.
  • Lead a combination of full-time Wolfspeed employees and contract employees to meet the facility tool install needs.
  • You will be responsible for coordinating with the Project Management Team on base build activities and EH&S team on the adherence to Wolfspeed’s corporate safety policies and culture. This shall include the communication of the importance of a safety culture and the demonstration of safety culture behaviors to the supervisors, peers and direct reports.
  • You are responsible for participating in vendor and subcontractor procurement/ selection, conflict resolution, bidding, budgeting and the development of customer relationships. Working knowledge of project controls, including information reporting, change order management, and process management are applied in day-to-day operations. Strong communication skills to all constituents and operating with a sense of urgency is a key success factor for this position.
  • Participate in cost estimating and schedule development activities to support ramp scenario planning.

This Job is Right for You if You Have (Minimum Requirements):

  • Experience in the overall tool installation management role of semiconductor manufacturing projects
  • Managed projects over $50M from design through tool start up and turnover.
  • Experience with contract negotiation, QA/QC program development and safety leadership.

This role may require additional duties and/or assignments as designated by management.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or Architecture or related field

· Experience with Procore, SAP

· Project experience with higher end, high visibility interior fit-ups

· LEED accreditation or WELL building certification a plus.

· Thorough knowledge of architectural design detailing and building material characteristics

· Broad understanding of industry standards and building codes

· Sincere desire to listen and understand the client and various stakeholders’ vision and key factors for project success

title: Non Registered Radiology Tech completing Radiology degree
description:
Job Description:

Non-Registered Radiology Technologist – PRN

Rocky Mountain Orthopedics | Grand Junction, Colorado

Status: PRN

Shift: Varied

Pay: $22.10/hour


Start Your Radiology Career at Rocky Mountain Orthopedics

Are you a radiologic technology student nearing the completion of your program and ready to begin putting your education and clinical experience into practice?


Join the Imaging team at Rocky Mountain Orthopedics in Grand Junction, Colorado, as a Non-Registered Radiology Technologist. This PRN opportunity is designed to help you gain valuable hands-on experience while working toward becoming a registered Radiologic Technologist.

In this role, you’ll perform diagnostic imaging procedures within your approved scope of practice under the supervision of a Registered Radiologic Technologist. You’ll work alongside experienced imaging professionals, strengthen your technical skills, and continue building the confidence and experience needed for the next step in your career.


A Pathway to Registered Radiology Technologist

This is intended to be a temporary transition position, with the expectation that you will advance into a Radiology Tech Reg position as soon as you meet the necessary requirements.

Caregivers are not expected to remain in the Non-Registered Radiology Technologist position longer than six months following completion of their clinical hours.


What You’ll Do

As part of the Imaging team, you will:

  • Perform diagnostic imaging examinations within the scope permitted by state regulations and under appropriate supervision.
  • Verify patient identity and imaging orders and appropriately prepare patients for examinations.
  • Perform examinations according to department protocols and review images for quality, clarity, and accuracy.
  • Follow radiation safety practices and help maintain a safe environment for patients and caregivers.
  • Complete imaging studies efficiently while maintaining high standards for patient care and image quality.
  • Educate patients about procedures, answer questions, and help ensure their comfort throughout the examination.
  • Follow appropriate infection prevention and sterile-technique practices.
  • Safely operate imaging equipment and related electronic information systems.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient information, procedures, and any adverse reactions.
  • Follow established requirements for medical necessity, consent, coding, charging, quality-control programs, and equipment reporting.
  • Continue developing the clinical and technical competencies required of a professional Radiologic Technologist.

Skills That Will Help You Succeed

  • Knowledge of anatomy and positioning
  • Image evaluation
  • Imaging equipment operation
  • Electronic imaging systems
  • Contrast protocols
  • Radiation and patient safety
  • Emergency response
  • Patient-focused communication
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Commitment to maintaining a clean, safe clinical environment

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a JRCERT- or AMA-approved school of radiologic technology, with documented completion of the clinical and didactic training required by applicable state regulations.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification for healthcare providers.

Build the Foundation for Your Imaging Career

This position is a great opportunity to take what you’ve learned in the classroom and clinical setting and apply it in a professional imaging environment while preparing for registration and the next stage of your career.


At Rocky Mountain Orthopedics, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from experienced imaging professionals, strengthen your clinical skills, provide high-quality patient care, and begin building your career in radiology.


Take the next step from radiologic technology student to registered technologist. Apply today and grow your imaging career with Rocky Mountain Orthopedics in Grand Junction.

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.
  • Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately, particularly during emergency situations.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing for documenting patient care, accessing needed information, medication preparation, etc.
  • Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transfer patients. Will also bend to retrieve, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.
  • Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)
  • May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.

title: NPI Engineer

The Commerce Checkout Engineering team is responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving the core checkout experience on the BigCommerce platform-one of the most business-critical and revenue-sensitive areas of the product.

  • Partners closely with Product to evolve checkout capabilities while balancing quality, security (PCI), and speed of delivery

The Commerce Engineering organisation is on a mission to build the leading SaaS ecommerce platform.


We work closely with engineering teams across multiple domains, product managers, designers, business stakeholders, and external partners to build a platform where we can easily and securely deliver new and alternative user experiences. Our team brings together people with varied experience and strengths, and we iterate, learn, and build great software together.

Who You Are

  • You’re comfortable working in existing systems as much as building new ones, and you enjoy simplifying code, refactoring, and untangling complexity
  • You’re a clear communicator who can explain technical details and trade-offs to both engineers and non-engineers
  • You take ownership of outcomes, follow through on commitments, and hold yourself to a high standard of reliability
  • You enjoy mentoring and supporting others, and you contribute positively to the team’s culture and technical growth
  • You stay up to date with modern tools and approaches without being dogmatic. Your goal is to find the right solution, not the trendiest one

Work Where You Thrive

title: AI & Data Solutions Engineer
description:
Help us bring AI from ambition to reality

At AGC Biologics, we have reached an exciting point in our AI journey. The governance foundation is in place, several high-value use cases have been identified, and we are now ready to scale the development and deployment of AI solutions across the business.


To support this journey, we are looking for an AI & Data Solutions Engineer who can help turn business challenges into practical and scalable AI solutions.

This role sits within our Global Data, AI & Business Platforms organization and will work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation. You will collaborate with stakeholders across AGC Biologics, partner with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, and contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.


What you'll be doing

In your first months, you will be involved in several AI initiatives already identified across the organization. Some solutions will be developed together with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, while others will be built and deployed directly within AGC Biologics.


Success in this role requires someone who enjoys moving between business discussions and technical implementation. One day you may be meeting with stakeholders to understand a new AI opportunity and define requirements. The next, you may be preparing datasets, working on solution architecture, developing machine learning capabilities, or supporting the deployment of an AI solution into production.


You will work closely with our Data Engineering, Analytics, Solution Architecture, and Digitalization teams and play an important role in ensuring that AI solutions are technically robust, business-relevant, and ready for real-world use.


What we're looking for

We imagine you come from a background in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field, and have already worked hands-on with building, deploying, or supporting AI and data-driven solutions.


You are comfortable working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Azure, and ideally have exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake. Experience working with machine learning models, AI applications, data pipelines, and data preparation is important, while familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or other emerging AI technologies would be a significant advantage.


Equally important is your ability to work with people. This is a highly business-facing role, and we are looking for someone who can confidently engage stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex concepts in a simple and understandable way.


You enjoy collaboration, challenge assumptions constructively, and thrive in environments where priorities evolve and new opportunities emerge.


Experience that will help you succeed

Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, or other GxP-regulated industries will be considered a strong advantage. We also welcome candidates coming from manufacturing or production-focused environments where technology, data, and business operations come together to support critical processes.


Whether your background is in AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering, what matters most is your ability to combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement and a genuine passion for solving business problems through technology.


Why AGC Biologics?

This is an opportunity to join a growing global team where AI is becoming a strategic capability across the organization. You will have the chance to influence how AI is adopted, work with modern technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and North America, and contribute to solutions that support the development and manufacturing of therapies that improve patients' lives around the world.


If you are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of AI at AGC Biologics, we would love to hear from you.


Interested in Joining Us?

If you are interested we would like to hear from you.


Applications are screened on an ongoing basis. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences in you CV about your motivation for applying to this position.


Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark, or the greater Malmø area.


If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. The right mindset matters just as much.


Please submit your application through the AGC Biologics careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Who We Are
AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: CATI QC Monitor / Telephone Survey Interview Monitor (Part-Time/Bilingual)
description:
The CATI Quality Control (QC) Monitor is responsible for monitoring, evaluating, coaching, and documenting the performance of Computer-Assisted Telephone Interviewing (CATI) interviewers conducting Veterans Affairs (VA) survey research studies. This position plays a critical role in ensuring that interviewers adhere to approved survey protocols, Veterans Crisis Line (VCL) escalation procedures, confidentiality requirements, and quality assurance standards while collecting information from Veterans participating in VA service delivery program. These include mental health, suicide prevention, healthcare experience, and service dog training programs.


The QC Monitor evaluates interviewer performance through live monitoring, recorded call reviews, CATI system reviews, and documentation audits. The position works closely with Interviewers, supervisors, the CATI study manager, and the Clinical Director to ensure Veterans are treated with respect, empathy, and professionalism while maintaining the highest standards of data quality. Because these studies involve potentially sensitive discussions regarding mental health, PTSD, suicidal ideation, wellbeing, recovery, and healthcare experiences, the QC Monitor must be capable of evaluating trauma-informed interviewing practices and identifying situations requiring clinical escalation.


This position is remote/work-from-home and requires a secure, confidential, and distraction-free work environment. Must be located in the Greater Tampa Area.


Quality Monitoring and Evaluation

  • Review recorded interviews to assess interviewer compliance with approved scripts, survey protocols, and quality standards.
  • Monitor live CATI interviews to assess interviewer compliance with approved scripts, survey protocols, and quality standards.
  • Evaluate interviewer performance using project-specific quality monitoring forms and scorecards.
  • Assess interviewer compliance with: Survey administration procedures; Respondent engagement standards; CATI system usage requirements; Privacy and confidentiality requirements; Crisis escalation procedures; and Data collection protocols.
  • Verify proper use of disposition codes, callback scheduling procedures, and respondent tracking activities.
  • Document monitoring findings and maintain detailed quality assurance records.
  • Identify trends affecting data quality, response rates, retention rates, and interviewer performance.

Interviewer Coaching and Development

  • Provide real-time and post-monitoring feedback to interviewers.
  • Coach interviewers on rapport-building, respondent engagement, refusal avoidance, and effective interviewing techniques.
  • Conduct refresher training sessions when quality issues are identified.
  • Support interviewer development through individualized coaching plans.
  • Assist in onboarding and certification of new interviewers.
  • Reinforce Veteran-centric communication techniques and trauma-informed interviewing practices.
  • Escalate persistent performance concerns with supervisor and project leadership.

Veteran Experience and Survey Quality

  • Evaluate interviewer interactions to ensure Veterans are treated with dignity, respect, sensitivity, and professionalism.
  • Assess interviewer adherence to standards, which may include discussions of: Mental health treatment; Suicide prevention services; PTSD; Recovery and wellbeing; Service dog training participation.
  • Monitor respondent complaints, concerns, or negative interactions for required follow-up.
  • Ensure interviewer compliance with informed consent and voluntary participation requirements.
  • Promote a Veteran-centered interviewing culture throughout data collection activities.

Crisis Escalation Oversight

  • Monitor interviewer recognition and handling of participant distress.
  • Verify adherence to Veterans Crisis Line (988, Press 1) escalation procedures.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation of all participant safety concerns.
  • Confirm timely notification of supervisors and Clinical Director staff during crisis events.
  • Review crisis-related incidents for quality assurance and protocol compliance.
  • Support post-incident reviews and corrective action activities when required.
  • Immediately notify leadership if serious protocol deviations affecting Veteran safety are identified.

Compliance and Data Security

  • Ensure personal and interviewer compliance with: HIPAA requirements; Human Subjects Protection requirements; VA privacy standards; Information security requirements; CATI system procedures.
  • Protect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Conduct quality reviews in accordance with established confidentiality requirements.
  • Maintain secure handling of quality monitoring records and project documentation.
  • Participate in audits and quality reviews conducted by project leadership or government representatives.

Reporting and Documentation

  • Prepare quality monitoring reports and summaries.
  • Maintain interviewer performance metrics and monitoring logs.
  • Track coaching activities and corrective action plans.
  • Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Provide quality summaries to project leadership, CATI study manager, and Clinical Director.
  • Assist with preparation of quality assurance reports required by project management.

title: QA Associate - Laboratories
description:
About Us

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.



A Day in the Life
As a QA Associate, you’ll be responsible for assisting multiple projects where you will have increasing interaction with our multi-disciplinary staff, regulatory agencies and clients. You will be part of a strong team of committed professionals.


The hourly compensation range for this role is $20.00 to $23.00, commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.


Schedule: Monday - Friday


To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities:


  • Track or perform verifications of laboratory supply equipment to ensure operational reliability per SOP and manufacturer specifications.
  • Perform daily/weekly reviews of appropriate logbooks, bench sheets, or data for Good Documentation Practices (GDP) compliance.
  • Initiate and address non-conformances for corrective actions.
  • Collect and interpret quality control data, create control charts, and audit sample reports to track lab performance and identify trends.
  • Track CAPA and perform or assist with Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Conduct routine internal audits of laboratory processes, documentation, and facilities.
  • Prepare audit checklists, reports, and follow-up on findings.
  • Accurate and timely communication with internal and external clients.
  • Draft, review, and/or revise SOPs, work instructions, forms, or other controlled documents.
  • Review and enter Proficiency Testing (PT) data and results.
  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Develop and deliver in-laboratory GDP, ethics, data integrity, safety, and technical training.
  • Maintain training records and competency assessments.
  • Archive documents in accordance with SOPs.
  • Review laboratory data, workflows, and procedures to ensure accuracy and compliance with TNI 2016, ISO 17025, client requirements, and our robust quality system.
  • Support external audits.
  • Communicating relevant updates to applicable people in a timely manner.
  • Adhere to documented quality manual, policies, and health and safety practices and protocols (i.e., use of PPE, chemical hygiene, and waste handling).
  • Take on additional duties and responsibilities as needed to support our dynamic lab team.

Your Expertise and Skills

These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific field, or a combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 1+ years of relevant experience working in a laboratory or quality assurance role (or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of scientific terminology, analytical laboratory procedures, and lab safety.
  • Understanding of physical and chemical principles underlying why procedures are specified the way they are for each method with which they work.
  • Good written and verbal communication, with sharp editorial and proofreading abilities.
  • Ability to collaborate with lab teams to gather, interpret, and document data.
  • Good organization, time management, and communication skills and able to facilitate priorities in an effective manner.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, Excel, SharePoint, and PowerPoint).
  • Familiarity with TNI 2016, ISO 17025 standards, GDP, CAPA, or RCA is a plus.
  • Experience with LIMS.
  • Proficiency using and data visualization tools for reports and graphs.
  • Conflict resolution skills and removes/breakdowns organizational communication barriers.
  • Assertion skills-problem diagnosis, assess corrective action, not blame.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining composure.
  • A team player who can work independently and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, quality-driven environment.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

The physical and environmental requirements below reflect what’s typically needed to perform the essential functions of this role safely and effectively. We may provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law, to support performance of the essential functions.


  • Sitting, standing, and walking
  • Lifting 50 pounds several times a day
  • Overhead lifting of over 20 pounds
  • Works in an office and/or laboratory environment
  • May be exposed to hot and cold environments and extreme weather conditions, including sunlit, rainy and windy conditions
  • May occasionally work shifts up to 12 hours in duration
  • Ability to work occasional evenings or weekends based on workload demands.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its employment for individuals with disabilities. Click here to learn more.

Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. Objective of the Front Line Care team is to partner with health systems on improving outcomes of main Hospital Acquired Conditions (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI and Fall Prevention).


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Use strong clinical acumen to present and educate on the safe and effective use of Front Line Care products. Objective is to partner with health systems on key quality metrics related to nursing (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI, Fall Prevention).

title: Digital Media Analyst
description:
Responsible for the design, development, and communication of paid media analytics that provide insight into the marketing performance of Strayer University. The Paid Media Analyst translates raw campaign data across social, display, and video channels into actionable intelligence that drives strategy, improves efficiency, and demonstrates enrollment impact.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The Digital Media Analyst is a core member of the Strayer in-house digital media team. This position is responsible for the design, development, and communication of paid media analytics that provide insight into the company's marketing performance across all in-house digital channels. This individual will regularly collaborate with the Digital Media Buyer, Media Strategy team, and the broader Marketing Analytics team to deliver end-to-end paid media analytics that meet and exceed requirements from internal clients. This role manages multiple priorities efficiently and independently, while facilitating knowledge transfer and self-service reporting. A natural curiosity for using data to understand paid media performance is very helpful in this position, as is a passion to collaborate with the team to continually improve reporting outputs and analytical processes.

1. Performance Reporting & Dashboards

  • Design, build, and maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance dashboards across all in-house digital channels
  • Track and report on key KPIs including spend, impressions, clicks, leads, views, applications, and enrollments
  • Deliver standardized reporting packages to relevant stakeholders on a defined cadence; flag anomalies and pacing issues proactively
  • Support quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with analysis-ready data pulls, charts, and written commentary
  • Maintain a running pacing tracker updated no less than weekly across all active campaigns and budget lines

2. Campaign Analysis & Optimization Insights

  • Analyze campaign performance data to surface actionable insights on audience targeting, creative performance, placement mix, and bid strategy
  • Provide data-driven optimization recommendations; document and track the impact of changes made
  • Support A/B test design, execution tracking, and results analysis across all platforms; maintain a testing log with documented outcomes
  • Monitor creative fatigue and frequency metrics; generate creative performance reports to inform rotation decisions
  • Analyze cross-channel attribution and assist with media mix modeling inputs to help quantify incremental impact

3. Data Infrastructure & Tagging Integrity

  • Own the tracking taxonomy and ensure all campaigns are correctly tagged before launch; audit existing campaigns quarterly
  • Monitor platform pixels and conversion events across platforms; flag and escalate discrepancies to the tagging/analytics team
  • Maintain campaign naming conventions and trafficking documentation to ensure clean data downstream in BI tools and data warehouse
  • Serve as the internal QA checkpoint for campaign setup accuracy — verifying targeting, tracking, budgets, and creative assignments against the approved media plan
  • Pull and validate custom audience lists; ensure CRM/upload-based segments are refreshed on schedule

4. Cross-Team Collaboration & Self-Service

  • Collaborate with the Marketing Analytics Team to align paid media definitions, metrics, and data structures with the broader marketing data ecosystem
  • Develop and maintain self-service reporting documentation and SOPs so internal stakeholders can access and interpret campaign data independently
  • Support invoice reconciliation by producing spend-vs-plan reports and validating against media plan budgets
  • Contribute to knowledge-transfer documentation and maintain the team's analytics and process playbook

Job Skills

  • Demonstrated capability in analyzing paid media data to drive marketing strategy and support decision-making across paid social, display, and programmatic channels
  • Strong interpersonal skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to present complex data in an understandable and compelling manner
  • Demonstrated experience driving and achieving results through data-informed recommendations
  • Ability to work in a team setting while also being an assertive self-starter capable of managing multiple priorities independently
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills with a natural curiosity for uncovering the story behind the numbers
  • Ability to present complex information in an understandable and compelling manner to non-technical stakeholders

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant digital marketing analytics experience, preferably with direct exposure to paid media campaigns
  • Experience extracting and analyzing data from digital campaign management platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google DV360, Google Ads, or DoubleClick/CM360
  • Knowledge and experience using analytical and data visualization tools, particularly Excel, Power BI, and/or Tableau
  • Experience with web reporting tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics, as well as SQL or similar query languages
  • Experience building and maintaining performance dashboards and recurring reporting packages for senior stakeholders

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in digital marketing, analytics, statistics, mathematics, business, or a web-relevant field

Other

  • Must be able to travel occasionally should a business need arise. For most roles travel would not be common. Travel may involve plane, car or metro. In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or Capella Core Faculty (5 – 10%).
  • Ability to work onsite in Corporate or Campus location (in a typical office environment) may be required based on role. If so, this would include being mobile within the office, including movement from floor-to-floor using elevators or stairs.
  • If offsite or hybrid role, must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • Faculty and Federal Work Study roles require access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including computer, privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • This role may require lifting, however reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with our ADA policies.
  • Must be able to meet critical thinking and problem solving aspects aligned to job duties, as well as effectively communicating with co-workers.
  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.

title: Program Manager, CRM and Loyalty
description:

Remote (U.S.) | West Coast Hours Preferred

Are you a Program Manager who thrives in fast-paced agency environments and loves bringing complex CRM and loyalty initiatives to life?

We're looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead integrated marketing, CRM, and loyalty programs for a portfolio of high-profile clients. In this role, you'll partner with strategy, creative, technology, analytics, and client teams to drive successful delivery of large-scale initiatives that create meaningful customer experiences and business impact.

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative team where you'll have visibility with senior leaders, influence how work gets done, and help shape programs for some of the world's most recognized brands.

What You'll Do

Lead Complex Programs

  • Drive planning, execution, and delivery of CRM, loyalty, and integrated marketing programs.
  • Develop program roadmaps, timelines, success metrics, and delivery strategies.
  • Manage multiple workstreams and dependencies across teams and stakeholders.
  • Identify risks, solve issues proactively, and keep programs moving forward.

Partner with Clients

  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Lead status meetings, program reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Translate business objectives into actionable delivery plans.
  • Help clients navigate change and transformation initiatives.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with strategy, creative, technology, analytics, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate work across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Align stakeholders around priorities and guide teams through ambiguity.
  • Monitor workloads, resolve conflicts, and facilitate solutions when challenges arise.

Ensure Successful Delivery

  • Maintain program health, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Manage program budgets and forecasting.
  • Track progress against goals and communicate status to leadership.
  • Capture learnings and best practices to improve future programs.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a Program Manager role within an agency, marketing, consulting, or similar environment.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex programs.
  • Experience supporting CRM, customer engagement, marketing technology, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience working across multiple disciplines, including strategy, creative, technology, analytics, and delivery teams.
  • Experience presenting to senior leaders and executives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with loyalty programs.
  • Experience managing CRM transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology platforms, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
  • Experience working with Fortune 500 brands and complex enterprise organizations.
  • Experience partnering closely with strategy teams and overseeing strategic workstreams.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

You are:

  • A strong communicator who can influence without direct authority.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguity and change.
  • Skilled at bringing diverse teams together around a common goal.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Experienced in navigating the pace and complexity of agency life.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge CRM and loyalty programs for leading brands.
  • Collaborate with talented strategy, creative, technology, and analytics teams.
  • Gain visibility with senior leadership and clients.
  • Make a meaningful impact on high-profile customer experience initiatives.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of a remote-first environment.

If you're an agency-savvy Program Manager who enjoys leading complex CRM and loyalty programs while partnering with a variety of teams and stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you. 🚀

title: NPI Engineer – Electronics (867868)
description:
Spear, founded in 2017 and based in Tel Aviv, develops and manufactures the Viper family of advanced Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) for leading defence forces. As the leading system house in Israel for tactical UAS focusing both on the battalion echelon and submarines, we provide end-to-end system development from concept and design through integration and field testing - delivering AI-powered loitering systems that give any combat unit an “inherent air force” with minimal training. Our multidisciplinary teams work across hardware, software, computer vision, artificial intelligence, communications, navigation, motion control, and electro-mechanics. As we continue to grow rapidly, we are looking for talented team players to join our success.


We are looking for NPI Engineer with Electronics background to lead and manage New Product Introduction (NPI) processes, transferring electronic products and systems from development to serial production, including PCBAs and electronic assemblies.

Responsible for ensuring product readiness for manufacturing, defining production and testing processes, preparing manufacturing documentation, and supporting initial production runs through process stabilization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead NPI processes, work plans, and Production Readiness Reviews (PRR).
  • Define manufacturing, assembly, and testing processes, including SMT, PCBA, and DFM / DFA / DFT methodologies.
  • Manage engineering interfaces with R&D, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, and external EMS providers.
  • Prepare manufacturing documentation, manage product configuration, and control engineering changes (ECO).
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues, lead failure analysis, and drive process improvements while ensuring quality, cost, and schedule targets.


Requirements:

  • B.Sc. in Electrical or Electronics Engineering – mandatory.
  • At least 3 years of experience in Electronics Manufacturing Engineering, NPI, or Development-to-Production Transfer – mandatory.
  • Proven experience transferring electronic boards and assemblies from development to serial production.
  • Experience working with Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SMT, PCBA, soldering, and electronic assembly processes.
  • Experience with manufacturing documentation, DFM / DFA / DFT, and engineering change management.
  • Experience in the defense, aerospace, or UAV industry – significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with PLM / PDM systems – advantage.
  • Strong hands-on engineering skills, systems-level thinking, and ability to lead cross-functional processes.
  • Native-level Hebrew and strong technical English.

title: Consultant - Data Engineer MarTech
description:
Tech consultants out there, we have a temporary assignment open as of now for some months forward. We welcome both independent consultants and consultancy firms to present candidates for this role. We also want to emphasize that we care deeply about diversity. We strongly encourage consultancy partners to reflect this in their submissions, i.e., at least present candidates out of gender diversity.

Every week, millions of people turn to us when they’re looking for a new home, or just imagining one. Reaching them with the right message at the right time really matters.
That’s where Martech comes in, right where marketing meets tech. Marketing has plenty of ideas about how we can reach our users in smarter, more relevant ways, and making them happen takes someone who understands both the data and the people behind it.

As our new Data Engineer in Martech, you’ll be the bridge. You’ll translate marketing ideas into technical solutions, and explain technical possibilities and limitations in a way that makes sense to Marketing. You’ll dig into a setup that has grown over time, work out what’s what, and help shape what it should become.

It’s a role with real impact and plenty of room to make your mark. You won’t just be maintaining something. You’ll help build the foundation for more intelligent communication that helps people find their way home.

☝🏽Please apply by November 13 at the latest.


What you'll be up to 🍏
You’ll support Martech as an area, owning both the day-to-day operation of what we have today and the development of what comes next. Keeping things running is only half the job. The other half is moving us forward, from where we are to where we should be.

In short, you’ll:

  • Run and improve our existing Martech setup

  • Move logic and content out of our core platform so Marketing can own it our CRM system in

  • Work closely with Marketing to understand their needs and turn them into solutions

  • Build towards smarter, data-driven communication using our real-time platform


Who we think you are 🤩
You’re a self-starter who takes initiative and gets things done without waiting to be told. You also have the people skills to read the room. You check in, ask the right questions and make sure you’re heading in the same direction as everyone else before you run. In addition you’re curious and eager to learn. You enjoy digging deep, untangling tricky problems and figuring out how things actually work.

In short, you’re:

  • Flexible. You adapt as things shift, and they will.

  • Curious. You want to understand, not just patch.

  • Ownership-minded. You take responsibility and follow through.

  • A team player. You win with the team, not on your own.


Requirements

  • Experience with TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, which our current integration service is built on.

  • Experience building and running API integrations with external platforms in production, ideally a CRM or marketing platform, including rate limits, monitoring and incident handling.

  • Experience working closely with non-technical teams, including turning their needs into technical solutions, explaining trade-offs and setting expectations.

  • Strong skills in SQL and data modelling, including event data at volume.

  • Experience building and running event-driven data flows, including retries, duplicates, ordering and backfills.
    Hands-on experience with analytical databases or data warehouses.

    Bonus

  • Experience with ClickHouse, BigQuery, dbt, Prefect or Kafka, which our data platform uses.

  • Experience integrating with , Braze or a similar customer messaging platform.

  • Experience with consent, identity across systems and deletion in customer data.


I am your new manager 👋
Hi, I am Helena and will be your new manager. A little about me: I’m engaged and I care about the people around me and about the work we do together. I see each person as an individual, and I see my job as giving you what you need to succeed and grow. That will look different for everyone, so I’ll be asking and listening a lot in the beginning.
You can expect me to be clear and direct, and to bring structure so we know where we’re going and why. I’d rather say things openly than leave you guessing, and I expect you’ll do the same with me.
I believe this team has the potential to deliver the really exciting things, the kind that make Hemnet the very best property portal, and I want us to do more of that. Getting there also takes groundwork, from the platform to data quality, and I’m excited to take that on together with you.
I also have a technical background in data, so I have a pretty good grasp of what goes into the work, and I still enjoy building things myself.


A note to Consultancy companies☝🏽
Present from a diversity perspective and do not forget candidate availability (open to start when) and hourly cost. Please note, all applications should be sent through this advert.

If any questions, please contact julia.maric@hemnet.se.


A note on inclusion 💚
At Hemnet, we believe that diversity in gender, sexual orientation, ability, neurodiversity, cultural background and life experience makes us stronger. We welcome applicants of all identities and backgrounds.

If you meet many but not all of the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a strong sense of purpose and the motivation to learn and grow, alongside your skills and experiences.


An Office-First Culture 🙏
Our office in central Stockholm is the true hub of our company culture. We are proudly an office-first team because we deeply value face-to-face collaboration and believe our best work happens when we are together. While we understand the need for occasional flexibility, we strongly prioritize in-person teamwork over remote work. Because our office is the center of our daily operations, it is essential that you are based in or near Stockholm.

title: Resource Specialist
description:
Position Purpose: Provides resource support to members and connects members to local resources for various services (e.g., employment, housing, independent living, justice, foster care) based on care/service assessment and plans. Works with leadership to identify the best, most appropriate local resources for member's needs based on industry best practices.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in child welfare and/or foster care, along with a background in case management. Strong computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications are required. The successful candidate should also possess excellent communication and customer service skills, strong attention to detail, assessment capabilities, effective time management skills, and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

The work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with occasional weekend work required.

  • Helps with assessing member needs and develops or contributes to the development of care plans/service plans for members with care team in accordance with their goals and preferences for various services (e.g., employment, housing, independent living, justice, foster care, and/or community transitions) including the identification and coordination of referral for care/services

Education/Experience: Requires a Bachelor's degree and 2 – 4 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

title: Expert LLM Engineer (AI Security)
description:
About Us

At Framna, we partner with ambitious brands to create digital products that make a meaningful impact.

We work across the full product journey, from strategy and UX to engineering and long-term growth, combining technical expertise with a strong product mindset. Together with our partners, we build solutions that users rely on every day.

Our culture is built on trust, ownership, and fearless collaboration. We challenge ideas, support each other, and keep learning-openly sharing feedback, staying flexible in how we work, and approaching each other with empathy. Because the best products are created by teams that move forward together.


About the Role

You will work on AI-powered security solutions for a next-generation, passwordless authentication platform used by millions worldwide, leveraging advanced biometrics to protect digital identities.

Using Python and a range of LLMs, you will build and scale production solutions, including RAG and multi-agent systems. Your work will cover agent orchestration, tools and integrations, context and memory management, evaluation, and observability, with a focus on quality, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Through controlled adversarial testing, you will investigate how attackers could use or manipulate LLMs and AI agents to bypass product safeguards. You will analyse agent activity in customer applications, identify potentially unsafe or unauthorised behaviour, and translate findings into stronger safeguards and product improvements.

We value occasional in-person meetings at our studio to support collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or security engineering, including at least 2 years developing and maintaining LLM-based solutions in production

  • Good knowledge of Python and experience building maintainable backend components that integrate multiple LLMs with applications, APIs, and data sources

  • Experience designing multi-agent architectures, orchestrating agent collaboration, designing and building agent tools, and managing agent fleets, context, and memory.

  • Hands-on experience building RAG systems and working with embeddings and vector databases

  • Experience evaluating LLM response quality and agent behaviour, building evaluation datasets and automated testing pipelines, with an understanding of data quality, validation, and data leakage

  • Experience monitoring LLM and agent activity in customer applications through logging, tracing, and traffic analysis to identify suspicious sources, malicious behaviour, and unauthorised activity.

  • Experience optimising the performance and costs of LLM-based solutions through model selection, caching, and rate-limit management

  • Practical experience investigating vulnerabilities in LLM-based applications and agentic systems through threat modelling and controlled adversarial testing, including identifying potential attack paths, attempting to bypass safeguards, and implementing protections against prompt injection, tool misuse, and abuse

  • Experience deploying, operating, and scaling LLM-based solutions

title: Blackstone Physical Security - SVP - Head of Investigations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

The Senior Vice President of Investigations will lead the design, implementation, and oversight of a global investigative program. This executive role is responsible for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and responding to internal and external threats that could impact the firm’s employees, operations, investments, clients, executives, and reputation.

The SVP will oversee enterprise-wide investigative operations involving employees, consultants, contractors, vendors, and third-party partners while partnering closely with other business lines across Blackstone. The role requires deep expertise in both domestic and international investigations, due diligence, executive protection support, and enterprise threat assessment within a highly regulated and fast-paced financial services environment.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with extensive experience managing sensitive investigations, building proactive investigation programs, and safeguarding complex global organizations from operational, reputational, financial, and physical risks.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Investigative Leadership

  • Develop and lead the firm’s enterprise investigation strategy, governance framework, and investigative protocols.
  • Establish proactive monitoring and risk identification processes related to consultants, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers.
  • Identify behavioral, operational, monetary, and physical indicators of physical security insider risk.
  • Investigate activities involving workplace violence, corporate espionage, fraud, misconduct, unauthorized disclosures, and other internal threats.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Technology teams to integrate physical and digital investigations into a unified insider risk program.
  • Create escalation and response frameworks for high-risk incidents and investigations.

Investigations

  • Collaborate with intelligence partners to lead sensitive and complex investigations involving misconduct, theft, fraud, workplace violence, executive threats, vendor concerns, and policy violations.
  • Advise on investigative response efforts involving portfolio companies, corporate offices, and senior executives.
  • Coordinate with external law enforcement, intelligence agencies, legal counsel, and investigative partners when necessary.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and confidentiality procedures for investigative materials and sensitive information.

Physical Security & Enterprise Protection

  • Collaborate with regional security teams to ensure consistent investigative and threat management standards globally.
  • Develop investigative standards, reporting frameworks, and metrics for executive leadership and board-level committees.
  • Deliver executive briefings on investigations, insider risk trends, and enterprise threat exposure.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, privacy regulations, financial regulations, and ethical conduct.
  • Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Legal, HR, Compliance, Internal Audit, Risk, Cybersecurity, and Portfolio Operations teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in leading corporate or government investigations.
  • Significant experience leading insider threat and investigative programs within government, financial services, asset management, private equity, banking, or similarly complex global organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing highly sensitive investigations involving executives, employees, vendors, and third parties.
  • Strong understanding of physical security operations, enterprise risk management, and protective intelligence methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with cybersecurity and technology teams on integrated threat management initiatives.

#LI-DNI


The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

title: Careflight Communications Center Manager
description:
Location:

Avera McKennan Hospital

Worker Type:

Regular

Work Shift:

Day/Evening/Weekend/Holiday Shift (United States of America)

Position Highlights:


You Belong at Avera


Be part of a multidisciplinary team built with compassion and the goal of Moving Health Forward for you and our patients. Work where you matter.


A Brief Overview

Responsible for the leadership, management and 24/7 operation of the Avera Careflight Communication Center, including aeromedical (rotor wing and fixed wing) and ground transport dispatch. Directs and develops communication center staff, owns center policy, quality and regulatory compliance, and serves as the first point of contact for all accidents and incidents. Leads dispatching software and communication systems and supports program leaders with data analysis, audits and quality review.

What you will do

  • Directs the 24/7 operations of the Avera Careflight Communication Center, including aeromedical and ground transport dispatch.
  • Provides leadership, supervision, staffing, scheduling, performance management, and staff development for Communication Center personnel.
  • Serves as the initial point of contact for accidents and incidents and coordinates emergency response activities, including PAIP activation and drills.
  • Develops, implements and maintains Communication Center goals, objectives, policies, procedures, protocols and standards to ensure regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • Leads quality assurance and performance improvement activities, including run report review, communication audits, trend analysis and corrective action recommendations.
  • Collects, analyzes and reports operational and quality data to support accreditation, regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Participates in the Safety Management System (SMS), including hazard reporting, safety investigations and risk mitigation activities.
  • Directs competency-based education, orientation, continuing education and professional development programs for Communication Center staff.
  • Serves as administrator and subject matter expert for dispatch software, communication systems and related vendor-supported technologies.
  • Manages departmental resources and collaborates with operational, clinical, maintenance and external stakeholders to support safe and efficient patient transport operations.
  • Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, developing, training, and retaining employees; planning, assigning, and leading work; appraising performance; rewarding and coaching employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Essential Qualifications

The individual must be able to work the hours specified. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job function satisfactorily including having visual acuity adequate to perform position duties and the ability to communicate effectively with others, hear, understand and distinguish speech and other sounds. These requirements and those listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions, as long as the accommodations do not cause undue hardship to the employer.

  • Certified Flight Communicator - International Association of Medical Transport Communication Specialists (IAMTCS) or Commlink CFC certification within 2 Years
  • 3 or more years of air medical, EMS, public safety communications, dispatch, or related healthcare operations experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory, leadership, or lead-worker experience.

Preferred Education, License/Certification, or Work Experience:

  • Associate's or
  • Bachelor's
  • Experience with Flight Vector or other CAD/dispatch software.
  • Air medical communications, EMT, EMD, aviation, emergency services, medical terminology, or healthcare experience.
  • Knowledge of public safety communications, emergency response procedures and regulatory standards.

Expectations and Standards

  • Commitment to the daily application of Avera’s mission, vision, core values, and social principles to serve patients, their families, and our community.
  • Promote Avera’s values of compassion, hospitality, and stewardship.
  • Uphold Avera’s standards of Communication, Attitude, Responsiveness, and Engagement (CARE) with enthusiasm and sincerity.
  • Maintain confidentiality.
  • Work effectively in a team environment, coordinating work flow with other team members and ensuring a productive and efficient environment.
  • Comply with safety principles, laws, regulations, and standards associated with, but not limited to, CMS, The Joint Commission, DHHS, and OSHA if applicable.

title: Business Strategist
description:
Als Business Strategist bij Framna help je organisaties hun uitdagingen en ambities te vertalen naar strategische richting. Je ontdekt waar digitale innovatie écht waarde toevoegt, adviseert klanten over hun digitale toekomst en speelt een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol in commerciële trajecten.

Word onderdeel van ons team

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en product. Onze teams ontwerpen en bouwen digitale producten en jij zorgt dat het de juiste producten zijn. Jouw advies bepaalt waar partners in investeren en welke keuzes ze maken. Dat zie je terug in de resultaten: groei, meer gebruikers, meer omzet en een hogere tevredenheid. Je overtuigt C-level om te investeren en de keuzes te maken die jij ze voorlegt. Daarin trek je samen op met collega’s uit de Strategy & Consulting Hub en het salesteam.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent inhoudelijk eigenaar van strategische vraagstukken bij partners. Je ziet waar groeikansen liggen en pakt ze op, zonder te wachten tot iemand erom vraagt. Je bepaalt wat er nodig is om die kansen te realiseren en welke stap als eerste gezet moet worden. Je haalt de input van stakeholders en disciplines op, kiest waar belangen botsen en legt een voorstel neer waar je volledig achter staat.

Je bent waar mogelijk bij onze partners aanwezig, zorgt voor zichtbaarheid van Framna en geeft richting. Door middel van gerichte interviews en workshops verschaf je de benodigde informatie om de vertaling te maken naar een goed inhoudelijk advies. Je weet daarbij goed te schakelen tussen C-level en andere niveau's in de organisatie. Samen met de collega's van Sales en Strategy duiken jullie in complexe klantvraagstukken, voeren jullie strategische analyses uit en ontwikkelen jullie overtuigende commerciële voorstellen.

Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:

  • Zelfstandig complexe businessvraagstukken van partners leiden, van probleemdefinitie tot een heldere strategische richting.

  • Op eigen initiatief groeikansen bij partners signaleren en uitwerken tot concrete voorstellen.

  • Partners adviseren over digitale strategie, businessmodellen, transformatie en groei.

  • Je advies verdedigen tegenover management en directie tot er een gedragen keuze ligt.

  • Markt-, concurrentie- en technologieanalyses vertalen naar concrete kansen en prioriteiten.

  • De strategische lijn bepalen en uitdragen in commerciële trajecten; van eerste gesprek en workshop tot pitch en voorstel.

  • Proactief nieuwe partnerrelaties en kansen ontwikkelen, samen met business development.

  • Framna’s strategische dienstverlening en proposities verder vormgeven.

Wie jij bent

Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt in een strategische of adviserende rol, bijvoorbeeld als Business Strategist, Digital Strategist of Business Consultant.

  • In het bezit bent van een HBO- en/of WO Diploma.

  • Verschillende belangen en disciplines samenbrengt tot één heldere richting.

  • Complexe businessvraagstukken weet te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete strategische kansen en onderbouwde, overtuigende adviezen.

  • Een sterk gevoel hebt voor business en begrijpt hoe digitale oplossingen bijdragen aan strategische en commerciële doelstellingen.

  • Energie krijgt van commerciële trajecten en graag bijdraagt aan pitches, klantpresentaties en overtuigende voorstellen.

  • Ervaring hebt met strategische analyses, markt- en concurrentieonderzoek en het ontwikkelen van businesscases.

  • Een stevige gesprekspartner bent voor klanten en gemakkelijk schakelt met stakeholders op management- en directieniveau.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands spreekt.

Over Framna

Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.

Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega's aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.

Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.500 - €6.300 afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Pensioenbijdrage van 67% vanuit Framna.

  • 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Een Macbook en telefoon in bruikleen.

  • Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.
