title: Client Service Associate
description:
Part-Time Client Service Associate

Location: Woodbury, Minnesota (In-office, Mon-Fri)
Pay Range: $50,000-$65,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Part-Time (approx. 25/hours per week), In Person; Monday–Friday, 9 AM–2 PM or 10 AM–3 PM.

**Full-time schedule will be considered for an exceptional candidate.

Hiring Firm: GFC Planning


Join Our Team at GFC Planning - GFC Planning is an independent advisory firm based in Woodbury, Minnesota, dedicated to helping clients transform financial complexity into clarity and confidence. “GFC” stands for God, Family, and Community, a quiet reflection of the firm’s foundational purpose and the values that guide how we serve our clients and one another. We believe in delivering high-quality work, doing the right thing, treating everyone with respect, and giving generously where we can.


Position Overview - GFC Planning is seeking a Part-Time Client Service Associate who enjoys helping clients and making a business run better. Most of your work will be hands-on client service: onboarding families, handling account requests, coordinating meetings, and following through on commitments. You will also own improvements to the processes and systems that support that work as the firm grows.


This position is offered on a flexible part-time schedule of approximately 25 hours per week, and full-time employment will be considered for an exceptional candidate.


You should be comfortable taking a desired outcome or an operational problem, researching options, and developing and implementing a practical solution. Working directly with the founder, you will help build an operation that delivers dependable service and gives advisors more time for clients. This is a hands-on role with responsibility for daily execution and process improvement, and it is well suited to a proactive, process-oriented professional who can independently manage projects and recommend improvements. Curiosity about AI, technology, and workflow automation is highly valued.


Your Role & Responsibilities:


Client Service & Relationship Support

· Serve as a dependable first point of contact for clients, explaining paperwork, account processes, and next steps in plain language

· Resolve routine questions, keep clients informed, and route advice-related questions to the appropriate advisor

· Own client onboarding from the advisor handoff through completion, including paperwork, signatures, account opening, transfers, and funding

· Verify account details, beneficiaries, bank links, and access settings, resolve processing issues, and provide weekly progress updates during onboarding

· Communicate with clients, advisors, custodians, and internal team members with discretion and a client-first mindset

· Resolve routine service items independently while escalating complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate team member


Account Maintenance & Operational Coordination

· Process money movement, transfers, distributions, beneficiary updates, address changes, and other service requests accurately and promptly

· Coordinate with Fidelity, Sanctuary, and other providers, following required approvals, verification, and documentation procedures

· Track pending items, outstanding documents, custodial requests, and operational follow-up across client workflows

· Keep Wealthbox, electronic files, client information, task updates, and compliance documentation accurate and organized

· Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, reduce errors, and keep service items moving forward efficiently


Advisor & Practice Support

· Partner with advisors and client service team members to support client meetings, service requests, and day-to-day practice needs

· Manage scheduling, confirmations, reminders, and logistics for client meetings; gather and organize client documents, update planning records, and prepare requested reports

· Review meeting notes, prepare recaps, and assign and track actions, keeping each open item tied to an owner, a next step, and a follow-up date until resolved

· Track clients due for annual strategy sessions, honor recorded follow-up dates, and clarify uncertain instructions with the advisor

· Support phone coverage, correspondence, and routine office needs while protecting confidential information

· Participate in special projects, team initiatives, process improvements, and practice-wide client service efforts as assigned


Process Improvement, Projects & Technology

· Identify recurring errors, duplicate work, weak handoffs, and unnecessary advisor involvement; research the cause, recommend priorities, and implement improvements within agreed authority rather than simply replicating current processes

· Independently manage projects and process initiatives from planning through completion, keeping advisors informed of progress and next steps

· Build and maintain practical workflows, SOPs, checklists, filing standards, and CRM practices; test changes, help the team adopt them, and verify that they reduce errors or save time

· Help document and standardize planning and investment processes with the founder and associate advisor, including preparation standards, handoffs, and task tracking; advisors retain responsibility for analysis, recommendations, and investment decisions

· Explore and adopt technology, AI tools, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and the client experience

description:
ion

At Wolfspeed, we do amazing things in a human way.

We know that the achievements of our organization are due to the passion, hard work and creativity of our employees. We celebrate different perspectives to foster excellence across our organization, and our goal is to make diversity a foundation of what we do. We are proudly building an environment where you can bring your authentic self to work.

  • Enjoy doing things that people say can’t be done? Innovation is at the center of everything we do.
  • Hate red tape? We remove roadblocks instead of creating them.
  • Student? We offer continuing education assistance.
  • Looking for community? There are many ways to get involved, from Employee Resource Groups to local outreach.

Here’s the Gist:


This position will be a part of the Wolfspeed Facilities Project Management group primarily overseeing projects at Wolfspeed’s Durham campus. Depending on business needs, management of projects at other Wolfspeed sites may be required. To be successful, this position requires:

  • High level of collaboration with various consultants, Wolfspeed employees, and contractor personnel.
  • Responsibility for planning, developing, establishing and controlling methods and procedures for construction to increase overall effectiveness of Wolfspeed, facilities.
  • This individual shall complete their duties in full support of the Wolfspeed brand, understanding that the positive and effective execution of these duties is instrumental to Wolfspeed’s culture and workplace environment.

The Day-to-Day:


As the Manager of Facilities Project Management North Carolina Sites, this position will be the manager of Base Build Facilities Project Management team for all North Carolina sites. This role reports to the Director of Facilities Project Management, and will be responsible for managing the existing team, future hires and headcount, and will also be integral into key projects occasionally performing traditional project management activities. Some key responsibilities include:

  • Management of yearly maintenance site shutdown activities
  • AOP/LRP development for respective sites
  • Manage vendor and subcontractor procurement/ selection, conflict resolution, bidding, budgeting and the development of customer relationships.
  • Deliver project controls information, including information reporting, change order management, and process management are applied in day-to-day operations.
  • Develop Project Management guidebook
  • When required, perform traditional project management skills for projects.

Strong communication skills to all stakeholders and operating with a sense of urgency is a key success factor for this position. Project Managers are responsible for managing the entire construction process from pre-construction through to project close out, ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget. Project sizes will range from several hundred dollars to several million dollars.


  • This Job is Right for You if You Have (Minimum Requirements):
  • Can to travel up to 5% of the time
  • Have worked in the Project Management and/or construction industry for a minimum of 5 years
  • Can review and interpret construction plans and specifications
  • Experience with MS Project

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or Architecture or related field
  • Experience with Procore, SAP
  • Project experience with higher end, high visibility interior fit-ups
  • LEED accreditation or WELL building certification a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of architectural design detailing and building material characteristics
  • Broad understanding of industry standards and building codes

title: Starszy Programista Python (k/m)
description:
• 15000–19000 PLN brutto / miesięcznie (umowa o pracę)
  • 21000–27000 PLN netto (+ VAT) / miesięcznie (kontrakt B2B)

Technologie, których używamy

Wymagane

  • Python
  • Docker
  • AWS

O projekcie

Szukamy doświadczonej osoby na stanowisko Starszego Programisty Python (senior), która przejmie odpowiedzialność techniczną za nasze produkty do uwierzytelniania sieciowego i pomoże zaprojektować ich kolejną generację.

Czym będziesz się zajmować

Będziesz prowadzić rozwój dwóch produktów Rublon, które wnoszą MFA i monitoring bezpieczeństwa do sieci firmowych:

Rublon Authentication Proxy: serwer proxy RADIUS i LDAP, który dodaje MFA do VPN-ów, firewalli i każdej innej usługi obsługującej uwierzytelnianie RADIUS lub LDAP. Współpracuje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i istniejącymi serwerami RADIUS, działa na Linuksie i Windows Server.

Rublon Log Sync: usługa, która na bieżąco eksportuje logi audytowe, logi uwierzytelniania i logi aktywności z Rublon MFA do systemów SIEM w formacie JSON lub CEF.

Oba produkty już dziś obsługują w środowiskach klientów ruch krytyczny dla bezpieczeństwa. Ich kolejna generacja musi być szybka, bezpieczna i łatwa w utrzymaniu w dużej skali, zarówno w sieciach klientów, jak i w chmurze. Pomożesz nam to osiągnąć: będziesz kształtować architekturę, wybierać właściwą technologię dla każdego komponentu i prowadzić prace. Dziś używamy głównie Pythona, a część nowych komponentów może powstać w Go lub Rust.

Liczy się dla nas Twoje doświadczenie. Szukamy osoby, która wniesie do zespołu coś nowego: wiedzę z budowania usług sieciowych lub produktów SaaS w dużej skali, sprawdzone praktyki i własne pomysły na to, jak budować bezpieczne systemy, które łatwo utrzymać.

Pracujemy w modelu AI-assisted development i Agentic Engineering. Narzędzia takie jak Claude Code są u nas standardowym narzędziem pracy: wykorzystujemy je do planowania, implementacji, testów, code review i dokumentacji, przy zachowaniu pełnej odpowiedzialności za jakość, bezpieczeństwo i poprawność kodu.

To stanowisko czysto backendowe. Doświadczenie we frontendzie nie jest wymagane.

Tak organizujemy naszą pracę

Liczba osób w zespole

15

Tak pracujemy

  • wewnątrz organizacji
  • koncentrujesz się na jednym projekcie
  • masz wpływ na wybór narzędzi i technologii
  • masz wpływ na rozwiązania technologiczne
  • masz wpływ na produkt
  • koncentrujesz się na rozwoju produktu

Skład zespołu

  • backend developer
  • fullstack developer
  • mobile developer
  • lider techniczny
  • architekt
  • devOps
  • specjalista cyberbezpieczeństwa
  • support
  • product owner
  • UI designer
  • UX designer
  • analityk systemowy
  • administrator IT

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • odpowiadać technicznie za Rublon Authentication Proxy i Rublon Log Sync: architekturę, jakość kodu i wydania,
  • projektować i implementować funkcje protokołów RADIUS i LDAP, takie jak tryby uwierzytelniania, przekazywanie żądań (proxying) i RadSec,
  • projektować usługi, które skalują się horyzontalnie i pozostają wysoko dostępne przy dużym ruchu uwierzytelniania,
  • wybierać właściwą technologię dla każdego komponentu, w tym decydować, kiedy użyć Pythona, Go lub Rust, i prowadzić migrację tam, gdzie ma to sens,
  • prowadzić integracje z Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Google Secure LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID i innymi serwerami RADIUS,
  • projektować niezawodne dostarczanie logów do systemów SIEM, z checkpointami, ponawianiem prób i jasnymi gwarancjami dostarczenia,
  • oceniać bezpieczeństwo obsługi protokołów i przygotowywać modele zagrożeń dla nowych funkcji, w tym ochronę przed atakami takimi jak Blast-RADIUS,
  • profilować i poprawiać wydajność, współbieżność i zużycie zasobów,
  • ustalać standardy observability: logowanie strukturalne, metryki, tracing i diagnostykę,
  • kształtować proces budowania, pakowania i wydawania wersji dla Linuksa, Windows Server i kontenerów,
  • ustalać standardy pracy z AI coding agents (np. Claude Code) w zespole i budować automatyzacje, np. pliki CLAUDE.md, własne komendy czy automatyczny code review,
  • prowadzić code review i mentorować młodszych programistów,
  • współpracować z product managerami, QA, supportem i specjalistami cybersecurity przy rozwoju produktu.

Nasze wymagania

  • minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu backendu, w tym minimum 3 lata w Pythonie,
  • doświadczenie w budowaniu i utrzymywaniu usług sieciowych na produkcji,
  • bardzo dobrą znajomość RADIUS, w tym przekazywania żądań (proxying), atrybutu Message-Authenticator i typowych ataków na ten protokół, oraz dobrą znajomość LDAP,
  • bardzo dobrą znajomość TLS, mTLS i certyfikatów x.509,
  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu usług, które skalują się horyzontalnie i pozostają wysoko dostępne,
  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu usług współdzielonych przez wielu klientów, np. wielodostępnych (multi-tenant) aplikacji SaaS,
  • doświadczenie ze współbieżnością i profilowaniem wydajności,
  • doświadczenie z Dockerem i infrastrukturą chmurową, najlepiej AWS,
  • doświadczenie z secure coding i modelowaniem zagrożeń dla oprogramowania sieciowego,
  • duże praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu oprogramowania z wykorzystaniem narzędzi AI, np. Claude Code, w tym budowaniu własnych workflow,
  • doświadczenie w podejmowaniu kluczowych decyzji technicznych i jasnym ich uzasadnianiu,
  • doświadczenie w mentoringu i prowadzeniu code review,
  • płynną znajomość języka polskiego (C1),
  • znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalającą czytać dokumentację techniczną i RFC (B1; płynny angielski nie jest wymagany).

Mile widziane

  • Go lub Rust w produkcyjnych usługach sieciowych,
  • RadSec, metody EAP i 802.1X,
  • PKI, cykl życia certyfikatów i uwierzytelnianie oparte na certyfikatach,
  • FreeRADIUS, Microsoft NPS lub inne serwery RADIUS,
  • Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph API,
  • platformy SIEM, np. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, Graylog lub Wazuh,
  • Kubernetes i infrastruktura jako kod (np. Terraform),
  • monitoring, metryki i tracing (np. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry),
  • usługi i instalatory dla Windows Server,
  • bramy VPN, firewalle i inne urządzenia sieciowe,
  • certyfikaty AWS lub z obszaru bezpieczeństwa,
  • formalne wykształcenie informatyczne, cybersecurity lub pokrewne, albo równoważne doświadczenie praktyczne.

Tak pracujemy nad projektem

  • code review
  • Continuous Deployment
  • Continuous Integration
  • deployment na poziomie zespołu
  • DevOps
  • wsparcie architekta / lidera technicznego
  • dokumentacja
  • narzędzia do trackowania zadań
  • automatyzacja testów
  • pentesty
  • środowiska testowe
  • testy funkcjonalne
  • testy integracyjne
  • testy jednostkowe
  • testy wydajnościowe
  • testy manualne

Takie dajemy możliwości rozwoju

  • branżowe platformy e-learningowe
  • przestrzeń do eksperymentowania
  • szkolenia wewnątrzfirmowe
  • wsparcie merytoryczne od liderów technologicznych
  • wymiana wiedzy technicznej w firmie

Benefity

  • prywatna opieka medyczna
  • możliwość pracy zdalnej
  • elastyczny czas pracy
  • spotkania integracyjne
  • brak dress code’u
  • kawa / herbata

Etapy rekrutacji

  • rozmowa online z rekruterem
  • realizacja testu online
  • rozmowa finalna

Jak będziesz pracować

  • Lokalizacja: praca w pełni stacjonarna w biurze w Krakowie lub w Zielonej Górze (umowa o pracę) lub praca w 100% zdalna z dowolnego miejsca w Polsce (B2B)
  • Obszary technologiczne: Python 3, RADIUS, RadSec, LDAP i LDAPS, TLS i mTLS, certyfikaty x.509, Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, Microsoft Entra ID i Microsoft Graph, Linux (systemd), Windows Server, Inno Setup, CEF, syslog i JSON, integracje z SIEM, GitHub CI/CD, AI coding agents (np. Claude Code)
  • Język: polski w codziennej pracy zespołu
  • Rozwój: dostęp do kursów online i możliwość dofinansowania certyfikacji
  • Benefity: prywatna opieka medyczna i karta MultiSport

Dlaczego warto aplikować? Ta rola może być dla Ciebie dobrym wyborem, jeśli:

  • chcesz mieć realny wpływ na produkty bezpieczeństwa, które chronią dostęp do sieci u klientów w ponad 60 krajach,
  • chcesz kształtować architekturę i wybierać technologie, a nie tylko realizować zadania,
  • budujesz lub budowałeś(-aś) usługi sieciowe albo produkty SaaS w dużej skali i chcesz wykorzystać to doświadczenie w zespole, który go potrzebuje,
  • lubisz pracę blisko protokołów, takich jak RADIUS, LDAP, TLS i syslog,
  • chcesz dziś pracować w Pythonie, a nowe komponenty tworzyć w Go lub Rust,
  • wykorzystujesz AI coding agents na co dzień i chcesz pracować w zespole, który traktuje je jako standardowe narzędzie,
  • wolisz backend i nie szukasz roli skupionej na frontendzie,
  • cenisz secure coding, automatyzację, observability i długoterminową utrzymywalność kodu.

RUBLON sp. z o.o.

Dołącz do Rublon i pracuj z zespołem pasjonatów cyberbezpieczeństwa, który rozwija przyszłość uwierzytelniania użytkowników w środowiskach enterprise.

Rublon MFA to platforma multi-factor authentication używana przez klientów w ponad 60 krajach do ochrony logowania pracowników do sieci, serwerów i aplikacji. Oprócz usług chmurowych tworzymy komponenty, które działają w sieciach naszych klientów i łączą Rublon MFA z VPN-ami, firewallami, katalogami użytkowników i systemami bezpieczeństwa.

Monday to Friday 10:30am to 7pm

title: Flight & Ambulance Services Operations Control Specialist
description:
Job Description:

The Operations Control Specialist oversees the execution of flight operations by exercising operational control in line with Federal Aviation Administration, (FAA) Part 135 requirements. It monitors flights, ensures regulatory compliance, communicates with flight crews, and documents operational decisions. This position provides critical support and guidance and ensures safe and compliant flight operations while effectively coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Essential Functions


  • Monitors active flights to ensure safe and compliant operations in accordance with FAA Part 135 regulations and company policies.
  • Exercises operational control, including the authority to initiate, continue, divert, or terminate flights as necessary.
  • Maintains real-time communication with flight crews, dispatchers, maintenance personnel, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated operations.
  • Continuously assesses weather conditions and update flight crews on potential hazards or necessary deviations from planned routes.
  • Reviews flight plans, weight and balance calculations, and other critical documentation to verify compliance and accuracy.
  • Maintains accurate and thorough records of all operational control decisions, flight activities, crew assignments, and deviations.
  • Assists in emergency response coordination, including activation of emergency protocols and communication with relevant agencies.
  • Conducts post-flight reviews to ensure documentation is complete and accurate
  • Participates in training, evaluations, and ongoing professional development to maintain operational control proficiency.
  • Stays current with changes in FAA regulations, company procedures, and industry best practices to ensure compliance.

Skills


  • Regulatory compliance
  • Communication
  • Organizational skills
  • Problem-solving
  • Decision-making
  • Time management
  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability
  • Operational oversight

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in an aviation, military aircraft operations, or dispatch center related field (e.g. pilot license, flight dispatcher, aviation communications specialist, 911 dispatch, Air Traffic Control, etc.)
  • Intermediate computer proficiency
  • Excellent communications skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two years’ experience in an aviation, military aircraft operations, or dispatch center related field (e.g. pilot license, flight dispatcher, aviation communications specialist, 911 dispatch, Air Traffic Control, etc.)
  • Helicopter Air Ambulance Pilot experience
  • Demonstrated knowledge of FAA Part 135 regulations and operational control responsibilities
  • Previous experience in an Operational Control Center (OCC) or Part 135 environment
  • Demonstrated familiarity with flight tracking and communication systems (e.g., Flight Vector, ADS-B, etc.)
  • Additional certifications in aviation safety or operations management
  • Experience working with emergency response procedures and safety management systems (SMS)

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
  • Frequent interactions with providers, colleagues, customers, patients/clients and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate supplies and equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use for typing, accessing needed information, etc.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods while monitoring flight operations and communicating with crews
  • Capability to work in a high-stress environment and make critical decisions in real-time
  • Must be able to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds, such as moving records or training materials

title: IT Infrastructure Administrator
description:
About Us

We are a collective of HVAC design and implementation experts. As recognized industry leaders, we combine our craft with care for spaces that matter most: healthcare, commercial, institutional, and mission critical. Our nationwide reach gives you flexible solutions for any market or project—delivering the expertise and resources to support your work at every scale. We believe in working with the best products, partners and people and hope you’ll join us!


Job Description

Position Overview


The IT Infrastructure Manager will be responsible for managing Azure and hybrid infrastructure, supporting regional IT operations, and leading technology integrations for newly acquired companies. This hands-on role works closely with the infrastructure and security teams, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and external vendors to maintain secure, reliable, and efficient IT systems.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, identity management, and automation, along with the ability to independently manage projects and troubleshoot complex issues.


This position reports to the Senior IT Infrastructure Manager and does not have direct reports.


Key Responsibilities


Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Manage, maintain, and optimize Microsoft Azure and on-premises infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, applications, and backups.
  • Establish and maintain Azure standards for security, performance, reliability, and cost management.
  • Support Azure-hosted applications, virtual desktops, and infrastructure migrations.
  • Oversee backup and disaster recovery planning, testing, and improvements.
  • Monitor Azure spending and identify opportunities for optimization.

Identity & Access Management

  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including user accounts, permissions, and authentication.
  • Manage automated user provisioning and updates through Workday.
  • Implement single sign-on (SSO) and automated account provisioning for business applications.
  • Support Microsoft 365 access, SharePoint permissions, and cross-location collaboration.

Acquisition Integration

  • Participate in IT due diligence and assess infrastructure, systems, and security for potential acquisitions.
  • Lead technology integration for assigned acquired companies, including site assessments, Microsoft 365 migrations, and device cutovers.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, outgoing IT providers, and vendors to ensure successful transitions.
  • Provide on-site support during migrations and go-live activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve and standardize acquisition integration processes.

Regional IT Support & Endpoint Management

  • Oversee IT infrastructure and support for assigned regional locations, including networking, office moves, and site buildouts.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues involving systems, applications, devices, and networks.
  • Manage Windows devices using Microsoft Intune and NinjaOne, including deployment, software updates, and maintenance.
  • Coordinate hardware purchasing, equipment standards, inventory, and returns with vendors and equipment providers.
  • Partner with MSPs and help desk teams to maintain service quality and resolve issues.

Automation, Security & Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate onboarding, offboarding, device management, and routine IT tasks.
  • Maintain IT service workflows through Jira Service Management.
  • Implement infrastructure security requirements in partnership with the Security team.

title: Clinical Diet Technician PRN
description:
Job Description:

The Clinical Diet Tech provides nutrition care and support to patients under the supervision of the Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) in the clinical setting. This position interacts with clinical staff, patients, and family members to collect, analyze, and document patient nutrition information. The Clinical Diet Tech partners with the Registered Dietitian Nutritionist to help create and implement appropriate nutrition care plans.

Posting Specifics

Pay Rate: Based on Experience

Shift Details: PRN: This is a PRN position with no guaranteed hours; however, we anticipate approximately 2–4 shifts per week supporting our Newborn ICU (NICU) Diet Tech role. Shifts are typically scheduled for four hours, with some flexibility based on patient care needs.

The NICU Diet Tech role is staffed daily, Sunday through Saturday, from 4:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m., with shifts alternating between in-person and remote work. Scheduling is shared among the Clinical Diet Tech team, who work collaboratively to build the schedule. Weekend and holiday coverage is distributed equally across the team.

Additional Details: The clinical diet tech team works closely with the inpatient dietitian team. A home computer workstation will be provided to fulfill remote NICU tech shifts.

We are looking for motivated, compassionate, and detail-oriented candidates who enjoy collaborating with a highly committed team. Strong communication skills are essential, as this role involves regular interaction with Diet Techs and Dietitians, both in person and through Microsoft Teams.

Candidates should also be comfortable using technology and learning new systems. Strong computer skills are important, as team members will be trained on our electronic medical record system and regularly use Excel, Microsoft Teams, and other applications to support their daily work.


Essential Functions

  • Collects nutrition screening information and manages nutrition tasks for techs and dietitians.
  • Completes nutrition data gathering and analysis.
  • Performs calorie counts.
  • Documents patient information in the electronic health record as established by protocol.
  • Interacts and problem solves with clinical and non-clinical staff.
  • Provides patient and the community with nutrition care and education, under the direction of RDN.
  • Performs various functions in the NICU under the direction of RDN.
  • Participates in department continuous quality improvement projects.
  • Provides exceptional customer service in all customer interactions.
  • Completes business functions as established by department.

  • Experience using word processing, spreadsheet, internet and e-mail applications.
  • Demonstrated advanced math skills.
  • Experience transcribing information quickly and accurately.
  • Experience in a healthcare setting or completion of nutrition-related college level course work, preferred.

Physical Requirements

title: Spanish Medical Interpreter Nights
description:
Job Description:

Coordinates and delivers both interpretation (oral) and translation (written) services for individuals with limited English proficiency across all Intermountain Health facilities and virtual services.



Please Read Before Applying

This position requires professional medical interpreter qualifications in addition to bilingual fluency. Being bilingual in English and Spanish alone does not qualify an applicant for this role.


Qualified applicants must meet at least one of the following:

  • 40-hour Professional Medical Interpreter course completion
  • 2+ years of professional interpreting experience
  • Degree in Spanish, Translation, Interpretation, or related field
  • Interpreter certification in another discipline (i.e. court, etc.)


Applications from candidates who do not meet one of the requirements above are unlikely to advance in the hiring process. Professional medical interpretation requires specialized training, knowledge of medical terminology, confidentiality standards, and interpreter ethics.


Application Requirements

We want to give every candidate the best possible consideration. Your resume is required. Please make sure your resume clearly reflects your interpreting experience, employment history, and any relevant certifications that support your qualifications.


Schedule and Shift

This is a part time 24-hour per week night position at Intermountain Medical Center in Murray, Utah. This is an on-site/in-person position.


The schedule for this position is Thursday and Friday, 6:30PM - 6:30AM.


Essential Functions

  • Interpret medical and general information with the highest degree of accuracy and completeness in consecutive, simultaneous and sight translation modes for patients, families, and Intermountain Health staff, using appropriate communication methods according to the individual’s developmental age and mental condition.
  • Interpret complex medical information, demonstrating expert knowledge of medical terminology and the healthcare system.
  • Acts as a cultural mediator, demonstrating cultural sensitivity and superior intercultural communication skills. Renders unbiased interpretation to ensure accurate exchange of information in the proper cultural context.
  • Adheres to the National Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice for Healthcare Interpreters, demonstrating knowledge of HIPAA, Title VI of the Civil Rights Act, Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act, and Section 1557 of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.
  • Manages time productively, displaying a proactive approach to the job. Responds to requests in a timely manner and provides staff with an estimated time of arrival for interpretation assignments. Refers staff to phone or video interpretation per guidelines.
  • Use computer, software, and electronic tools for research, data entry and other communication purposes within the work environment. Maintains accurate and complete records of all interpretation events. Ensures data across multiple platforms or sources is consistent and accurate.
  • Translates written material into one of more languages, ensuring meaning, context, and localization are maintained. Completes assignments in a timely manner and with a high degree of accuracy.

Skills

  • Professional ethics and communication
  • Basic computer and data entry skills
  • Collaboration/Teamwork
  • Time Management
  • Critical thinking
  • Situational awareness
  • Medical Terminology
  • Cultural Communications
  • Medical Knowledge
  • Language Interpretation and Translation

Posting Specifics

  • Pay Range: $22.98 - $35.00. Pay is determined based on direct professional interpreting experience.
  • Benefits Eligible: Yes
  • Shift Details: Part Time - 24 hours per week
  • Location: Intermountain Medical Center in Murray, Utah (on-site)

Required Qualifications

  • Certificate of completion from a 40-hr Professional Medical Interpreter course
  • Successful completion of a pre-hire skills assessment.
  • Excellent oral and written command of both source and target language(s) as to obtain a “Professional Proficiency” or Level 3 in the ILR scale (or equivalent as approved by Manager), including specialized healthcare terminology.
  • Performs consecutive, simultaneous and Sight Translation with a high degree of accuracy in both languages.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and multi-task.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal verbal and written communication skills to function as part of a team and the flexibility and good judgement to work independently.

For candidates who do not meet the 40-hr Professional Medical Interpreter course requirement: You may be considered if you meet one of the following qualifications (If hired, you will need to complete the 40-hr. course on your own within six months):


  • Hold an interpreting certification in a different field (e.g., court)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two years of experience working as an interpreter in healthcare settings.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Interpretation or Translation, Languages or Communications.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Most GenAI roles ask you to wrap a public API around a chat interface and hope for the best. At Thales UK, you’ll be tackling a much harder—and far more interesting—engineering problem: how to make autonomous AI agents safe, deterministic, and trustworthy inside regulated, high-security, and mission-critical environments.


Working at the heart of Thales UK’s AI capability alongside cortAIx Factory, you will architect and ship production multi-agent systems that reason, plan, retrieve verified intelligence, and execute controlled actions across complex enterprise and engineering workflows. You won't just build individual agents—you will help define the platform, standards, and reusable capability catalogue for how Thales deploys agentic AI at scale.


Location: Crawley / Bristol / Reading / Glasgow / Belfast / Cheadle (Hybrid)


What You’ll Actually Be Building

  • Production Multi-Agent Workflows: Design and deploy stateful, tool-using agents (using frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel) that handle complex planning, memory, structured outputs, and graceful fallbacks—far beyond the PoC stage.
  • Zero-Trust Tooling & Interoperability: Architect secure orchestration layers and API contracts using emerging standards like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent patterns, enforcing identity-aware access and least-privilege execution.
  • High-Assurance Knowledge Pipelines: Build robust RAG and GraphRAG pipelines with strict metadata filtering, document provenance, and permission-aware retrieval across complex technical datasets.
  • Sovereign & Constrained Model Deployment: Select, optimize, and serve models based on strict latency, cost, and data-sovereignty constraints—including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped environments.
  • Adversarial Defense & AI Security: Engineer guardrails against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and excessive agency. Lead threat modeling, red-teaming, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates so autonomy stays bounded.
  • True LLMOps & Evaluation: Replace "vibe checks" with automated regression testing, golden evaluation datasets, distributed tracing, observability, and strict prompt/model release controls.

What You Bring to the Table

We care more about production engineering rigor than hype. You’ll thrive here if you have:

  • Strong Software Engineering Roots: Deep fluency in Python, API design (REST/gRPC), automated testing, secure coding, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-On Agentic Experience: Proven track record taking LLM/agentic applications from discovery into live production—managing state, memory, retries, and non-deterministic failure modes.
  • Deep Retrieval & Context Engineering: Practical command of embeddings, vector and knowledge graph stores, hybrid search, and data governance.
  • Evaluation & Observability Mindset: Experience measuring and debugging agent behavior in production using tracing, telemetry, and automated/human eval frameworks.
  • Security-First Instincts: A solid grasp of IAM, secrets management, sandboxing, supply-chain security, and Responsible AI principles (explainability, robustness, safety assurance).

Bonus Points For:

  • Deploying open-weights models in sovereign, classified, edge, or resource-constrained environments.
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, critical national infrastructure, FinTech, or other heavily regulated engineering domains.
  • Acting as a technical authority, defining reference architectures, or contributing to open-source AI tooling/standards.

Why Thales UK?

  • High-Stakes Engineering: Your work directly impacts aerospace, defense, space, and critical national infrastructure—solving real operational problems rather than chasing vanity metrics.
  • Access to cortAIx: Collaborate directly with Thales’s dedicated AI research and accelerator ecosystem, bridging cutting-edge R&D with hardened enterprise engineering.
  • Shape the Blueprint: Join early enough in our agentic capability build-out to influence our core architecture, tech stack, and engineering standards from the ground up.

Qualifications: Degree/Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field—or equivalent hands-on engineering track record.


Benefits

  • Performance-related bonus
  • Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
  • 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
  • 24 hours volunteering paid for
  • Private healthcare
  • Pension scheme
  • Life cover
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
  • Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
  • Gym membership discounts

Security Clearance Requirement

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

title: UM/UIM Claims Specialist
description:
MSIG USA continues to grow!

Company Overview:

MSIG USA is the US-based subsidiary of MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s top P&C carriers and a global Class 15 insurer, with A+ ratings and a reach that spans 40+ countries and regions. Leveraging our 350-year heritage, MSIG USA brings the financial strength, expertise, and global footprint to offer commercial insurance solutions that address your business’s unique risks.

Summary/Job Purpose:
The UM/UIM Claims Specialist manages complex first-party uninsured and underinsured motorist claims from initial assignment through resolution. The role analyzes commercial auto policy language and state-specific requirements; investigates coverage, liability, damages, and available insurance; evaluates bodily injury exposures; establishes reserves; and negotiates represented and unrepresented claims within assigned authority. The specialist also manages litigation, contractual arbitration, defense counsel, experts, recovery opportunities, fraud referrals, and regulatory compliance while maintaining timely, accurate, and defensible claim documentation and professional communication with insureds, claimants, attorneys, brokers, and internal partners.


Essential Functions:


  • Review commercial auto policies, endorsements, limits, priority-of-coverage issues, stacking or anti-stacking provisions, offsets, consent-to-settle requirements, notice requirements, and state-specific UM/UIM statutes and case law; identify coverage issues promptly and prepare or coordinate required coverage correspondence.
  • Conduct timely investigations of the underlying accident, tortfeasor liability, comparative negligence, damages, available liability insurance, exhaustion or tender status, other insurance, and potential recovery rights; obtain statements, police reports, photographs, medical records, wage documentation, expert reports, and other relevant evidence.
  • Evaluate bodily injury damages, causation, treatment, permanency, wage loss, future damages, liens, and applicable offsets; establish and update reserves based on exposure and document evaluation rationale.
  • Develop resolution strategies; negotiate represented and unrepresented claims within authority; prepare settlement evaluations and authority requests; issue accurate payments and releases; and use mediation, arbitration, or other dispute-resolution processes when appropriate.
  • Manage litigated UM/UIM claims and contractual arbitration matters; select and direct defense counsel and experts; review pleadings, discovery, budgets, reports, and legal strategy; attend mediations, arbitrations, depositions, and trials as needed; and escalate significant coverage or severity issues.
  • Preserve subrogation rights, evaluate liens and credits, coordinate recovery activity, identify fraud indicators, and make timely SIU referrals; comply with fair claims practices, state regulations, licensing requirements, company procedures, and reporting expectations.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with insureds, claimants, attorneys, brokers, underwriters, counsel, medical providers, and internal partners; maintain timely diaries and complete, defensible electronic claim documentation.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education and Experience Required:

  • High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of commercial casualty claims experience required.
  • 3+ years of direct UM/UIM including complex auto liability. Litigation experience strongly preferred.

Other Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Active adjuster license or ability to obtain one within 90 days of hire, plus additional state licenses as required.
  • AIC, CPCU, SCLA, or similar claims designation preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of first-party UM/UIM coverage, state-specific statutory requirements, bodily injury evaluation, negotiation, and litigation management.
  • Ability to interpret policy language, endorsements, statutes, regulations, and case law and to prepare clear coverage analyses, claim notes, settlement evaluations, and professional correspondence.
  • Experience using a modern claims administration system, legal bill review tools, vendor portals, and Microsoft 365, including Excel.
  • Ability to evaluate medical documentation, wage-loss claims, liens, future damages, and complex bodily injury exposures.
  • Strong negotiation, critical-thinking, organization, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume inventory, meet diary and regulatory deadlines, and work independently within delegated authority.
  • Familiarity with ISO ClaimSearch, NICB, SIU referral practices, inter-company arbitration, and subrogation preservation.

#LI-HYBRID #LI-REMOTE

description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Job Title: Technical Lead, Intelligent Automation

Location:

Get To Know Us:

SS&C is leading the way. We continue to look for todays and tomorrow’s brightest talent, those that embody a spirit to improve not only their lives, but those around them. From college students to seasoned and experienced professionals, we encourage you to apply. SS&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals, who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation to name a few.

Why You Will Love It Here!

  • Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
  • Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS&C University
  • Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme
  • Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
  • Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career

What You Will Get To Do:

About the role

We are further expanding our automation programme across our business process outsourcing (BPO) operations, where large teams run high-volume, regulated processes for financial services clients. This new team is to support our strategic process reviews which specifically looks at large global areas of manual process and re-invents the process from front to back .You will lead the technical side of that programme: choosing where AI and agentic systems can safely take on work, designing how they run, and building them with a small engineering team.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write code, review code and set the engineering standard, while working with the SPR team to decide what gets automated and how it is controlled.

What you will do

  • Own the technical architecture for the automation programme: agent runtimes, orchestration, integration with core platforms, data access and observability.
  • Design and build agentic workflows using large language models, tool use, retrieval and structured outputs, with humans in the loop where judgement or regulation requires it.
  • Work with the SPR team to find, size and prioritise automation opportunities, and turn them into a delivery roadmap with measurable outcomes (hours saved, error rates, turnaround times).
  • Define evaluation, testing and monitoring for AI components so behaviour is measurable, auditable and safe to run in production.
  • Set engineering standards: code review, CI/CD, security, model and prompt versioning, cost tracking.
  • Lead, mentor and grow engineers on the team, starting with the Automation Software Engineer and Process Analyst.

What You Will Bring:

  • Strong software and systems engineering background: you have designed, built and run production systems, and can write high-quality code yourself (Python and/or TypeScript; others welcome).
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompting, tool and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and evaluation.
  • Practical experience designing agentic systems: multi-step agents, orchestration, state and memory, failure handling and human escalation.
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g. Model Context Protocol, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or similar), and judgement about when not to use them.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs, messaging, databases and, where needed, legacy platforms.
  • Cloud and platform experience (AWS, Azure or private cloud), including containers, infrastructure as code and observability.
  • A track record of leading technical delivery and influencing senior, non-technical stakeholders.
  • Sound judgement on security, data privacy and operational risk in AI systems.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services operations, fund administration, transfer agency or another regulated BPO setting.
  • Background in RPA or workflow tools (UiPath, Blue Prism, Power Automate) and experience moving beyond them.
  • Document processing and intelligent document understanding at scale.
  • Experience running AI systems under model risk management or similar governance.

What success looks like in the first year

  • A production-grade automation platform with clear patterns for building, testing and monitoring agents.
  • Several automations live in operations with measured, reported benefits.
  • A prioritised pipeline of opportunities agreed with SPR leadership.
  • A small, capable team working to a consistent engineering standard.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.

title: Medical Writer - Patient Education and Health Literacy
description:
Job Description:

The Medical Writer, Patient Education and Health Literacy, researches, writes, edits, designs, and produces clear, accurate, and engaging education materials for patients, families, and caregivers. This enterprise-level role balances clinical accuracy, patient understanding, standards, and production needs to translate complex clinical and scientific information into practical, accessible content. The position consults on health literacy and partners with clinical, operational, communications, and creative stakeholders to promote consistent, patient-centered information across print, digital, and multimedia channels.

The shifts for this position are Monday-Friday from 8am-4pm.

This is a fully remote position, but some travel may be required for function training. We are committed to offering flexible work options where approved and stated in the job posting. However, we are currently not considering candidates who reside or plan to reside in the following states: California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Washington.


Video phone screens and interview(s) through Microsoft Teams will be required as well for fully remote position.

Essential Functions:

Patient Education Writing and Editing

  • Researches, writes, edits, and maintains evidence-based patient education, translating complex clinical and scientific information into clear, concise, actionable content using plain language, health literacy, numeracy, and inclusive communication principles.
  • Adapts and reviews content for diverse audience needs and validates accuracy, clarity, consistency, readability, usability, citations, copyright, and evidence-based recommendations with clinical subject matter experts.

Information Design and Production

  • Designs and produces accessible patient education for print, web, mobile, electronic health record, video, presentation, and other channels using effective typography, layout, color, imagery, tables, charts, and content-driven design.
  • Applies brand, accessibility, style, and production standards; prepares publication-ready files; coordinates with production partners; and performs quality-control reviews to maintain visual and editorial consistency.

Health Literacy Consultation

  • Consults on health literacy, plain language, patient communication, accessibility, readability, information design, audience needs, content organization, terminology, format, and communication channels for enterprise initiatives.
  • Reviews patient-facing communications, recommends user-centered improvements, supports enterprise standards and templates, and may provide education, presentations, coaching, or resources to promote equitable, accessible communication.

Project Management and Collaboration

  • Manages multiple patient education projects from intake through review, design, approval, publication, maintenance, and archival by defining scope, deliverables, plans, timelines, records, version control, and workflow requirements.
  • Builds productive cross-functional relationships, facilitates stakeholder discussions, resolves content and production questions, works independently, and adapts priorities to changing clinical, operational, regulatory, and organizational needs.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Stays current in health literacy, patient education, medical writing, information design, accessibility, multimedia communication, and healthcare technology, and explores new approaches to improve usefulness, engagement, accessibility, and efficiency.
  • Responsibly evaluates emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, for accuracy, privacy, accessibility, usability, bias, workflow fit, and value, and shares lessons learned to improve standards, workflows, templates, and tools.


Skills:

  • Medical writing, editing, and inclusive patient communication.
  • Plain language, health literacy, accessibility, and universal design.
  • Clinical research and synthesis of reliable information.
  • Content organization, graphic design, and visual communication.
  • Professional writing, editing, layout, and design software.
  • Critical thinking, problem-solving, quality assurance, & decision-making.
  • Consultation, collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder management.
  • Project management, prioritization, organization, and independent work.
  • Adaptability, continuous learning, and responsible technology use.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in medical writing, communications, English, journalism, health education, nursing, public health, life sciences, graphic design, visual communication, or a related field. Relevant professional experience may be considered in accordance with organizational policy.
  • At least three years of professional experience in medical writing, health communication, patient education, health literacy, clinical education, or a closely related role.
  • Clinical experience or demonstrated knowledge of healthcare, medical terminology, clinical concepts, and evidence-based information.
  • Demonstrated experience writing and editing patient-facing or public-facing health information and translating complex clinical or scientific information into clear, accurate, inclusive, and actionable content.
  • Strong information design and graphic design skills, including typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and integration of text and images.
  • Proficiency with professional writing, editing, page-layout, and design applications, including Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Cloud applications such as InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat, or comparable tools.
  • Knowledge of health literacy, plain language, readability, accessibility, and user-centered communication principles, or willingness to learn and adopt these principles within six months of employment.
  • Ability to locate, evaluate, synthesize, and cite reliable medical and scientific information; manage competing priorities; work independently; collaborate effectively; and responsibly evaluate new technologies, including artificial intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in health communication, medical writing, public health, health education, nursing, communications, design, or a related discipline.
  • Professional certification or advanced training in medical writing, health literacy, plain language, accessibility, graphic design, or health communication.
  • Clinical licensure or substantial experience in a clinical or healthcare setting, including familiarity with clinical workflows and electronic health record systems such as Epic.
  • Experience developing materials for people with limited health literacy or other communication access needs and incorporating patient, caregiver, or end-user feedback.
  • Experience with multimedia education, photography, illustration, infographics, data visualization, art direction, responsive or mobile content, e-learning, or motion graphics.
  • Experience publishing through electronic health records, content management systems, digital asset management systems, or patient engagement platforms.
  • Experience using generative AI or other emerging technologies within appropriate governance requirements.
  • Experience working in a large, complex, or geographically distributed healthcare organization.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ongoing need for employees to see and read information, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
  • Frequent interactions with providers, colleagues, customers, patients/clients, and visitors that require employees to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use for typing, accessing needed information, etc.
  • May have the same physical requirements as those of clinical or patient care jobs, when the leader takes clinical shifts.
  • For roles requiring driving: Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, and other vehicles.

description:
Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary

Under the direct supervision of a registered pharmacist, properly prepares, labels, packages, distributes, restocks and disposes of medications and pharmaceutical supplies. Manages and processes inventory within the Pyxis Logistics Inventory system. Assists with cycle counts, returns and inventory update maintenance. Fills and maintains Pyxis automated dispensing (ADS) cabinets. Reports and/or addresses all issues such as discrepancies and failed drawers. Answers phone calls and triages calls to a pharmacist for further assistance when required. Utilizes EPIC to respond to messaging and re-dispense patient medications.     • Completed a pharmacy technician cross training program at Grady Health System with recommendation from Grady Health System preceptor

title: Front Line Care Clinician - Richmond, VA
description:
Job Summary

Job Description

Own clinical support activities related to retaining and growing Medline Front Line Care business, including customer support, clinical troubleshooting, trial and implementation support, and clinical solutions execution while collaborating with OneMedline partners.


Objective of the Front Line Care team is to partner with health systems on improving outcomes of main Hospital Acquired Conditions (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI and Fall Prevention).


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Provide clinical subject matter expertise on clinical practice related to safe and effective use of products. Use strong clinical acumen to present and educate on the safe and effective use of Front Line Care products. Objective is to partner with health systems on key quality metrics related to nursing (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI, Fall Prevention).
  • Build and maintain strong account-level relationships with stakeholders involved in clinical decision-making, including but not limited to CNO, ACNO, ICU, key unit leaders, Infection Prevention, WOCN, Quality/Patient Safety, and other relevant clinical stakeholders.
  • Support retention activities in the assigned geography and participate in trials, implementations, and post-implementation support in assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with Front Line Care Specialists to pitch, perform assessments, and implement and maintain clinical solutions.
  • Collaborate in the field with Acute Care, IDN, Front Line Care Strategic Account Managers and Front Line Care Reps, and other partners to bring the right solutions to customer needs and retain and grow business.
  • Lead or attend local trade shows, educational dinners, chapter events or product events as needed.
  • Ensure an appropriate frequency of touchpoints with priority accounts.
  • Perform account activities including in-services, just-in-time education, clinical troubleshooting, bedside audits, trial support, clinical solutions workshops, and protocol reviews with clinical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer expectations, internal resources, clinical evaluations, implementation needs, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in Front Line Care Clinical business reviews.
  • Initiate and facilitate communication and collaboration among relevant internal stakeholders.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS


Experience


  • At least 3 years of clinical experience (patient care, education, or medical sales/support).

Education


  • Per certification requirements.

Certification / Licensure


Position requires at least one of the following certifications or meeting state-specific requirements to practice:


  • RN (Registered Nurse)
  • CCRN (Critical Care Registered Nurse)
  • APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse)
  • VA-BC (Vascular Access Board Certified)
  • CRNI (Certified Registered Nurse of Infusion)
  • CWOCN (Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nursing Certification)
  • CWCN (Certified Wound Care Nurse)
  • WCC (Wound Care Certification)
  • CNOR (Certified Perioperative Nurse)
  • CIC (Certified Infection Control)

title: EMT Event Staff PRN
description:
Job Description:

The Emergency Medical Technician demonstrates critical thinking capabilities in working autonomously and in collaboration with other health care providers in the delivery of care to critically ill patients in diverse and non-traditional settings.

Essential Functions

  • Quickly and efficiently responds to emergency and non-emergency calls.
  • Assesses patients' conditions to determine the nature and extent of their injuries or illnesses.
  • Provides basic life support and administers first aid, CPR, and other basic life support measures.
  • Stabilizes patients at the scene of an emergency and during transport to medical facilities.
  • Safely transports patients to hospitals or other medical facilities.
  • Operates emergency vehicles. Drives ambulances and other emergency vehicles safely and responsibly.
  • Communicates and coordinates with other emergency services as well as family members or staff.
  • Maintains equipment and ensures it is in good working order and properly stocked.
  • Accurately documents the care provided and the patient's condition.
  • Participates in ongoing training and professional development to stay current with medical protocols and procedures.
  • Idaho Base: Community Health Emergency Services (CHEMS): Provides continued or follow-up care that can prevent unnecessary readmissions, or 911 calls from those patients within the community.

Skills

  • Patient Care
  • Medication Knowledge
  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Safe Patient Handling
  • Documentation
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Accountability
  • Professional Etiquette
  • CHEMS
  • Acting as healthcare navigators for patients
  • Transitional care for patients after they are discharged from a hospital stay
  • Vaccinations
  • Medication inventories
  • Resource coordination
  • Basic medical therapeutics

Minimum Qualifications

  • Successful completion of EMT Basic Course
  • Must obtain EMT license in state of operation within 120 days of hire
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers
  • Current valid driver license in good standing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support (PHTLS)
  • EMT National Registry Certification
  • Attendance License (Before start of employment)

Physical Requirements

  • All EMS medical crew members may be subject to certain work conditions while functioning in the full capacity of their position. title: Literacy Specialist 282K
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs—including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access—help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

Extended Day Activity Instructors lead after-school programming for children and teens at New York Edge after-school program sites. The activity instructor will teach or co-lead activities in one of the following areas: STEM, visual art, performing art, literacy, student leadership and character development, sports, health and wellness, business, finance and entrepreneurship, math, media arts, journalism, botany, and urban agriculture, history. The activity instructor has a dual reporting role, supporting the curriculum and instruction department team by designing lesson plans and implementing curricula across New York Edge program sites. They will also support the program director by preparing activity materials and explaining principles, techniques, and safety procedures to student participants. The Literacy Specialist is a multi-site instructional leader who collaborates closely with a team of Site Directors to support front-line staff (Academic Enrichment Coaches and Activity Specialists) in delivering Literacy-based curricula and thematic projects.


Schedule:

Part-Time

Monday – Friday

2:00 pm – 6:00 pm (Days/shifts vary depending on site needs)

This role requires you to be in person.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Build strong relationships with and among students

  • Teach or co-lead daily activities

  • Establish clear objectives for all lessons, units, and projects and communicate those objectives to students.

  • Participate in ongoing professional development activities

  • Prepare materials for daily activities

  • Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet students' needs and interests.

  • Support the coordination of program events

  • Input data and prepare reports

  • Administer pre and post-assessments and evaluations for student activities

QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Demonstrated ability to lead activities with children and teens

  • Creativity

  • Knowledge of state and National Literacy efforts

  • Must have excellent communication, organizational, and time management skills

  • Experience working with children and/or teens

  • Ability to multitask and manage workflow in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with program staff, school personnel, parents

  • Sensitive to social-emotional needs and characteristics of students

  • Self-starter who takes initiative

  • Flexibility, reliability, and sound judgment

  • Other duties as assigned


 REQUIREMENTS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Must be at least 18 years of age

  • College credits and/or degrees are highly preferred

  • Experience working with children strongly preferred

  • Broad knowledge of the principles and practices of current educational trends in Literacy curriculum and experience successfully teaching and instructing youth.

  • May be required to walk up and down stairs.

  • May have to lift or move objects/materials as needed.

  • Work is permitted mostly within a New York City Public School but may be required to interact with community-at-large during trips or events.

Specialists will be required to report to the school building and interact with staff, students, parents, and school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and the Department of Health.

title: Senior Director Revenue Cycle Operations
description:
Job Description:

The Senior Director Revenue Cycle will be responsible for leading the development and implementation of revenue cycle strategies for the organization to optimize financial performance. The successful candidate will possess a combination of specialized technical expertise in the assigned department/s, strategic vision, and leadership skills to drive results. This position coordinates with the other RSC Senior Leadership team to ensure that all operational revenue management functions are aligned and optimized to meet or exceed patient requirements, maximize collections, and minimize cost to collect.

This leader will directly oversee support services, including cash posting, credits, provider enrollment (hospital and professional).

This position can be performed remotely with business travel as-needed. Intermountain Health maintains employment registration in Utah, Idaho, Nevada, Colorado, Montana, and Wyoming. Candidates in other locations may be considered. Currently, we are not hiring remote workers in the following states: CA, CT, HI, IL, MA, MN, NY, PA, RI, VT, and WA. Please note that a video interview through Microsoft Teams will be required as well as potential onsite interviews and meetings.

Job Essentials


  • Develop and implement revenue cycle strategies to improve financial performance.
  • Creates and manages annual operating budget. Conducts return on investment analyses on capital expenditures and identifies various opportunities for savings and revenue growth. Analyzes budget variances while implementing improvement initiatives.
  • Identifies and implements new technology or identifies enhancements to existing technology to drive performance improvement, efficiency and/or to improve the patient experience.
  • Identifies, leads and drives quality and performance improvement initiatives. Leads the team to establish mechanisms to design, measure, maintain, and improve the performance and quality of department/s services. Ensures compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program, safety, environmental and infection control standards. Develops action plans in line with the organization's strategic initiatives and goals.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, Medicare, and Medicaid
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures to improve revenue cycle performance.
  • Acts as champion or business owner of external vendors that provide products and/or services to Revenue Cycle operations; selects and coordinates any third-party vendors within the assigned department/s.
  • Monitor and analyze revenue cycle metrics to identify areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with other senior leaders to develop and implement financial goals and objectives.
  • Manage and develop a team of revenue cycle professionals.

Minimum Qualifications:

Fifteen (15) years of progressive revenue cycle leadership experience.

And

Ability to build strong partnerships across the organization such as Managed Care, Finance, ITDS, operations and clinical leadership to ensure Intermountain Health’s strategies are executed.

And

Ability to lead teams in a large operational/healthcare/financial environment.

And

Comprehensive understanding of hospital and clinic operations, working knowledge of hospital and clinic finance and accounting, including patient accounting principles and operations.

Extensive knowledge of the current healthcare/finance environment and trends, policies, and regulations - keeping current on industry developments.

Advanced knowledge of information systems, vendor contracting, patient accounting processes, including billing, collections, and reimbursement analysis.

Extensive knowledge of facilitating engagement related strategies to create high performing teams, and a work culture aligned with the organization’s mission, vision, and values.

And

Competency in developing efficient and effective solutions to complex business challenges.

Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, verbal and written communication skills.

Reporting to the Regional Technical Services Manager, the Technical Services Manager leads the delivery, support and evolution of mission-critical technologies that enable the safe, reliable and efficient movement of aircraft across Canadian airspace. The role provides operational and technical leadership for a diverse portfolio of systems and services within the region, ensuring high levels of system performance, reliability and regulatory compliance.

The role is accountable for assigned aspects of the lifecycle management of ANS technologies, which may include operational support, maintenance, integration and deployment of new capabilities. Responsibilities include leadership of quality management programs, workforce development, project delivery, facility support activities, and the effective management of human and financial resources.

This role offers the opportunity to lead skilled technical teams, deliver technology strategy through implementation and operational excellence, and play a direct role in supporting one of the world's safest and most complex air navigation systems.

Job Description

What NAV CANADA offers you:

  • Challenging, team-oriented work environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Defined benefit pension plan
  • Opportunities for growth and development
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Diverse and inclusive workforce

In this role you will:


People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team by fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and accountable work environment.
  • Manage workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and employee relations activities.
  • Ensure employees maintain required competencies and regulatory compliance while supporting ongoing learning and professional growth.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations, ensuring effective resource utilization and achievement of business goals.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, unions, national technology teams, airport authorities, and external partners.
  • Lead discussions, influence decisions, and resolve competing priorities to support operational and strategic objectives.
  • Communicate complex operational, technical, financial, and project information through presentations, briefings, and reports.
  • Promote collaboration, engagement, and continuous improvement across teams and business units.

Technology & Operational Management

  • Ensure regional technology systems, infrastructure, and operational services are reliable, secure, compliant, and effectively maintained throughout their lifecycle.
  • Monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, manage system changes, and implement strategies to enhance service delivery and operational effectiveness.
  • Oversee compliance with regulatory, quality, safety, and risk management requirements, including audits, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support technology standardization efforts and alignment with enterprise strategies, policies, standards, and operational requirements.

Project & Change Delivery

  • Lead the planning and execution of regional technology projects, ensuring delivery within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate resources, stakeholder engagement, testing, implementation, training, communications, and operational readiness activities.
  • Collaborate with regional and national teams to manage project portfolios and technology roadmaps while minimizing operational disruption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop, manage, and monitor operational and capital budgets, forecasts, contracts, and resource plans.
  • Ensure effective stewardship of financial, material, and human resources while identifying efficiencies and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Monitor financial performance, address variances, and adjust plans to meet business priorities and budget targets.
