title: Expert Fullstack Engineer
description:
About us

At Framna, we partner with ambitious brands to create digital products that make a meaningful impact.

We work across the full product journey, from strategy and UX to engineering and long-term growth, combining technical expertise with a strong product mindset. Together with our partners, we build solutions that users rely on every day.

Our culture is built on trust, ownership, and fearless collaboration. We challenge ideas, support each other, and keep learning—openly sharing feedback, staying flexible in how we work, and approaching each other with empathy. Because the best products are created by teams that move forward together.

About the role

We are building a next-generation passwordless authentication platform, leveraging advanced biometrics to secure digital identities and millions of global transactions. In this role, you won’t just be pushing tickets - you’ll have deep ownership and a real voice in shaping our critical architecture across the full stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React).

We engineer high-end systems capable of real-time analysis at scale, tackle complex security challenges in the AI era, utilize modern AI tools to eliminate boilerplate, and value pragmatic engineering where every senior is a genuine product co-creator.

Please note that we follow a hybrid model with a requirement for regular in-office syncs to foster team collaboration.

Preferred skills & qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience building digital products as a Fullstack Engineer or in a similar role

  • Deep knowledge of TypeScript and JavaScript, with the ability to guide technical decisions and best practices

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Node.js and React

  • Confidence working across the stack, shaping solutions, and taking end-to-end ownership of complex technical challenges

  • Experience using AI tools effectively across coding, testing, documentation, and team collaboration, with the ability to critically evaluate their output and guide adoption within the team

  • In-depth understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, and technology selection

  • Deep understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, and modern web communication patterns, with the ability to make informed architectural decisions

  • Extensive experience with frontend and backend testing approaches and tools, with the ability to define testing strategies and drive improvements in quality

  • Very good communication skills in English and Polish, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and align stakeholders on technical decisions

What you will find at Framna

  • Real ownership and influence on the products you build

  • A focus on business value over technical perfection

  • Continuous feedback and open, honest communication

  • Regular 1:1s and a mentoring program to support your growth

  • Internal workshops and knowledge sharing across teams

  • Flexible working hours (you can start between 7:00–10:00)

  • Hybrid model with regular in-studio collaboration (Gdańsk, Wrzeszcz)

  • High-quality equipment, including MacBook and testing devices

  • Individual training budget

  • English classes in small groups

Plus the essentials:

  • Private medical care (Compensa) and MultiSport

  • Team gatherings and shared moments beyond work

If you are motivated by ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy solving real problems with a team you can rely on—you will feel at home at Framna.

Let’s build impactful products together.

title: Security Metrics and Behavioural Manager
description:
Job Description:

Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. For more information, visit www.merkle.com.


This is an exciting time to join Dentsu Aegis Network (DAN) as we focus on becoming a 100% digital economy business by 2020 through content, media and commerce. We are well placed to build capability, scale and sustainable growth as a high performance business. Our strategy is driven by our unique culture with one vision (to innovate the way brands are built), one set of values and a unique operating model which drives collaboration, client focus and attention.


The Global Technology operating model is based around a set of principles and a clear alignment to the Business strategy. Those core themes are formed around scalability, compliant and agile solutions and propagating a significant move to cloud.


The purpose of this role is to define and measure the effectiveness of cybersecurity initiatives across dentsu. This includes developing and maintaining metrics to monitor progress and assess whether initiatives, projects, or stakeholder engagement have led to changes in behaviour and culture. Comprehensive metrics will underpin a data-driven approach to security, allowing leadership to track progress over time, identify emerging risks, and strengthen organisational resilience.


Key accountabilities


  • Strategic direction - Shapes the strategic direction, to implement metrics across dentsu Security to monitor and track progress and change in security posture, culture, and behaviour.
  • Behavioural Analysis - Defines key behavioural metrics and establishes success criteria to demonstrate meaningful behaviour change that strengthens the organisation’s security posture.
  • Analyse and Understand Threats - Conducts in-depth trend analysis and delivers actionable intelligence to Security Leadership, pinpointing areas were targeted interventions, such as tailored communications, focused training, or issue-specific campaigns, could help mitigate emerging threats.
  • Collaborates - with key stakeholders (e.g., Security, Data Protection, HR, L&D, Communications) to ensure strategic metrics and associated reporting drive positive behavioural change.
  • Create frameworks - to resolve issues identified and define measurable indicators (key performance indicators (KPIs)) that demonstrate improvements over time.
  • Influence - Present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely to senior leadership, with translated data into actionable insights and findings.
  • Insight –Leverage behavioural insights and data-driven analysis to equip the Security Team with actionable intelligence, guiding campaign strategy, recommending approaches to foster secure behaviours, and evaluating effectiveness post-campaign.
  • Benchmark - Compare internal performance against industry standards and peer organisations.

Professional skills


  • Self-Motivation - Acts as a self-starter, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance security culture and uncover insights without waiting for direction and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Security Metrics Development - Proven experience of using data analytics, to drive behavioural change.
  • Understanding of behavioural science, to reduce human-related security risks and enhance overall security posture, including the development of metrics within security, risk, or compliance frameworks.
  • Risk Management and Security Awareness - Strong understanding of security risk and security culture principles.
  • Technical Proficiency - in data visualisation tools and analytics platforms.
  • Leadership Communication - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Analytical Mindset & Storytelling: A curious analytical mindset to interpret data and clearly communicate insights through storytelling.

Desirable


  • Industry Experience: Experience in the information security industry. A keen interest in technology and understanding of the security threats faced by a global business like dentsu.
  • Behavioural Science: Background in psychology, behavioural science, or organisational development.
  • Security Awareness Tools: Familiarity with phishing simulation platforms and security awareness tools.
  • Awareness: in key security threats and themes impacting global organisations and the controls that implemented to maintain security
  • Agentic AI: A good understanding of agentic AI would be advantageous with a strong desire to learn and help automate existing and new processes.
  • Power BI: Experience creating and managing Power BI dashboards would be useful in this role.

We, obviously, offer even more:


⛺ 5 weeks of vacation + 3 wellness days

❤️ 2 Volunteering days to share the kindness of your heart with others

⏰ Flexible working hours and home office

🎯 Fully covered certifications in Salesforce, Adobe, Microsoft, etc.

🎓 Full access to Dentsu Academy, on-site learning sessions

🐶 Pet friendly offices

💌 Edenred meal and cafeteria points

🍹 Team events: company parties, monthly breakfasts, and pub quizzes

🥪 Snacks, and drinks at the office

💸 Referral bonus programme

💻 Laptop + equipment

📞 Corporate mobile phone subscription


Inclusion and Diversity


We’re proud to be different and that starts with our people. We believe in equal opportunities for everyone. We won’t define people by their race, gender, sexual-orientation, age or disability. Individuality is what makes us great, we want everyone to bring their full self to work and create something amazing. That’s what we care about. So, whether you’re joining us, or looking to move to a different part of the business, we work hard to make sure we create equal opportunities for everyone. We are happy to discuss flexible and agile approaches to working for all our roles – we can’t promise we will be able to offer you everything you want or need but we do promise to discuss it with you openly and honestly. If you have any reasonable adjustment needs arising from a disability or medical condition to fully participate in the recruitment process, please discuss this with our recruitment teams.

title: Florysta / Florystka
description:
• 6000–8000 PLN brutto / miesięcznie (umowa o pracę)

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Tworzenie kompozycji kwiatowych i bukietów według zamówień klientów

  • Obsługa klientów, doradztwo w wyborze kwiatów i dekoracji
  • Przyjmowanie dostaw, magazynowanie oraz przygotowywanie roślin do sprzedaży
  • Uczciwość i dobre pozytywne podejście do Klienta

Nasze wymagania

  • Doświadczenie w pracy na stanowisku florysty lub w branży kwiatowej
  • Umiejętność tworzenia kompozycji florystycznych oraz bukietów
  • Zdolności manualne i poczucie estetyki
  • Komunikatywność i umiejętność pracy z klientem
  • Dyspozycyjność oraz zaangażowanie w wykonywaną pracę

To oferujemy

  • Stabilne zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę
  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie oraz premie uznaniowe
  • Praca w kreatywnym i przyjaznym zespole pasjonatów florystyki
  • Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego i udział w szkoleniach branżowych
  • Zniżki na wyroby florystyczne oraz akcesoria kwiaciarniane

O nas

Kwiatowe Klimaty Anna Ostrowska to firma, która powstała z pasji do piękna natury i potrzeby dzielenia się nią z innymi. Jesteśmy zespołem florystów, których łączy miłość do kwiatów oraz kreatywność w tworzeniu niepowtarzalnych kompozycji. Od lat dostarczamy naszym klientom wyselekcjonowane bukiety, dekoracje oraz aranżacje roślinne, dbając o najwyższą jakość oraz indywidualne podejście do każdej realizacji. Wierzymy, że kwiaty mają moc wyrażania emocji, ozdabiania codzienności i podkreślania wyjątkowych chwil w życiu.

Nasza marka wyróżnia się szczególną dbałością o szczegóły oraz zamiłowaniem do innowacji w dziedzinie florystyki. Ofertę przygotowujemy tak, aby odpowiadała zarówno potrzebom klientów indywidualnych, jak i biznesowych. Tworzymy bukiety okolicznościowe, dekoracje na śluby, eventy firmowe, a także wieńce i wiązanki pogrzebowe. Uważnie wsłuchujemy się w potrzeby naszych odbiorców, doradzając i pomagając zachować harmonię między osobistymi preferencjami a aktualnymi trendami. Zawsze stawiamy na świeżość stosowanych kwiatów, a nasze kompozycje powstają z roślin starannie wyselekcjonowanych od sprawdzonych dostawców.

Pracownia Kwiatowe Klimaty to nie tylko miejsce, gdzie powstają bukiety — to przestrzeń pełna pasji, inspiracji i twórczego klimatu. Każde zamówienie traktujemy indywidualnie, chcąc jak najlepiej odzwierciedlić osobowość i oczekiwania naszych klientów.

title: Radio System Architecture Engineer- 244287
description:

  • Support field trials, investigate customer issues, and help resolve system-level problems in production.


What we need to see

  • Experience defining hardware and software requirements and supporting design teams throughout development and integration.
  • Experience developing multidisciplinary products, with the ability to take on unfamiliar technical problems, guide others, and work directly with customer needs.

title: Senior Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Boston Government Services, LLC. (BGS) is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst to support our clients.


BGS is an engineering, technology, and security firm helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects. We support clients at every stage, from strategic planning and program management to the execution of engineering and technical activities. We work to attract and retain the best talent because the best talent delivers the best results for our clients. Our capabilities are based on our experience in complex, secure, and highly regulated environments. We leverage our experience and capabilities to provide mission-driven solutions tuned to our client's mission needs and strategic direction.


Work that Matters. People that Matter More. At BGS, we believe meaningful work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability—where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make an impact. We care about our employees’ well-being through competitive benefits, clear expectations, and an environment that values both excellence and connection.


If you align with BGS’ company values and culture, we would love for you to explore opportunities to join our growing team by checking out the job description below!


BGS is seeking a detail-oriented Senior Cybersecurity Analyst to support cybersecurity compliance, assessment, and continuous monitoring activities within federal, operational technology (OT), and critical infrastructure environments. This role will assist senior cybersecurity personnel with system discovery, asset inventory management, evidence collection, documentation development, assessment preparation, vulnerability management, and ongoing compliance operations.


The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in cybersecurity controls and compliance practices, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to work directly with technical teams and customer stakeholders to support security assessments and program execution.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support cybersecurity discovery and assessment activities, including data gathering, asset identification, and documentation reviews.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of system asset inventories, hardware and software registers, and configuration records.
  • Collect, organize, track, and maintain cybersecurity evidence and artifacts supporting compliance assessments and authorization activities.
  • Participate in stakeholder interviews, working sessions, and site assessments; capture meeting notes, action items, and technical findings.
  • Support the development and maintenance of security documentation, including control implementation records, compliance matrices, and assessment artifacts.
  • Populate and maintain security control implementation workbooks and supporting compliance repositories.
  • Develop and manage evidence tracking systems and artifact indexes to support audits, assessments, and authorization reviews.
  • Draft control narratives, process descriptions, meeting summaries, and compliance documentation.
  • Conduct document reviews to identify missing evidence, documentation gaps, and compliance concerns.
  • Support vulnerability management activities, including vulnerability tracking, remediation coordination, and reporting.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Support continuous monitoring activities and recurring cybersecurity compliance reviews.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity engineers, assessors, project managers, and customer personnel to ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
  • Follow all customer safety, security, and facility access requirements while supporting on-site activities.


Required Qualifications:

  • Eight years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, assessment support, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), or security operations.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls and control assessment concepts.
  • Understanding of how security controls are implemented, documented, and evidenced within compliance programs.
  • Experience maintaining:
    • Asset inventories
    • Hardware and software registers
    • Evidence repositories
    • Assessment tracking tools
    • Compliance documentation repositories
  • Strong written communication skills with experience developing:
    • Control narratives
    • Technical documentation
    • Assessment records
    • Interview notes
    • Compliance reports
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work on customer sites while adhering to facility safety, security, and escort requirements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • CompTIA CySA+ certification.
  • Pursuing or planning to obtain Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP) certification.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) programs.
  • Exposure to Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity compliance initiatives and assessment activities.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms, governance and compliance tools, and cybersecurity documentation processes.


Location/Work Arrangement:

  • Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
  • This position is Remote.


Benefits:

BGS offers a competitive total compensation package to eligible employees. Benefits include Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Vacation, 401K, Long and Short-Term Disability.


EEO:

BGS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.


Exclusive Agreement Disclaimer:

BGS has standing contracts with federal agencies throughout the United States. We require an affirmative exclusive agreement to represent all candidates to our clients. By submitting this application, you are consenting to allow BGS to represent you as a candidate for the role in which you are applying.


Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
This position is Remote.

title: Environmental Consultant Manager
description:
Responsibilities

As a member of Sargent & Lundy’s Environmental and Permitting team, you will utilize your academic background and experience to review, evaluate, and implement federal, state and local environmental regulatory requirements as they apply to a variety of electric power and industrial projects. In this role, you will also support the continued growth of Sargent & Lundy’s environmental services by leading business development efforts, expanding client relationships, and identifying opportunities to increase the firm’s environmental services footprint across the power industry.

You will help drive growth by developing target markets, strategic pursuits, and expanding key accounts across consulting, engineering/design, owner’s engineering, and project services in the power, grid, industrial, decarbonization, and government sectors.

This position also requires leadership in proposal development, including preparation of proposals, statements of qualifications, and interviews, as well as shaping win themes, level of effort and schedule. A successful candidate will be expected to build and maintain strong client relationships, identify strategic opportunities, and position Sargent & Lundy to grow its environmental and permitting practice in the power industry. In addition, you will mentor and develop junior environmental staff; champion knowledge sharing, templates, and continuous improvement across the team.

The position will offer you the opportunity to expand your knowledge of federal, state and local environmental regulations as they apply to major industrial projects, and to work with multi-disciplined project teams to:

  • Support business development initiatives by identifying client needs, developing pursuit strategies, and contributing to the growth of Sargent & Lundy’s environmental services capabilities and market presence.
  • Manage complex, multi-disciplinary power industry projects involving environmental planning, permitting, engineering coordination, scheduling, budget management, and client engagement. You will serve as a primary liaison for environmental topics with clients, agencies, landowners, and community stakeholders.
  • Manage site-specific environmental impact studies to evaluate the suitability of a site for a proposed power facility, wind energy farm, solar generating station, electric substation, or transmission line.
  • Work with project engineers to ensure projects are designed and developed using criteria that recognize all relevant environmental requirements.
  • Manage permit applications and interface with federal, state, and local permitting agencies.
  • Manage complex technical reports including site selection studies, environmental and social impact assessments, compliance audits, and regulatory reviews.

The position offers the opportunity to travel to client offices and project site locations for project reviews. Some international travel may be required.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • A BS in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or related field, MS preferred.
  • Twelve (12) or more years of experience in environmental compliance, environmental impact assessment, and/or permitting for complex industrial and power related projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary projects in the power industry, including coordination among internal engineering teams, clients, regulatory agencies, and other project stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to support business development efforts by growing client relationships, identifying and pursuing new opportunities, contributing to proposals and interviews, and helping expand Sargent & Lundy’s environmental services footprint.
  • Familiarity with environmental laws and regulations that apply to large industrial facilities, including the National Environmental Policy Act, Threatened & Endangered Species Act, Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, and Resource Conservation and Recovery Act.
  • Environmental impact assessment/permitting experience, including specific experience in one or more of the following fields:
    • Environmental Impact Assessments.
    • Subsequent License Renewals and associated Environmental Reports.
    • NPDES wastewater and construction stormwater discharge permitting.
    • Wetlands permitting.
    • Major source air permitting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to interact and multitask with project team members, clients, community stakeholders and regulatory agencies
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time and coordinate various inputs between the internal engineering team, client and regulatory agency.
  • Ability to provide mentorship and guidance to younger staff members.

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Proficiency in ArcGIS mapping and experience in developing interactive maps showing critical environmental resources such as wetlands, critical habitats, and other sensitive receptors.
  • Certification or coursework in GIS is a plus.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Health & WellnessFinancial BenefitsWork-Life Balance
  • Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • Disability Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Back-Up Daycare
  • FSA & HSA
  • 401(k)
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Account
  • Merit Scholarship Program
  • Employee Discount Program
  • Corporate Charitable Giving Program
  • Tuition Assistance
  • First Professional Licensure Bonus
  • Employee Referral Bonus
  • Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST)
  • Paid Vacation
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Paid Bereavement Leave
  • Flexible Work Arrangements

Compensation Range

$145,310.00 - $222,001.00

Transparency Statement

Sargent & Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus.

About This Business Unit

The Energy & Industrial Group (EIG) specializes in delivering advanced engineering solutions across various sectors, including power generation, environmental compliance, oil & gas, and industrial projects, from new plant design to plant betterment and upgrade services for operating facilities. We have designed nearly 900 conventional power plants, yielding over 100,000 megawatts (MW) of generation capacity. Our expertise includes numerous recent and ongoing combined cycle projects that leverage the latest advanced machinery, including combustion turbines, steam turbines, and heat recovery steam generators from all leading suppliers. EIG is recognized for its commitment to decarbonization through innovative technologies in renewable energy, carbon capture, and hydrogen power. We excel in detailed engineering services for photovoltaic (PV) solar projects and energy storage integration, and lead the industry in carbon capture technologies, managing projects from conceptual studies, pilot demonstrations and through commercial scale implementation for utilities and industrial plants.

Equal Opportunity

title: Transition Specialist
description:
Position Purpose: Provides support with identifying, overseeing, and managing the coordination of transition of members in the community. Works with leadership to ensure the timely and safe transition of members in the community from various levels of health care services including coordinating care plans with community care coordinators, educating transition enrollees about services, requirements, limitations, and/or exclusions of services as a result of the transition. May perform and/or assist with member assessment/screenings; may develop and/or assist with developing member transition plan or service plan/care plan.



Key Details: This position works Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET. Candidates must reside in New Jersey, with preference given to those in Northern New Jersey (Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Union, Morris, or Warren counties). Field-based travel to nursing facilities and other community locations is required up to 50% of the time. The role supports members transitioning from healthcare facilities into community-based settings by coordinating with care teams, providers, members, families, and caregivers; arranging essential household items, furnishings, groceries, and in-home setup; addressing barriers to safe community placement; and maintaining accurate documentation, tracking, and monthly reporting.




  • Supports care coordination team, providers, and/or other health care team members to develop an effective transition plan for members in the community and/or into adulthood and adult services/providers, as appropriate
  • Assists with the transition for members in the community based on enrollment or transition of care for services identified
  • Works with care coordination and care management team to identify new member enrollees requiring transition services
  • Ensures existing authorizations are honored during the transition process and works with care management team and providers to address any issues
  • Acts as an available resource for members and their families and/or caregivers to educate on services, requirements, limitations, and/or exclusions of services as a result of transition planning
  • May track and maintains transition metrics including new member assessments, volume of members transitioning into or out of care to identify trends and process improvements, and ensures all transition of care information is appropriately documented
  • Supports with efforts to draft education materials and resources for members on requirements, limitations, or exclusions of services for transition of care
  • Assists with developing education and training programs for care coordination staff and providers to improve transition services for members
  • May evaluate the needs of the member, the resources available, and recommends and facilitates the plan for the best outcome
  • May coordinate as appropriate between the member and/or family/caregivers and the care provider team to ensure members are being effectively treated
  • Interacts with healthcare providers as appropriate to facilitate member care coordination needs
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: Requires a Bachelor's degree and 2 – 4 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Pay Range: $27.02 - $48.55 per hour

title: Night Auditor
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Valor, we are passionate Hotelitarians—driven, detail-obsessed professionals who go beyond service to deliver true hospitality. With a global perspective and a commitment to thoughtful hospitality and sustainable dining, we bring enthusiasm, creativity, and local flair to every property we support. We seek individuals who value relationships, embrace high standards, and create meaningful experiences for guests, teams, and owners alike. If you’re someone who notices the little things and strives to make a lasting impact, you’ll thrive here.

Please visit http://www.valorhospitality.com to learn more about our existing hotels, other exciting job opportunities and our company.

POSITION PROFILE

Responsible for performing close of day scenarios for the hotel Guest Service area and account for daily activity by organizing and verifying information; identifying and correcting discrepancies; posting accounts; running and distributing daily reports.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Audit, balance and report on all food and beverage outlets’ (e.g. restaurant, lounges, banquets, room service) cash and credit operations to include but not limited to checks, over/short figures/tally sheets, deposits, counts, house charges, promotional materials, postings, etc. And reset all registers to ensure accurate, timely information.
  • Follow all specified procedures to reconcile cashier’s reports with the restaurant system each night, researching and posting any unresolved tickets from the day shifts.
  • Follow all specified procedures to maintain and post a daily balance of all house accounts, including running preliminary reconciliations, detail transactions and final reports to accounting.
  • Audit, balance, post and report on the front desk to include but not limited to; room charges, phone calls, zero balance folios, corrections, adjustments, taxes, disputed charges, over/short figures, deposits, etc. To ensure accuracy and verify proper cash handling procedures are followed.
  • Audit, balance and prepare, verify and report on Room information to provide rooms management with a picture of how they are performing.
  • Prepare and input statistics and income journal sheets for preparation of daily reports. Produce accurate and timely reports and correctly handle all cash transactions.
  • Balance and audit for accuracy room revenue, food and beverage revenue, cashier’s reports, and guest and house accounts and telephone revenue; assisting the preparation of all reports relevant to daily revenues. Balance and close all bank ticket codes, daily.
  • Transmit credit card batches.
  • Run night audit final after ensuring all revenues are in balance nightly.
  • Complete and transmit daily management and accounting reports and supporting documents.
  • Act as hotel system liaison during night hours.
  • Perform all Guest Service Representative functions as required; may assists in booking room reservations; may assist in answering hotel phone calls and notifying guests of message.
  • Perform any other duties as designated.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • High school education or equivalent experience.
  • Six to twelve months of employment in related position or office setting with this company or other organization. Accounting or hospitality experience a bonus.
  • Requires having excellent computer and cash handling skills, ability to stand for extended periods of time; present a sociable, outgoing, lively and guest service-oriented demeanor. Ability to adapt to changing guest needs.
  • Working knowledge is generally learned on-the-job.
  • Good judgment and ability to resolve conflicts effectively.
  • Communicate information and hotel services to management, staff and guests.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to stand on your feet for extended periods of time
  • Bending and lifting to support organization of the hotel and offices

BENEFITS PACKAGE

  • Competitive Salary

  • Daily Pay!

  • Team Member Hotel Discount Program

title: Senior OT Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Boston Government Services, LLC. (BGS) is seeking a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity Engineer to support our clients.


BGS is an engineering, technology, and security firm helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects. We support clients at every stage, from strategic planning and program management to the execution of engineering and technical activities. We work to attract and retain the best talent because the best talent delivers the best results for our clients. Our capabilities are based on our experience in complex, secure, and highly regulated environments. We leverage our experience and capabilities to provide mission-driven solutions tuned to our client's mission needs and strategic direction.


Work that Matters. People that Matter More. At BGS, we believe meaningful work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability—where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make an impact. We care about our employees’ well-being through competitive benefits, clear expectations, and an environment that values both excellence and connection.


If you align with BGS’ company values and culture, we would love for you to explore opportunities to join our growing team by checking out the job description below!


BGS is seeking a highly experienced Senior OT Cybersecurity Engineer to serve as the technical authority for Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity initiatives supporting critical infrastructure, energy, industrial control systems (ICS), and regulated environments. This role will provide leadership in OT security architecture, asset discovery, network analysis, industrial control system protection, and cybersecurity assessment readiness.


The Senior OT Cybersecurity Engineer will work directly with operators, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and executive stakeholders to assess, document, secure, and sustain OT environments while ensuring operational reliability and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate combines deep industrial control system expertise with hands-on cybersecurity engineering experience and a strong understanding of federal cybersecurity assessment requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead technical authority for OT cybersecurity engineering and architecture activities.
  • Conduct passive OT asset discovery, network mapping, communications analysis, and data flow identification utilizing industry-leading OT security platforms.
  • Participate in stakeholder interviews and technical workshops with operations personnel, engineers, and system administrators to document OT environments and operational processes.
  • Analyze industrial control system architectures and identify cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps.
  • Develop and maintain cybersecurity documentation supporting OT environments, including system architecture diagrams, network segmentation designs, security control narratives, and implementation documentation.
  • Lead development of security documentation related to:
    • System and Communications Protection (SC)
    • Access Control (AC)
    • Configuration Management (CM)
    • System and Information Integrity (SI)
    • Maintenance (MA)
    • Physical and Environmental Protection (PE)
    • Contingency Planning (CP)
  • Design and evaluate network segmentation strategies using industry best practices and recognized OT security frameworks.
  • Develop secure remote-access architectures supporting operational requirements while minimizing cybersecurity risk.
  • Support cybersecurity assessments, audits, and authorization activities by preparing evidence, responding to findings, and validating technical implementations.
  • Provide coaching and technical guidance to customer personnel during cybersecurity assessments and regulatory reviews.
  • Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity improvement initiatives within OT environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to strengthen security controls without negatively impacting operational reliability.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of fifteen (15) years of experience in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control System (ICS), or critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with industrial network engineering, control system architecture, and cybersecurity engineering.
  • Experience conducting passive OT asset discovery and environment assessments using tools such as:
    • Dragos
    • Claroty
    • Nozomi Networks
    • Tenable OT
  • Experience performing OT cybersecurity assessments without disrupting operational environments.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols, including:
    • Modbus
    • DNP3
    • EtherNet/IP
    • Profinet
    • OPC UA
    • IEC 61850
  • Experience supporting and securing major industrial control platforms, including:
    • Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
    • Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC)
    • Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems
  • Expertise designing segmented industrial networks utilizing:
    • Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture
    • ISA/IEC 62443 Zones and Conduits
    • Data diode architectures
    • Secure remote-access solutions
  • Experience preparing organizations for federal, regulatory, or compliance cybersecurity assessments.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to operations personnel, engineering teams, executives, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical writing skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP).
  • GIAC Response and Industrial Defense (GRID).
  • ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert certification.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  • Experience supporting nuclear energy, reactor operations, nuclear instrumentation and control systems, or advanced reactor environments.
  • Experience supporting Department of Energy (DOE), utility, energy, or other critical infrastructure cybersecurity programs.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-82, NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), and industrial cybersecurity governance requirements.


Location/Work Arrangement:

  • Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
  • This position is Remote.


Benefits:

BGS offers a competitive total compensation package to eligible employees. Benefits include Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Vacation, 401K, Long and Short-Term Disability.


EEO:

BGS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.


Exclusive Agreement Disclaimer:

BGS has standing contracts with federal agencies throughout the United States. We require an affirmative exclusive agreement to represent all candidates to our clients. By submitting this application, you are consenting to allow BGS to represent you as a candidate for the role in which you are applying.


Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
This position is Remote.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Job Title: Principal Software Engineer

Location(s): Waltham, MA

Get To Know the Team

We build the infrastructure that global private equity firms rely on to raise capital, onboard investors, and manage fund operations. If you’re passionate about distributed systems, clean APIs, and delivering scalable software in a regulated environment, you’ll find this work both challenging and meaningful.

Why You Will Love It Here!

· Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model & a Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans

· Your Future: 401 (k) Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement

· Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays

· Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, including SS&C University

What You’ll Do:

· Design and build scalable components for a multi-tenant SaaS platform

· Own features end-to-end — from design and development to deployment and production support

· Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to solve real customer problems

· Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and elevate engineering standards

· Implement robust observability and monitoring across services

· Use AI-enabled development practices across the software development life cycle to assess and improve code quality, test coverage, and security.

· Apply AI-assisted data modeling and analysis to inform scalable, reliable software design.

What You Bring:

· Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience, or Master’s degree with 3+ years in Computer Science or a related field

· Proven experience owning full-stack features in a SaaS environment from concept to production

· Strong commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and testable code

· Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams

· Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with high ownership and minimal bureaucracy

· Full-stack engineering experience with practical use of AI tools throughout the development life cycle.

· Ability to use AI-assisted data modeling and analysis, and to critically evaluate AI-generated output for quality, accuracy, and security.

Technology Stack:

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Java

Frameworks: React, Spring Boot, Express, Flask

APIs & Protocols: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf, AsyncAPI

Data Stores: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis

Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Graphana, Splunk, Dynatrace

Source Control: Git (Monorepo with Turborepo or Nx)

AI & Emerging Technologies:

· Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into production systems

· Familiarity with agentic frameworks or Model Context Protocol (MCP)

· Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools to support design, coding, testing, code review, and security analysis

title: Front Line Care Clinician - Lubbock, TX
description:
Job Summary

Job Description

Own clinical support activities related to retaining and growing Medline Front Line Care business, including customer support, clinical troubleshooting, trial and implementation support, and clinical solutions execution while collaborating with OneMedline partners.


Objective of the Front Line Care team is to partner with health systems on improving outcomes of main Hospital Acquired Conditions (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI and Fall Prevention).


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Provide clinical subject matter expertise on clinical practice related to safe and effective use of products. Use strong clinical acumen to present and educate on the safe and effective use of Front Line Care products. Objective is to partner with health systems on key quality metrics related to nursing (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI, Fall Prevention).
  • Build and maintain strong account-level relationships with stakeholders involved in clinical decision-making, including but not limited to CNO, ACNO, ICU, key unit leaders, Infection Prevention, WOCN, Quality/Patient Safety, and other relevant clinical stakeholders.
  • Support retention activities in the assigned geography and participate in trials, implementations, and post-implementation support in assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with Front Line Care Specialists to pitch, perform assessments, and implement and maintain clinical solutions.
  • Collaborate in the field with Acute Care, IDN, Front Line Care Strategic Account Managers and Front Line Care Reps, and other partners to bring the right solutions to customer needs and retain and grow business.
  • Lead or attend local trade shows, educational dinners, chapter events or product events as needed.
  • Ensure an appropriate frequency of touchpoints with priority accounts.
  • Perform account activities including in-services, just-in-time education, clinical troubleshooting, bedside audits, trial support, clinical solutions workshops, and protocol reviews with clinical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer expectations, internal resources, clinical evaluations, implementation needs, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in Front Line Care Clinical business reviews.
  • Initiate and facilitate communication and collaboration among relevant internal stakeholders.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS

Experience

  • At least 3 years of clinical experience (patient care, education, or medical sales/support).

Education


  • Per certification requirements.

Certification / Licensure


Position requires at least one of the following certifications or meeting state-specific requirements to practice:


  • RN (Registered Nurse)
  • CCRN (Critical Care Registered Nurse)
  • APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse)
  • VA-BC (Vascular Access Board Certified)
  • CRNI (Certified Registered Nurse of Infusion)
  • CWOCN (Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nursing Certification)
  • CWCN (Certified Wound Care Nurse)
  • WCC (Wound Care Certification)
  • CNOR (Certified Perioperative Nurse)
  • CIC (Certified Infection Control)

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

$92,000.00 - $138,000.00 Annual

The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. This role is bonus and/or incentive eligible. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp. title: Public Education & Outreach Coordinator – Cancer Center | Correll Pavilion
description:
Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary

Connect Communities to Cancer Education and Support



Take your passion for community outreach and put it to work where it can make a difference. As a Public Education and Outreach Coordinator with Grady’s Cancer Center at Correll Pavilion, you’ll lead outreach efforts, build meaningful community partnerships, and help bring cancer education, resources, and support closer to the people who need them most. You’ll connect patients, families, and communities with programs and resources that can make a meaningful difference throughout their cancer journey.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan and coordinate community education, outreach, screening, and awareness initiatives
  • Build relationships with community organizations and other cancer-focused partners
  • Develop an annual outreach plan based on community health needs
  • Coordinate patient education materials and resources
  • Identify grant opportunities and assist with letters of intent and applications
  • Recruit, orient, and coordinate volunteers supporting Cancer Center programs
  • Work with patient navigation, support services, and community affairs teams
  • Evaluate outreach efforts and adjust program goals as needed



What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Community Services, Public Relations, Education, or a related field
  • Five or more years of related experience
  • Experience with public education, community outreach, and volunteer management
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, organization, and program-planning skills


If you’re passionate about increasing cancer awareness, connecting people with valuable resources, and building partnerships that strengthen community health, apply today to join Grady’s Cancer Center at Correll Pavilion.

Core Competencies
These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment.


1. Patient-Centered Care – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high-quality care that prioritizes the well-being and satisfaction of patients and their families.
2. Integrity & Accountability – Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and accepts responsibility for actions, decisions, and outcomes.
3. Collaboration & Teamwork – Builds positive relationships, works effectively across departments, and supports colleagues to achieve shared goals.
4. Communication – Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with patients, families, colleagues, and leadership.
5. Respect & Inclusion – Creates an inclusive environment by valuing diversity, treating others with dignity, and ensuring equitable care and opportunities for all.
6. Quality & Safety – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes.
7. Adaptability & Resilience – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure.
8. Continuous Improvement – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
9. Leadership & Professionalism – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.
10. Employee Experience Focus – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care.


Grady Total Rewards
At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our Total Rewards package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

  • Financial Security: Retirement savings plans with employer contributions, life insurance, and disability coverage.

  • Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, holidays, and family leave benefits.

  • Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, professional development programs, and opportunities for advancement.

  • Employee Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and discounts on services.

Grady’s Total Rewards are designed to ensure our employees feel valued, supported, and empowered, both at work and beyond.

Why Join Grady?
Grady Health System is more than a hospital — we are a vital part of Atlanta and the surrounding communities. For over 125 years, Grady has been committed to providing exceptional care, advancing health equity, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve. When you join Grady, you become part of a team that values excellence, compassion, innovation, and collaboration.


Here, every role matters. Whether you provide direct patient care, support our operations, or lead teams, you play an important part in fulfilling our mission. We offer opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career in an environment where your contributions are recognized and valued.


At Grady, we don’t just work, we make an impact.

title: Shift Manager
description:
Who we are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Reporting to Automation Manager, the Shift Manager plans and leads the daily activities of the Operations Department in the areas of Safety, Quality, and Maintenance. This requires both a focus on leadership as well as the full utilization of information, procedures and methods to positively impact the production of the overall system.


Role and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that the safety commitments in compliance with OSHA, Symbotic, and our customers’ processes and procedures are met daily.
  • Manage a team of hourly and salaried employees to support the customers hours of operations.
  • As the system operates at various levels, execute standard operating procedures to drive performance enhancements, adjusting to changing business conditions as required.
  • Ensures proper staffing of all functions for the established operating pattern, training and development of employees, setting goals and objectives. This includes evaluating performance by preparing performance reviews.
  • Coach the team to respond effectively to issues/problems in the system. Develop standards,
  • processes, procedures and documentation for dealing with specific problems.
  • Train and enhance the performance of the team members. Regularly assess performance of team members. Train and motivate employees to exceed customer expectations.
  • Communicate regularly with the local customer management team as well as the teams at Symbotic headquarters.
  • Monitor system performance, report on trends of problems and present solutions.
  • Monitor and provide defined KPI reporting based on contractual agreements.
  • Conduct accident investigation per company guidelines and use judgment and discretion to make findings and document them

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field, such as manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial automation.
  • 1-3 years of experience in management in a related field.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Values safety above all else.
  • Regularly interacts with executives and/or major customers. Interactions frequently involve special skills, such as negotiating with customers or management or attempting to influence senior level leaders regarding matters of significance to the organization.
  • Utilize progressive coaching and counseling concepts according to established policies and procedures to provide continuous feedback on performance, increase employee retention and improve employee relations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual presentation communications skills.
  • Strong knowledge of automation, warehousing, and business processes.
  • Ability to work independent of supervision following maintenance procedures and manuals.
  • A high sense of urgency.
  • Takes critical feedback and recognition positively.
  • Team player.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.

Environment:

  • Must be able to work at heights of up to 45 feet and within restrictive areas of 24 inches.
  • Subject to environmental conditions, protection from weather conditions but not necessarily temperature changes. Must be capable of working in temperatures ranging from 105° to 32° Fahrenheit.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequent ability to safely and efficiently lift items weighing up to 60lbs and move items weighing up to 80lbs.
  • Stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours.
  • Must be capable of occasional and/or continuous feeling, seeing, hearing, bending, twisting, stooping, pushing, pulling, balancing, gripping, climbing, crawling, sitting, handling objects, and repetitive movement using both hands and feet.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity


Our US Gas Operations – American Gulf team is seeking a Mechanical Technician to support the safe, reliable operation and maintenance of natural gas facilities in the Alexandria Area, including Deville and Jena, Louisiana. The area consists of five compressor stations and associated pipeline facilities.


In this hands-on role, you will perform a variety of mechanical maintenance, troubleshooting and operational activities on compression, pipeline and station equipment. You will work both independently and collaboratively with operations and technical teams to identify issues, complete repairs and help maintain safe and reliable facilities.


A solid mechanical and technical foundation is essential, and we welcome candidates who can apply their skills in an industrial or field environment. Experience with natural gas compression and pipeline facilities is an asset, and electrical, instrumentation and controls (EIC) knowledge or experience is also considered a plus.


What you'll do


  • Operate, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain and repair mechanical equipment associated with natural gas compressor stations and pipeline facilities
  • Maintain and troubleshoot gas-fired turbine engines, gas compressors, standby generators, pumps, air compressors, cooling systems, gearboxes, valves, valve operators and other auxiliary equipment
  • Perform pipeline and facility maintenance, including work on valves, regulators and relief valves
  • Support pipeline and station blowdowns, purging, pressurization and other operational activities
  • Perform line locates, utility and pipeline patrols, and associated right-of-way maintenance
  • Plan, coordinate and complete routine, preventive and corrective mechanical maintenance, equipment improvements and major maintenance activities
  • Diagnose equipment issues and identify safe, effective solutions to support equipment reliability
  • Complete work orders, job plans and maintenance documentation in SAP
  • Support other operations and maintenance activities across the Alexandria Area as needed

Minimum Qualifications


  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 3+ years of mechanical, industrial maintenance or other relevant hands-on experience that provides a solid technical foundation

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working knowledge of mechanical equipment and the operating principles of four-cycle combustion engines
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot mechanical equipment and perform maintenance safely and effectively
  • Experience in natural gas pipeline, compression, oil and gas, petrochemical or similar industrial operations
  • Experience maintaining or troubleshooting gas turbine engines, internal combustion engines, gas compressors, standby generators or similar mechanical equipment
  • Knowledge of compressor station and pipeline equipment, including pumps, valves, regulators and auxiliary systems
  • Electrical, instrumentation and controls (EIC) knowledge or experience, including exposure to instrumentation, electrical systems, control systems or related troubleshooting

This position requires candidates to:


  • Have and maintain a valid driver's license and safe driving record
  • Successfully complete a pre-employment medical screening, including drug and alcohol testing
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and be available for callouts, including nights, weekends and holidays, as required
  • Be available for overtime as operational needs require; typical overtime is 10% or less
  • Travel regularly within the Alexandria Area to support multiple facilities. Local travel may occur daily and is typically within approximately one hour, with no overnight stay required
  • Travel to other company locations for temporary assignments, meetings or training, which may include overnight stays
  • Work outdoors in varying weather and temperatures and in industrial environments that may include confined or restricted work areas
  • Perform the physical requirements of the role, including lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds

Driving a motor vehicle is an essential job function of this position. Following a conditional offer of employment, the Company will check the motor vehicle records of any job applicant when driving is an essential job function.


About our business


We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs. Every day, we move more than 30 per cent of the natural gas used across the continent and connect LNG exports to global markets, powering communities and industries. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure delivers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy across North America. Our field operations span seven Canadian provinces, 34 U.S. states and seven Mexican states. Together, we strengthen the connections that deliver the energy the world relies on-every day.


TC Energy is an equal opportunity employer and participates in the E-Verify program supervised by the US government. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, age, sex, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability. We are also committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Applicants requiring accommodations or accessible formats are encouraged to contact us at careers@tcenergy.com for support.


All applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based, without restrictions. Background screening is required for all positions, which may include criminal and/or credit checks. Offers may be extended at a different level or job title that best aligns with the successful candidate's qualifications.

Visit us at TCEnergy.com and connect with us on our social media channels for our latest news, employee stories, community activities, and other updates.


Thank you for considering TC Energy in your career journey.

title: VP, Client Operations
description:
Job Description:

The VP, Account Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across a portfolio of client accounts. This role establishes the operating discipline required to connect resource planning, staffing, financial stewardship, scope governance, cross-functional execution, and client delivery.


As a senior partner to Account Leadership, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Resource Management, Human Resources, and Executive Support, the Director translates business priorities into scalable operating plans, anticipates risk, drives accountability, and equips leaders with clear, actionable insights. The role owns governance and continuous improvement across account operations while leading and developing operations talent.


Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Operations & Governance

  • Own the account-operations strategy and operating rhythm across assigned client accounts, establishing standards, controls, decision rights, and escalation paths.
  • Lead portfolio-level reviews of staffing, financials, scopes, operational risk, and delivery readiness; convert findings into prioritized actions for senior leadership.
  • Define and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, and reporting standards that improve transparency, consistency, and accountability.
  • Identify systemic risks, dependencies, and capacity constraints early; lead mitigation planning and executive escalation when required.

Resource Strategy, Workforce Planning & Staffing

  • Direct resource planning and staffing across client teams to align skills, capacity, utilization, and cost with business demand.
  • Provide governance for PAR submissions, approvals, tracking, and reporting; ensure workforce actions are accurate, timely, and aligned with approved plans.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Resource Management leaders on hiring priorities, backfills, redeployment, succession coverage, and longer-range workforce needs.
  • Lead scenario planning for growth, attrition, scope changes, and budget pressure; recommend trade-offs and investment decisions to account leadership.
  • Establish portfolio-level staffing dashboards and ensure leadership has a reliable view of vacancies, hiring progress, allocations, and emerging gaps.

Financial & Business Leadership

  • Own operational oversight of staffing-related financials, budgets, allocations, and forecasts across the portfolio.
  • Partner with Finance and Account Leadership to connect resource decisions to revenue, margin, utilization, and client commitments.
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual planning processes, including variance analysis, scenario modeling, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Ensure reports, dashboards, and analytical tools provide accurate, decision-useful insights; strengthen controls that reduce financial and operational risk.

Scope, Contract & Change Governance

  • Provide governance for the creation, review, approval, execution, and retention of client Scopes of Work and related documentation.
  • Partner with account and finance leaders to evaluate operational and staffing implications of scope changes, amendments, renewals, and new business.
  • Create controls for signature tracking, document management, obligations, and handoffs to reduce delays and compliance risk.
  • Escalate unresolved scope, funding, or delivery misalignment and drive cross-functional resolution.

Client & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as the senior operational point of contact for complex account and client matters, ensuring clear ownership, timely resolution, and appropriate escalation.
  • Advise account leaders on operating-model decisions, resource investments, workflow design, and risk mitigation.
  • Prepare concise executive updates that synthesize staffing, financial, scope, and operational performance into decisions and actions.
  • Build trusted relationships across client teams and internal functions while reinforcing a high standard of responsiveness, accuracy, and service.

Team Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop account-operations team members; establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans.
  • Delegate operational ownership effectively while maintaining accountability for quality, controls, and outcomes.
  • Build repeatable tools, playbooks, training, and communities of practice that strengthen operations capability across accounts.
  • Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented operating culture.

Travel, Entertainment & Event Oversight

  • Provide governance for client travel, entertainment, offsites, events, and business reviews, including budgeting, approvals, vendor coordination, and expense controls.
  • Partner with executive assistants and account leadership to align logistics with client objectives, agency policies, and financial parameters.
  • Escalate material budget, policy, or execution risks and ensure corrective action.

Process Transformation & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that simplify workflows, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.
  • Establish process documentation, ownership models, and best practices that can scale across teams and accounts.
  • Evaluate workflow and workforce-planning tools, define business requirements, and guide adoption and change management.
  • Use trend analysis and root-cause problem solving to address recurring issues and improve operational performance.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in agency operations, account operations, business operations, resource management, client services operations, project or program management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading operations across multiple teams or accounts and influencing senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience leading and developing team members, with the ability to set direction and drive accountability through others.
  • Advanced financial and analytical capability, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, workforce planning, and operational reporting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, and executive-level reporting.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and resolve complex operational issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent executive communication, judgment, stakeholder management, and change-leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in a media, advertising, or marketing agency environment with knowledge of client account economics and delivery models.
  • Experience with staffing, resource-management, workforce-planning, financial-planning, and workflow platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contract administration, Scopes of Work, amendments, renewals, and client financial processes.
  • Experience designing operating models, governance frameworks, dashboards, and process-improvement programs.

Critical Success Factors

  • Strategic perspective paired with disciplined execution and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to anticipate business needs, connect operational signals, and present clear options and recommendations.
  • Strong financial acumen, analytical judgment, and commitment to data integrity.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence across functions without relying solely on authority.
  • High sense of urgency, strong follow-through, and comfort making decisions amid ambiguity.
  • Commitment to developing people, improving systems, and building scalable ways of working.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership has a timely, accurate portfolio view of staffing, financials, scopes, risks, and required decisions.
  • Resource plans anticipate demand and minimize disruption while balancing client needs, team capacity, and financial objectives.
  • PARs, hiring actions, backfills, and workforce changes move through defined governance with clear ownership and status.
  • Forecasts and operational reporting are accurate, actionable, and consistently used to guide decisions.
  • SOWs and changes are executed with strong controls, clear operational alignment, and reduced compliance risk.
  • Operational issues are resolved at the right level, recurring problems decline, and escalation paths are effective.
  • Account-operations talent grows in capability and ownership, supported by clear standards, tools, and coaching.
  • Processes become more scalable, efficient, and reliable across the portfolio.

The annual base salary range for this position is ($113,000 - $182,562). Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.
