title: Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer
description:
Do you like building backend solutions that don’t just work, but keep working, and are secure, scalable, and easy to live with? At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer who knows their way around .NET and Azure, and who likes thinking beyond the code itself.

Become part of the team

Framna partners with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across ten studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.

As Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer you’ll join our team in Stockholm, working alongside developers, designers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first sketch to live product.

You’ll also become part of Framna’s wider engineering and cloud community across our studios, sharing knowledge, discussing architecture, trying new approaches, and figuring out better ways to build together.

What you’ll do

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys owning the bigger technical picture. You’ll work across backend development, cloud infrastructure, architecture, and operations, with a particular focus on .NET and Microsoft Azure.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions primarily using .NET and Azure.

  • Build and operate cloud infrastructure and applications with reliability, scalability, and performance in mind.

  • Make architectural and technical decisions that help our products stay maintainable as they grow.

  • Work with security, databases, networking, and cloud services to create stable and robust systems.

  • Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and partners to turn both technical and business needs into great solutions.

  • Share your experience with the people around you, whether that means mentoring another developer, leading a technical discussion, or simply helping the team solve a particularly stubborn problem.

Who you are

We imagine you’ve spent around 6–7 years or more working professionally with backend and cloud development, and that .NET and Azure have been a significant part of that journey.

But years alone don’t make someone senior. We’re looking for someone who has developed the judgement that comes with experience. You know when to dig deeper, when to keep things simple, and how the decisions you make today will affect a product two years from now.

You might recognise yourself if you:

  • Have strong professional experience with .NET and Microsoft Azure

  • Have worked with cloud architecture and understand the infrastructure surrounding the applications you build

  • Are comfortable thinking about the full lifecycle of a system, from development and deployment to monitoring and operations

  • Take pride in quality and don’t like solving today’s problem by creating tomorrow’s

  • Enjoy technical variety and are happy learning new tools or technologies when the problem calls for it

  • Like collaborating and sharing knowledge rather than disappearing into your own corner with a ticket

  • Feel comfortable taking technical ownership and helping less experienced developers grow

  • Enjoy working from the office and being part of the everyday life of a team

What you get

For us, it’s studio first. Our cozy Stockholm office is our main location for work. Right in the middle of the city - a welcoming space where there’s always something happening, whether it is a demo, a fika, or someone testing out a new idea. We spend time together to build culture, optimize for stronger collaboration, better products, and greater value for our partners and challenging ourselves while having fun doing it. We mix that with the freedom to work from home when it makes sense, and hours that flex around real life.

A culture of curiosity. On Fridays we have weekly demos, Wednesdays mean lunch-and-learns, and sometimes we throw ourselves into conceptathons just to see what happens. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there’s something new we want to explore.

The freedom to follow your “what if.” We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you’re curious about something, you’ll have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.

Teammates who bring their whole selves. Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky, and, in Östersund, the occasional dog making an appearance too. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.

And of course, the benefits you’d expect. A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.

Our hiring process

  • Recruiter videocall

  • Manager interview

  • Technical interview

  • Reference check

Please note: For this role, you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden, or within commuting distance of our Stockholm studio. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer relocation.

We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to learning more about you!

title: LIA/internship Data Engineer
description:
Every week, millions of people turn to Hemnet when they’re looking for a new home, or just imagining one. Behind every search, listing and recommendation there is data, and making that data available, reliable and useful is what we in the Data & ML team do.

About the placement 🍏
We’re looking for two LIA students who start at the same time, ideally in December or January, and work together. The length of the LIA follows your school’s LIA period. You’ll be part of our team, working on real tasks in our data platform alongside experienced data and ML engineers.

As an LIA student, you’ll get to:

  • build and improve data pipelines and data models on our platform

  • work with the tools we use every day, such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, dbt, Prefect and Kafka

  • add tests and data quality checks, so that the product and our models can trust the data

  • take part in the team’s daily work and code reviews


Who we think you are 🤩
We think you:

  • study Data Engineer or an equivalent YH program, and are in the final phase with mostly your LIA left

  • are curious about how data flows and is modelled

  • take initiative, but also check in and ask when something is unclear

  • like working together with others

  • work well in English, our working language


I’ll be your supervisor 👋
Hi, I’m Helena and I lead the Data & ML team. I see my job as giving you what you need to learn and grow during your LIA, and that looks different for everyone, so we’ll talk a lot, especially in the beginning.
You can expect me to be clear and direct, and to make sure you know what you’re working on and why. I’d rather say things openly than leave you guessing, and I hope you’ll do the same with me. I have a technical background in data and still enjoy building things myself, so you’ll have someone to discuss the details with.

Does this sound like the place for your LIA? 🏡
Send us your application and tell us a bit about yourself, your program, your LIA dates and what you’re most curious to learn during your LIA. If you have a GitHub profile or a project you’ve built, feel free to include it.

A warm welcome - just as you are 💚
We value curiosity, a strong sense of purpose and the motivation to learn and grow, alongside your skills and experience.

title: Senior Analytisk Kemist
description:
Om Novavax AB


Novavax AB i Uppsala är ett helägt dotterbolag till det amerikanska moderbolaget Novavax Inc. Novavax AB utvecklar och producerar Matrix-M™, ett saponinbaserat vaccinadjuvans. Adjuvans är ett ämne som tillsätts ett vaccin för att förstärka kroppens immunsvar mot vaccinet. Tillsammans med Novavax Inc., som har utvecklat ett effektivt produktionssystem för vaccinantigen, arbetar Novavax AB med att utveckla olika vaccinkandidater.


Gruppen Analytical Development på Novavax AB söker en Senior Analytisk kemist då en av våra erfarna kollegor går i pension. Vi söker därför en ny kollega som vill bli en del av gruppen och bidra med sin kompetens inom analytisk metodutveckling.

Analytical Development ansvarar bland annat för utvecklingen av analysmetoder inom FoU-projekt samt analys av tekniska prover och tidiga stabilitetsstudier. Gruppen arbetar även med utveckling av analysmetoder inom CMC-projekt för frisläppning, inklusive verifiering och validering, samt support och transfer av analysmetoder till QC och externa partners.

Om rollen

Som Senior Analytisk kemist arbetar du metodiskt och noggrant, har ett analytiskt tänkande och förmåga att se både detaljer och helhet. Du trivs i en miljö där förutsättningarna kan förändras, något du hanterar med flexibilitet och ett lugnt fokus.

Rollen kräver självständighet, men också ett genuint intresse för samarbete och tvärfunktionell problemlösning. Du kommunicerar tydligt och tar egna initiativ för att driva arbetet framåt, samtidigt som du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och bidra till ett öppet klimat i gruppen. Du rapporterar till Director Analytical Development och tjänsten är placerad på plats hos Novavax AB i Uppsala.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

  • Leda, utföra och rapportera utveckling av analytiska metoder.
  • Planera, utföra och rapportera analyser av utvecklingsprover och tidiga stabilitetsstudier.
  • Leda och utföra fit-for-purpose och valideringsarbete av analytiska metoder.
  • Representera gruppen Analytical Development i utvecklingsprojekt.
  • Stödja andra avdelningar i utredningar gällande metoder och analysdata.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Mycket god laboratorievana och erfarenhet av metodutveckling med HPLC-MS och HPLC-UV.
  • Erfarenhet av att vara valideringsledare och/eller deltagit i validering av analytiska metoder.
  • Erfarenhet av självständig leda planering, genomförande och dokumentation av analyser och utredningar.
  • Mer än 5 års erfarenhet av analysutveckling i kvalitetsstyrd miljö, exempelvis GxP.
  • Universitetsexamen i analytisk kemi eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Erfarenhet av peptidanalys.
  • Erfarenhet av analys av lipider och/eller saponiner.
  • Erfarenhet av transfer av analysmetoder till externa laboratorier.

Vad erbjuder Novavax?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av innovativa adjuvansteknologier som gör verklig skillnad i global hälsa. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med hög kompetens, stort mandat och en tydlig mission: att möjliggöra framtidens vacciner och behandlingar.
Om du vill vara med och utveckla teknik i världsklass, och samtidigt växa i en roll med stort ansvar och påverkan, ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

Ansökan
Välkommen med din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Production Quality Specialist
description:
Pixel Sight, a company developing advanced electro-optical systems, is looking for a Production Quality Specialist to play a key role in the transition to serial production and ensuring product quality.

The role includes responsibility for quality control processes, testing and calibration, system approval before delivery, working with subcontractors, and driving continuous improvement of quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and manage quality control throughout all production stages, from incoming component inspection to final system acceptance.
  • Take responsibility for final Acceptance Testing (ATP), calibration, and system approval before customer delivery.
  • Define inspection procedures, quality plans, and acceptance and rejection criteria.
  • Monitor and control production quality at subcontractors and suppliers, including handling non-conformities.
  • Manage quality issues, investigate failures, implement corrective actions, and follow up on their effectiveness.
  • Establish and implement a digital quality and testing documentation process, ensuring full traceability of each system by serial number.
  • Collaborate with R&D, engineering, and production teams to continuously improve product quality and testing processes.

Requirements:

Must Have:

  • Certified practical engineer or technician in electronics, electro-optics, mechanical engineering, or a related technical field.
  • At least 2 years of experience in quality control, testing, or integration of complex electronic or electro-mechanical systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Acceptance Testing (ATP), calibration, and troubleshooting of complex systems.
  • Ability to read technical drawings and specifications and write inspection and testing procedures.
  • Ability to work independently with strong attention to detail, personal responsibility, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Good technical English skills. Advantages
  • Experience with electro-optical systems or within the defense industry.
  • Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, AS9100, and IPC standards.
  • Experience in failure analysis, non-conformance management, and RCA, CAPA, and 8D methodologies.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, particularly Priority.

description:

As our AI Solutions & Enablement Manager, you will work directly at the intersection of business operations, IT governance, and practical automation. You will serve as our regional champion: identifying workflow bottlenecks and areas for efficiency improvement, building intuitive low-code applications, deploying agentic workflows, and establishing the operational guardrails needed to scale modern AI tools safely across our EMEA operations.

We are looking for a pragmatic builder and problem-solver who understands how to analyse complex processes and data sets, and identify improvement opportunities; script automations, build lightweight apps, collaborate with IT/security teams, and guide operational staff through digital adoption with confidence and authority. With a solid AI background combined with experience in continuous improvement, operations, technical consulting, or systems support, you know how to turn manual friction into working solutions

Implement AI tools and agentic automation to eliminate front-end data bottlenecks, accelerate program data loading, and streamline change reviews.

What You Bring


  • A demonstrable track record: Practical experience leading the integration of AI into business and/or or operational processes, creating meaningful business impact.
  • Low-Code & Scripting Proficiency: Hands-on experience building functional tools in Google AppSheet and writing custom automation scripts using JavaScript / Google Apps Script.
  • Cloud & IT Fundamentals: A solid baseline understanding of cloud environments (preferably Google Cloud Platform / GCP), access controls, and IAM to ensure secure deployment.
  • Operational Grounding: Experience analyzing and improving multi-stakeholder operational workflows, continuous improvement initiatives, or business systems.
  • Pragmatic Implementation Mindset: You prioritize delivering a working, secure app in two weeks over developing theoretical models over six months.
  • Credibility & Influence: The authoritative communication style needed to establish compliance standards, push back on unsafe shadow IT, and guide cross-functional teams through new ways of working.

Why Join Us?


  • High-Impact Regional Ownership: Direct, executive-backed sponsorship to define and execute our AI and Google Cloud tools roadmap.
  • Real-World Agentic Automation: Work directly with BigQuery data assets to build closed-loop decision support and automate real enterprise workflows.

title: ICS/OT Engineer
description:
Boston Government Services, LLC. (BGS) is seeking a Industrial Control Systems/ Operational Technology (ICS/OT) Engineer to support our clients.


BGS is an engineering, technology, and security firm helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects. We support clients at every stage, from strategic planning and program management to the execution of engineering and technical activities. Work that Matters. People that Matter More. At BGS, we believe meaningful work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability—where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make an impact. We care about our employees’ well-being through competitive benefits, clear expectations, and an environment that values both excellence and connection.


If you align with BGS’ company values and culture, we would love for you to explore opportunities to join our growing team by checking out the job description below!


BGS is seeking an experienced ICS/OT Engineer to provide hands-on engineering support for industrial control systems (ICS), operational technology (OT), and cybersecurity initiatives supporting critical infrastructure, energy, and highly regulated environments. This role will work directly with operations personnel, engineers, cybersecurity teams, and system vendors to assess, document, and maintain secure and reliable control system environments.


The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in industrial automation, control system design and maintenance, networked operational technology environments, and cybersecurity best practices. This position plays a critical role in system discovery activities, architecture analysis, control implementation documentation, assessment support, and ongoing operational cybersecurity efforts.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct field-based discovery and assessment activities within industrial and operational technology environments.
  • Perform equipment walkdowns and system inventories to identify and document OT assets, communications paths, and system dependencies.
  • Review and validate control system architectures, network configurations, controller settings, Human Machine Interface (HMI) configurations, and engineering workstation implementations.
  • Support passive network traffic analysis and asset discovery activities to identify OT devices, protocols, and communications flows.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive OT asset inventories and configuration records.
  • Participate in interviews and working sessions with operations personnel, instrumentation and controls (I&C) engineers, system administrators, and vendors.
  • Develop and document OT-specific procedures, security controls, and implementation statements supporting cybersecurity and compliance initiatives.
  • Support documentation and implementation activities related to:
    • Configuration Management (CM)
    • Maintenance (MA)
    • System and Communications Protection (SC)
    • System and Information Integrity (SI)
    • Contingency Planning (CP)
    • Physical and Environmental Protection (PE)
  • Review and validate industrial control system network diagrams, architecture drawings, wiring diagrams, control narratives, and engineering documentation.
  • Provide technical expertise during cybersecurity assessments, audits, and regulatory reviews.
  • Evaluate OT system configurations against cybersecurity and operational requirements.
  • Establish and maintain OT configuration baselines and support configuration management processes.
  • Perform security impact analyses for proposed system modifications, upgrades, and engineering changes.
  • Support vulnerability assessments and evaluate vendor patches, firmware updates, and remediation activities to minimize operational risk.
  • Collaborate with operators, engineers, cybersecurity teams, and third-party vendors to enhance the security and reliability of industrial systems.
  • Support continuous monitoring and cybersecurity improvement initiatives within OT environments.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience engineering, commissioning, maintaining, or supporting industrial control systems.
  • Experience working within energy, nuclear, utility, manufacturing, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments.
  • Hands-on experience supporting one or more of the following:
    • Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
    • Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC)
    • Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems
    • Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS)
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and validate:
    • Control system drawings
    • Network architecture diagrams
    • Electrical and instrumentation diagrams
    • Controller logic and configurations
    • OT system documentation
  • Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols, including:
    • Modbus
    • DNP3
    • EtherNet/IP
    • Profinet
    • OPC UA
    • IEC 61850
  • Experience with OT networking technologies, industrial communication infrastructure, and security architectures.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • ISA/IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards
    • NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3
    • OT cybersecurity best practices
    • Configuration management and change control processes
  • Experience supporting configuration baseline development and maintenance for control system environments.
  • Ability to conduct security impact analyses for operational technology system changes.
  • Experience evaluating cybersecurity vulnerabilities, firmware updates, and patch management activities in industrial environments.
  • Ability to work safely within operating industrial facilities while adhering to site safety, security, and escort requirements.
  • Strong troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP).
  • GIAC Response and Industrial Defense (GRID).
  • ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience supporting nuclear energy facilities, reactor operations, or instrumentation and control (I&C) systems.
  • Experience supporting Department of Energy (DOE), utility, power generation, or other critical infrastructure organizations.
  • Experience collaborating with control system vendors, engineering contractors, and plant operations personnel.


Location/Work Arrangement:

  • Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
  • This position is Remote.


Benefits:

BGS offers a competitive total compensation package to eligible employees. Benefits include Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Vacation, 401K, Long and Short-Term Disability.

BGS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

By submitting this application, you are consenting to allow BGS to represent you as a candidate for the role in which you are applying.

title: Project Delivery Manager
description:
Project Delivery Manager

Operations | Vendor Management | Delivery & QA


About DataSeeds.AI

DataSeeds.AI provides rights-cleared, multimodal training data for AI developers and robotics companies, spanning image, video, and audio, as well as egocentric and exocentric (first-person and third-person) capture. We offer off-the-shelf datasets and on-demand collection, all enriched with detailed metadata, along with annotation and model evaluation services that complete a full data stack for AI training. Backed by our global network of more than 20 million creators and multiple production hubs worldwide, DataSeeds.AI delivers diverse, high-quality content at speed and scale.


DataSeeds.AI is part of Zedge, Inc. (NYSE American: ZDGE), which operates a portfolio of digital platforms. These include Zedge, a leading marketplace for phone personalization content such as wallpapers and ringtones, and GuruShots, a global photography community that serves as the quality engine behind DataSeeds.AI's image data.


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Project Delivery Manager to own the day-to-day operations behind our data delivery. You will lead vendor sourcing and testing, build and run the pipelines that take projects from scoping to customer delivery, and own our QA processes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own all operations tasks, including testing and sourcing potential vendors, building and executing delivery pipelines, and QA.
  • Lead vendor sourcing and onboarding for data collection, annotation, and production partners.
  • Design and run vendor tests and pilots to evaluate quality, cost, turnaround time, and scalability.
  • Manage vendor relationships, performance, pricing, and SLAs.
  • Build and execute end-to-end delivery pipelines for datasets and on-demand collection projects.
  • Define and own QA standards covering content quality, metadata accuracy, annotation quality, and rights documentation.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Product, Data, and creator-community teams so projects are delivered on time and to spec.
  • Track operational KPIs, identify bottlenecks, and improve processes, tools, and automations.


Requirements

  • 2–3 years of experience in operations, delivery operations, or project management, including hands-on experience managing vendors.
  • Proven experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing vendors, including running pilots and negotiating terms.
  • Experience building and running delivery pipelines or workflows end to end.
  • Hands-on QA experience and high attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.

title: Production Integration
description:
PixelSight is a deep-tech startup that builds vision intelligence systems to tackle one of the hardest problems in perception: early detection of threats drones, boats, and other targets at the edge of what's visible. Our systems are deployed in the field and saving lives.

Pixel Sight produces its systems together with contract manufacturing partners.

In this role you hold the hands-on knowledge of how our systems are built, integrated, tested and repaired. You will support R&D with development builds and upgrades, run RMA repairs, and improve assembly processes at our subcontractors to shorten assembly time, reduce cost and raise output.

You will work on our partners’ production lines to make sure every build meets our standard, and capture that know-how in documents and procedures.

Key responsibilities:

R&D builds and upgrades:

  • Build development systems and prototypes to R&D requirements
  • Make changes, adjustments and upgrades to existing systems
  • Record assembly difficulties and feed design-for-assembly (DFA) improvements back to R&D

Production at subcontractors

  • Lead integration and assembly of electronic, mechanical and opto-mechanical assemblies on the

subcontractor line, to Pixel Sight work instructions and production documents

  • Supervise build quality and adherence to quality and safety procedures, including ESD; escalate

deviations

  • Identify difficulties and bottlenecks on subcontractor lines and drive solutions that improve

speed and quality

  • Run functional tests and support environmental and vibration tests
  • Find and fix faults in complex systems, down to component level on electronic boards

Production logistics and records:

  • Receive parts against purchase orders, kit per work order and run inventory counts
  • Record serial numbers, component-to-serial links, unit status and shipments in the ERP (Priority)
  • Flag shortages and material risks to Supply Chain

Work instructions and documentation

  • Write clear, photo-based assembly instructions for every stage: sequence of operations, tools,

technical notes and in-process checks

  • Keep work instructions up to date with engineering changes and system versions
  • Build a library of known faults and repair methods

Assembly efficiency and cost:

  • Map assembly times and identify complex or repetitive steps
  • Develop work methods, jigs and aids that shorten assembly time and prevent errors
  • Evaluate pre-assembly of sub-assemblies, better sequences and simpler processes

keeping quality:

  • Propose changes to design, sub-assembly split and assembly methods that reduce production

cost

Assembly quality

  • Define in-process checkpoints at key assembly stages, for approval by Quality Control as part of

the control plan

  • Identify common assembly errors and develop ways to prevent them

RMA, upgrades and maintenance

  • Run the RMA process: intake, fault diagnosis, repair and testing before return to use, with

Quality Control on root cause and retest

Requirements:

  • Practical engineer or certified technician in electronics, electro-mechanics,

mechatronics or electrical engineering

  • 5+ years of hands-on assembly and integration of electro-mechanical systems- Must
  • Experience in serial production or transfer of products from development to production- Must
  • Fault finding in complex systems, including component-level debugging of electronic boards
  • Reads drawings, electrical schematics, BOMs and production documents, including in English
  • Hands-on with lab and measurement equipment
  • Comfortable with ERP records and documentation

title: Principal ML Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Principal Data Scientist – Agentic AI

SS&C Intralinks


About the Role

SS&C Intralinks is looking for a Principal Data Scientist – Agentic AI to provide technical leadership in designing, architecting, and delivering next-generation agentic AI systems across our enterprise product ecosystem.


This is a principal-level individual contributor role for someone who combines deep machine learning expertise, strong software engineering, and a forward-looking understanding of autonomous AI systems. You will lead the architecture and engineering of agentic platforms that can reason, plan, collaborate, use tools, remember, interact with enterprise systems, and execute complex business workflows reliably and securely.


You will work at the intersection of advanced AI research and production engineering. Beyond using existing frameworks, you will understand their internals, extend or fork them at the source-code level, and build reusable capabilities that become the foundation for enterprise-wide AI adoption. You will also influence technical direction across multiple product lines, set engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and data scientists, and drive build-versus-buy framework, model, and deployment decisions.


We operate with an agile, research-driven mindset: we continuously evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and turn promising innovations into practical enterprise capabilities, always with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and measurable business outcomes.


Why Join SS&C Intralinks

SS&C Intralinks combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and healthcare operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale with confidence.

You will shape how agentic AI is designed and deployed across a broad enterprise software ecosystem, working with industry experts, modern AI infrastructure, large-scale data environments, and complex real-world workflows. This role is about shaping the next generation of enterprise AI architecture, not simply integrating existing frameworks into applications.


How You Will Make an Impact

1. Agentic Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own the technical architecture and long-term engineering strategy for enterprise agentic AI platforms across multiple product lines.
  • Establish architectural standards, reference implementations, and reusable SDKs, abstractions, and patterns for agent runtimes, orchestration, state, memory, tool integration, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Select the right architecture for each use case: deterministic workflow automation, graph-based orchestration, autonomous agents, or hybrid approaches.
  • Lead decisions on agent frameworks, model providers, inference infrastructure, and enterprise integration patterns, including build-versus-buy evaluations.
  • Identify limitations in existing frameworks and develop custom solutions where standard implementations fall short of enterprise requirements.
  • Define and communicate the long-term roadmap for agentic AI platforms, lead architecture reviews, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers and data scientists.
  • Drive research initiatives, prototypes, and proofs of concept that bring emerging agent architectures, models, and protocols into production.

2. Agent Design, Planning & Multi-Agent Orchestration

  • Architect agents that understand objectives, decompose tasks, plan, select tools, monitor progress, and adapt based on execution results.
  • Implement advanced reasoning and planning patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, hierarchical and dynamic planning, reflection, critic-verifier loops, self-correction, and consensus-based validation.
  • Design supervisor-worker, hierarchical, collaborative, and decentralized multi-agent systems with dynamic delegation, sub-agent spawning, handoffs, parallel execution, and result aggregation.
  • Design and operate autonomous agent swarms that self-organize around large or open-ended objectives, with coordination mechanisms for shared context, dependencies, task prioritization, resource and cost budgets, conflict resolution, failure recovery, and containment of emergent behavior.
  • Build hybrid systems that combine deterministic workflows with autonomous execution so critical enterprise operations remain predictable and controllable.
  • Support long-running, multi-stage workflows that maintain execution state, track intermediate results, and recover from interruptions.
  • Define autonomy controls: confidence thresholds, escalation policies, human approvals, execution budgets, and bounded tool permissions.
  • Make agent decisions traceable and auditable through structured plans, execution events, tool-call histories, and evidence-based decision records.

3. Agent Runtime, Harness Engineering, Skills & Autonomous Coding

  • Architect and extend agent runtimes and harnesses that manage the full agent lifecycle: model invocation, context assembly, tool execution, state, sessions, memory, and execution control.
  • Work extensively with coding-agent environments and harnesses such as OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex-style systems, and custom environments; understand and customize the underlying execution loop, including tool discovery, context compaction, session recovery, and sub-agent coordination.
  • Build custom harnesses that combine planning engines, coding agents, tool runtimes, memory systems, and workflow orchestration from different frameworks.
  • Design a reusable Agent Skills ecosystem: modular skills, instructions, tool registries, and execution capabilities that are versioned, governed, and dynamically discovered and loaded based on task requirements.
  • Build autonomous software-engineering workflows: repository exploration, multi-file refactoring, code generation and review, test generation and execution, debugging, vulnerability analysis, documentation, and automated remediation.
  • Develop controlled execution environments (isolated file systems, shells, code sandboxes, browsers) and explore browser-use and computer-use agents for web, enterprise, and legacy interfaces.
  • Optimize harness performance: context utilization, tool-selection accuracy, task completion, token consumption, and multi-step reliability.

4. MCP, Agent-to-Agent Communication & Interoperability

  • Lead the design of enterprise MCP infrastructure using FastMCP and compatible implementations, exposing internal applications, databases, APIs, and business capabilities as structured tools and resources.
  • Define reusable tool schemas, descriptions, annotations, invocation policies, and output contracts for reliable tool discovery and execution.
  • Implement remote MCP servers with OAuth-based authentication, scoped access, session management, and enterprise identity integration.
  • Design agent-to-agent communication using the A2A protocol and other emerging standards (including AG-UI for streaming agent state and events), so agents built on different frameworks, models, and runtimes can discover capabilities, delegate tasks, and collaborate.
  • Separate agent reasoning, orchestration, tool execution, and business logic to avoid tight coupling between agents and enterprise applications.
  • Establish governance and lifecycle management for MCP tools, agent endpoints, schemas, versions, and integrations.

5. Knowledge, Retrieval, Memory & Context Engineering

Advanced retrieval architectures

  • Architect production Agentic RAG systems in which agents plan retrieval, decompose queries, choose among sources and tools, evaluate results, and iterate until answers are grounded.
  • Design Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG) strategies, including KV-cache and prompt-cache preloading of stable knowledge, and define when CAG, RAG, or hybrid approaches are the right choice for latency, cost, and accuracy.
  • Build GraphRAG pipelines: entity and relationship extraction, knowledge graph construction (e.g., Neo4j, memgraph), community summarization, and graph-based and multi-hop retrieval.
  • Develop ontology-driven RAG that uses domain ontologies, taxonomies, and schemas to guide entity resolution, query expansion, reasoning, and answer validation for complex financial, legal, and healthcare content.
  • Combine hybrid search (vector, keyword, metadata, relational) with reranking, multi-query retrieval, contextual retrieval, and query decomposition; optimize accuracy, grounding, and efficiency.

Memory & context engineering

  • Lead context engineering for long-running, complex tasks: context assembly pipelines that select, prioritize, summarize, compress, and manage information within model context windows.
  • Architect persistent AI memory that retains task-specific knowledge across sessions, execution boundaries, and context-window limits.
  • Design multi-memory systems for agents: working, short-term conversational, long-term semantic, episodic, and procedural memory, with consolidation, summarization, temporal reasoning, entity resolution, and relevance-based recall.
  • Define memory scoping across agents, users, teams, and tenants, including shared versus private memory in multi-agent and swarm settings.
  • Prevent memory contamination, stale knowledge, context pollution, cross-user data leakage, and incorrect long-term retention.

6. LLM Research, Inference Optimization & Model Serving

  • Lead evaluation of open-source and commercial foundation models (e.g., Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Gemma, Muse), including reasoning, multimodal, and mixture-of-experts architectures, on reasoning quality, coding ability, instruction following, tool-use reliability, context length, latency, and cost.
  • Develop model-selection and intelligent routing strategies based on task complexity, capability, latency, and cost.
  • Apply model adaptation techniques: SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, preference optimization, and synthetic data generation.
  • Lead inference optimization: speculative decoding, constrained decoding and structured generation, prompt and KV-cache optimization, continuous batching, quantization, and disaggregated prefill/decode.
  • Design multi-node and distributed model serving: tensor, pipeline, and expert parallelism; multi-GPU and multi-node deployments; GPU scheduling and autoscaling; and cache-aware routing, using vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalents.
  • Balance quality, throughput, latency, GPU utilization, cost, and scalability across cloud, private cloud, and on-premises environments.
  • Explore multimodal agent architectures spanning document understanding, vision-language models, audio, and speech.
  • Establish a systematic research and experimentation process that moves promising innovations into production.

7. Agent Evaluation, Benchmarking & Observability

  • Architect evaluation frameworks that measure complete execution trajectories and task outcomes, not just individual LLM responses.
  • Establish benchmarks for planning accuracy, tool-selection precision, invocation correctness, task completion, agent and swarm collaboration, retrieval quality (including RAG, GraphRAG, and memory recall), and execution efficiency.
  • Build simulation environments and synthetic enterprise workflows for repeatable benchmarking.
  • Create automated pipelines combining deterministic tests, LLM-as-a-judge, domain validation, human review, and adversarial testing, covering failure recovery, context overflow, hallucination, tool misuse, prompt injection, and inconsistent state.
  • Implement end-to-end observability with Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, and custom instrumentation, tracking model calls, context usage, tool invocations, inter-agent messages, latency, tokens, cost, errors, and business outcomes.
  • Establish continuous evaluation, regression testing, A/B testing, and feedback-driven improvement, with measurable quality and reliability standards for enterprise-wide deployment.

8. Production Engineering, Durable Execution & Infrastructure

  • Lead the engineering of highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant agent services supporting long-running tasks, asynchronous and concurrent execution, streaming, state persistence, and session recovery.
  • Implement durable execution patterns: checkpointing, resumability, idempotency, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and compensation logic; evaluate Temporal and event-driven architectures for distributed agent workflows.
  • Architect containerized services on Docker and Kubernetes, including GPU-enabled deployments and autoscaling.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and reproducible deployments; manage packaging and distribution of customized frameworks, internal SDKs, MCP servers, and reusable AI components, including framework forks, dependency pinning, model versions, and environment parity.
  • Drive performance optimization across orchestration, model serving, networking, databases, and distributed execution.

9. Enterprise Security, Governance & Responsible AI

  • Establish security-first patterns for autonomous agents operating on sensitive enterprise data: least-privilege access, agent identities, scoped IAM, OAuth, service-to-service authorization, and secure token and secrets management.
  • Defend against direct and indirect prompt injection, malicious tool outputs, data exfiltration, insecure tool execution, memory poisoning, and unauthorized agent actions.
  • Architect isolated execution environments with controlled access to files, shells, databases, APIs, and browsers, and enforce policy at the agent, orchestration, tool, and infrastructure layers.
  • Design human-in-the-loop controls and approval workflows for high-impact, sensitive, or irreversible operations.
  • Ensure tenant isolation, confidentiality, encryption, auditability, and secure retention of agent execution data and memory.
  • Build governance for agent registration, capability discovery, versioning, permissions, monitoring, and lifecycle management, working with security, compliance, legal, and infrastructure teams to meet regulatory requirements.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Experience and leadership

  • 8+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, data science, or related disciplines, with substantial experience building and operating production-grade AI systems.
  • Minimum of a master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with at least 5 years of relevant professional work experience.
  • Significant hands-on experience designing and deploying LLM-powered applications and autonomous agent systems in enterprise or similarly complex environments.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: architecture ownership, mentoring, cross-team collaboration, and delivery of reusable platforms adopted by multiple teams.
  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, concurrency, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proven ability to move between research, architecture, experimentation, source-code engineering, and production implementation.
  • Strong communication skills for explaining architectures and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Software engineering

  • Expert-level Python (async programming, concurrency, testing, packaging, profiling, performance) and strong software architecture and API design skills.
  • Experience working directly in the source code of complex open-source frameworks: forking, customizing, extending, and maintaining internal variants as production-grade software with automated tests, version management, and compatibility controls.
  • Familiarity with service integrations, agent interfaces, and full-stack AI applications.

LLM and foundation model expertise

  • Deep understanding of transformer architecture, attention, tokenization, embeddings, context windows, and inference.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Ollama, and other serving platforms, and with evaluating open-source and reasoning models for enterprise use.
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), distillation, and synthetic data generation.
  • Experience with inference optimization (speculative and constrained decoding, structured outputs, quantization, KV-cache and prompt caching, continuous batching) and with serving engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, including multi-GPU and multi-node serving.

Agentic AI architecture and harness engineering

  • Extensive hands-on experience architecting autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and agent swarms, using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen/AG2, Google ADK, PydanticAI, and custom runtimes.
  • Experience with coding-agent harnesses such as OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex-style systems, and with building custom harnesses and runtimes that integrate multiple frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of execution loops, planning, tool use, delegation, sub-agent lifecycle, reflection, session management, context compaction, checkpointing, sandboxing, and recovery.
  • Experience building long-running agents that maintain state and complete multi-stage workflows, and building reusable Agent Skills, tool registries, and standardized agent libraries.
  • Clear judgment on when to use autonomous agents versus deterministic workflow orchestration.

MCP and interoperability

  • Hands-on experience building MCP servers with FastMCP or equivalent, exposing enterprise APIs, databases, and services as structured agent-accessible capabilities with secure authentication, authorization, and schema validation.
  • Understanding of A2A (discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation) and emerging protocols such as AG-UI.

Retrieval, memory, and context engineering

  • Strong experience designing production RAG and Agentic RAG systems, with working knowledge of CAG, GraphRAG, and ontology-based RAG.
  • Hands-on experience with vector databases (PgVector, Milvus, or equivalent) and with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Neo4j, Elasticsearch, and object storage.
  • Experience with hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, knowledge graphs, contextual retrieval, and advanced query processing.
  • Experience designing persistent AI memory, multi-memory agent architectures (working, semantic, episodic, procedural), and scalable context management for long-running, multi-session agents.

Evaluation and observability

  • Experience building evaluation frameworks for autonomous and multi-agent systems: trajectory evaluation, tool-use benchmarking, simulation, regression testing, adversarial testing, and human-assisted pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or comparable platforms, and the ability to quantify quality, reliability, latency, token use, cost, and business outcomes.

Infrastructure and security

  • Strong understanding of secure enterprise architecture: IAM, OAuth, token-based authentication, secrets management, encryption, least privilege, prompt-injection defense, sandbox isolation, and auditable, governed agent design.

Mindset

title: Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer
description:
Do you like building backend solutions that don’t just work, but keep working, and are secure, scalable, and easy to live with? At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer who knows their way around .NET and Azure, and who likes thinking beyond the code itself. Someone who can zoom in on a tricky backend problem, zoom out to consider the architecture and infrastructure around it, and build solutions made to last.

Become part of the team

Framna partners with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across ten studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.

As our next Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer you’ll join our team in Östersund, working alongside developers, designers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first sketch to live product.

You’ll also become part of Framna’s wider engineering and cloud community across our studios — sharing knowledge, discussing architecture, trying new approaches, and figuring out better ways to build together.

And while we collaborate across locations, Östersund is where you’ll call home. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being around their colleagues and wants the office to be a natural part of their working week.

What you’ll do

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys owning the bigger technical picture. You’ll work across backend development, cloud infrastructure, architecture, and operations, with a particular focus on .NET and Microsoft Azure.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions primarily using .NET and Azure.

  • Build and operate cloud infrastructure and applications with reliability, scalability, and performance in mind.

  • Make architectural and technical decisions that help our products stay maintainable as they grow.

  • Work with security, databases, networking, and cloud services to create stable and robust systems.

  • Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and partners to turn both technical and business needs into great solutions.

  • Share your experience with the people around you, whether that means mentoring another developer, leading a technical discussion, or simply helping the team solve a particularly stubborn problem.

Who you are

We imagine you’ve spent around 6–7 years or more working professionally with backend and cloud development, and that .NET and Azure have been a significant part of that journey.

But years alone don’t make someone senior. We’re looking for someone who has developed the judgement that comes with experience. You know when to dig deeper, when to keep things simple, and how the decisions you make today will affect a product two years from now.

You might recognise yourself if you:

  • Have strong professional experience with .NET and Microsoft Azure

  • Have worked with cloud architecture and understand the infrastructure surrounding the applications you build

  • Are comfortable thinking about the full lifecycle of a system, from development and deployment to monitoring and operations

  • Take pride in quality and don’t like solving today’s problem by creating tomorrow’s

  • Enjoy technical variety and are happy learning new tools or technologies when the problem calls for it

  • Like collaborating and sharing knowledge rather than disappearing into your own corner with a ticket

  • Feel comfortable taking technical ownership and helping less experienced developers grow

  • Enjoy working from the office and being part of the everyday life of a team

What you get

For us, it’s office first. Our Östersund studio makes that pretty easy. With views over Storsjön, plenty of space to work together, and even a dedicated room for four-legged colleagues, it’s an office with a personality of its own. We spend time together because we believe it creates stronger teams, better collaboration, and ultimately better products.

A culture of curiosity. On Fridays we have weekly demos, Wednesdays mean lunch-and-learns, and sometimes we throw ourselves into conceptathons just to see what happens. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there’s something new we want to explore.

The freedom to follow your “what if.” We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you’re curious about something, you’ll have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.

Teammates who bring their whole selves. Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky, and, in Östersund, the occasional dog making an appearance too. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.

And of course, the benefits you’d expect. A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.

Our hiring process

  • Recruiter videocall

  • First interview

  • Case assignment

  • Technical interview

  • Reference check

Please note: For this role, you need to be based in Östersund, Sweden, or within commuting distance of our Östersund studio. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer relocation.

We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to learning more about you!

title: Dir Quality Strategic Programs
description:
Job Summary

The Director, Quality Strategic Programs is a member of the SVP, Quality Forward’s leadership team, serving as an integrator across the Quality Forward program portfolio. This role provides strategic oversight, governance, and coordination for the Quality organization’s largest and most complex transformational initiatives, ensuring workstreams and programs remain aligned, interconnected, and positioned to deliver sustainable business outcomes. The Director ensures Quality strategic programs positively influence the current and future-state Quality organization, align with the department’s operating model and governance structures, and remain responsive to the evolution of the enterprise and long-term quality and regulatory performance objectives. The role is accountable for the success of strategic programs under their direction, as well enterprise portfolio integration, strategic prioritization, and related executive decision-making support. As a senior individual contributor, the Director leads through influence, structured governance, disciplined execution, and cross-functional partnership, connecting strategy to execution across Quality Forward teams, including Project Management, Continuous Improvement, Sustaining Quality, and other business partners critical to the success of Quality’s strategic programs. The Director also establishes and continuously improves the mechanisms and governance needed to sustain the future-state Quality organization beyond the formal transformation period.

Job Description

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:


Portfolio Prioritization and Scope Management


Maintain an enterprise view of strategic programs and their initiatives, dependencies and resource demand across the Quality Forward portfolio. Partner with leadership to evaluate capacity constraints, recommend prioritization decisions, and align enterprise focus and resources to the organization’s most critical objectives.


Transformation Integration


Align and integrate work across Quality Forward portfolio programs and workstreams, and across Quality pillars to align initiatives to overall transformation objectives and the future-state operating model. Identify and resolve duplicative efforts amongst workstreams.


Governance and Accountability


Establish, facilitate and continuously improve governance routines, decision forums, milestone reviews, executive reporting and escalation pathways. Reinforce clear ownership and accountability.


Performance Measurement and Value Realization


Establish and maintain portfolio-level performance indicators, success measures, and transformation-health metrics in alignment with Quality department KPIs. Monitor progress toward intended outcomes and ensure initiatives deliver measurable business value and sustained improvements.


Major Initiative Ownership


Lead and coordinate selected enterprise quality initiatives that require executive sponsorship, operating-model changes, cross-pillar alignment, significant risk reduction, organizational capability development, or enterprise-wide transformation.


Remediation and Commitment Oversight


Coordinate governance of significant remediation programs and critical quality commitments, maintaining visibility to interdependencies, status, risks, escalations and closure readiness.


Program and Project Management Integration


Partner with PMO leadership to ensure major initiatives are supported by effective execution, visibility, risk management, and decision-support processes. The Director does not directly manage project managers or PMO personnel. Instead, the role partners with PMO leadership to establish portfolio priorities, escalation pathways, governance expectations, reporting requirements, and executive decision-making processes. The PMO remains accountable for project execution, while the Director remains accountable for enterprise portfolio alignment, transformation outcomes, and strategic-program governance.


Portfolio Health and Executive Advisory


Provide executive-level assessments of portfolio health, delivery confidence, emerging risks, strategic tradeoffs, and organizational readiness. Develop recommendations that enable leadership to make informed decisions regarding priorities, investments, timing, and risk mitigation.


Sustaining and Improving Future State


Embed transformation outcomes into sustainable operating practices with clear ownership, controls, measures, and review mechanisms. Continuously strengthen portfolio governance, execution capabilities, and cross-functional processes to improve delivery effectiveness and advance strategic program management maturity across the Quality organization.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Business
  • Administration, Life Sciences, Organizational Leadership, Industrial
  • Engineering, or related field.

Certification / Licensure:

  • None

Work Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality, Operations, Program Leadership, Continuous Improvement, Transformation, or related functions.
  • Experience supporting organizational transformation, operating-model implementation, and cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success driving business outcomes through cross-functional leadership, organizational alignment, and influence without direct authority
  • Significant experience leading complex quality, transformation, remediation, operational-excellence, or strategic-program initiatives in a regulated environment.
  • Experience assessing organizational risks, prioritizing improvement opportunities, and driving sustainable change within a regulated environment.
  • Experience translating strategy into executable plans, measurable outcomes, sustainable processes, and executive communications
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, portfolio management, risk management, change leadership, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience influencing quality strategy, operating-model improvements, quality-system performance, or organizational capability development across multiple functions.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • Enterprise thinking and strategic judgment
  • Influence without authority
  • Organizational leadership and strategic execution
  • Cross-functional integration
  • Executive communication
  • Systems thinking and problem solving
  • Constructive challenge and sound escalation
  • Adaptability in ambiguity
  • Collaboration and stakeholder trust
  • Commitment to sustainable quality outcomes
  • Operating-model design and organizational effectiveness
  • Ability to connect enterprise strategy, quality-system objectives, organizational capabilities, and program execution into a cohesive roadmap

  • Lean, Six Sigma, organizational change-management, quality, or project-management certifications

Work Experience:

  • Quality systems or regulatory experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare products, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience leading enterprise transformation, operating-model implementation, organizational redesign, or large-scale quality-improvement initiatives.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • None

title: Construction Technician
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity

Our In-Line Inspection team is evolving to meet the needs of our growing business and help safely build and maintain the integrity of our natural gas pipeline infrastructure across the United States.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Technician to support pipeline construction and mechanical activities associated with pipeline maintenance.

The successful individual will possess a high degree of respect for safe work habits, display a great work attitude, and work effectively in a construction environment, while acting independently in the execution of pipeline maintenance.

This position is eligible for overtime pay and requires frequent travel (75%) in support of pipeline construction activities.

*Position will be based out of Rayne, LA

What you’ll do

  • Ship and receive materials for projects
  • Operate power tools such as drills, grinders, torches, etc.
  • Gather MTR’s for all materials that are applicable to a project
  • Perform red line reviews/FMR’s and work with internal/external engineering as needed
  • Assist with ordering of welding consumables
  • Order and manage inventory of coating materials
  • Operate equipment that is necessary to off-load trucks
  • Oversee small equipment certification logs and ensure compliance
  • Catalog and complete project record binders for all projects
  • Assist crew leader and associate with obtaining documentation, op quals, and procedures
  • Assist crew on constructability reviews, safety aspects, and compliance for projects
  • Cross train with project planner and fill-in as needed to support program
  • Assist planner on information gathering for quotations and other engineering data as needed
  • Other tasks as required

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Two years of work experience in a mechanical related environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Valid CDL license or ability to obtain license
  • Pipeline or construction industry experience
  • Computer proficiency to include experience with SAP

This position requires candidates to

  • Have and maintain a valid driver’s license (CDL preferred) and a safe driving record
  • Successfully complete a pre-employment medical screening, to include drug and alcohol testing
  • Be subject to call out 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and work extended days and/or weeks for emergency response purposes
  • Frequent travel to other company locations to support construction activities, which will involve overnight stays away from home

Driving a motor vehicle is an essential job function of this position. Following a conditional offer of employment, the Company will check the motor vehicle records of any job applicant when driving is an essential job function.


About our business


We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs. Every day, we move more than 30 per cent of the natural gas used across the continent and connect LNG exports to global markets, powering communities and industries. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure delivers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy across North America. Our field operations span seven Canadian provinces, 34 U.S. states and seven Mexican states. Together, we strengthen the connections that deliver the energy the world relies on-every day.

title: Shared Services Analyst
description:
The Firm:


Brevan Howard Investment Management is one of the leading absolute return/hedge fund managers, overseeing assets on behalf of institutional investors from around the world, including pension funds, endowments, insurance companies, government agencies, private banks, and fund of funds.

Brevan Howard was founded in 2002 and launched its flagship global macro strategy in April 2003. The firm currently manages over $34bn and engages predominantly in discretionary directional and relative value trading in fixed income, FX markets, and equities. BH Digital, a division within Brevan Howard that manages crypto and digital asset strategies was launched in 2022.

The firm currently employs over 1,000 personnel worldwide, including over 400 investment professionals. This global presence gives Brevan Howard the ability to identify and source attractive investment opportunities, as well as investment management talent wherever they may be. Brevan Howard has won several industry awards for excellence in risk management, operational robustness, and investment performance.

The firm’s main hubs are in London, Jersey, Geneva, New York, Austin, Hong Kong, Singapore, Abu Dhabi and Bengaluru.

Info about the team

The Shared Services Hub is a cross-functional initiative aimed at creating collaboration across the Brevan Howard back office, bringing together Finance, FP&A, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Payroll, Tax and Legal. The Hub is based in Bengaluru and supports colleagues across Brevan Howard’s global offices.

These roles report into the Enterprise Systems & Operations team, which owns the platforms and automation underpinning the end-to-end process, but you will spend most of your time working directly with the various departments on a rotational basis. For example, you might support Finance during month-end, Procurement during negotiations and Legal vendor management. Rotations are designed to give you full training and knowledge across the entire back-office process.

This is a great opportunity for an entry-level candidate to learn how the back office of a hedge fund operates and to understand all of its areas, with exposure across the business from day one. You will also receive regular hands-on support and mentoring from the Enterprise Systems & Operations leadership, who will visit Bengaluru regularly, as well as a named point of contact based in Bengaluru for each rotation.

We are looking for two proactive, adaptable and ambitious candidates to join the Hub in Bengaluru as Shared Services Analysts. The ideal candidate brings natural problem-solving ability, strong attention to detail and a real appetite to learn. Full training is provided.



MAIN DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE:


Essential Responsibilities:

What you will do across the Hub

  • Rotate through the supported departments, working directly with each team and learning their processes end to end.
  • Help manage BAU activity across our finance and operations platforms, following documented processes and standards.
  • Provide flexible capacity where demand is highest, covering peaks, absences and new workloads.
  • Take part in structured training and cross-training to build working knowledge of the entire back-office process.
  • Build strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders in each department and across regions.
  • Flag errors, exceptions and risks early to the relevant department and to your manager.
  • Help document and improve processes, looking for opportunities to streamline and automate manual work, particularly via the use of AI tools.

Examples of what you could support and learn:

Procurement

  • Administering supplier contracts in Workday and supporting routine procurement projects.

Payroll

  • Supporting payroll integration reviews, monthly closures and routine audits.

Legal

  • Legal management and supplier onboarding support into the legal vendor and payment management system, BrightFlag.
  • New fund and company creation.

Accounts Payable & Finance Operations

  • Creating and adjusting supplier invoices in Zip, including tax treatment and approvals.
  • Executing settlement runs and cost allocation runs, and updating payment acknowledgement statuses.
  • Supporting bank reconciliations, prepaid amortisation schedules and system alerts.
  • Creating supplier master records and updating remit-to details where automated feeds are unavailable.
  • Supporting month-end close, including journal matching, reconciliations, adjustments and ledger period status updates.

FP&A

  • Maintaining headcount and cost planning sheets in Adaptive and preparing the monthly payroll data load.
  • Supporting forecast bridging, forecast-versus-actuals reviews and variance analysis.
  • Preparing reporting packs and providing UAT support ahead of go-lives.

WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:


ESSENTIAL


  • A strong graduate, or someone with early experience in finance operations or shared services — we are more interested in aptitude and potential than years of experience.
  • Willingness to learn quickly and move between teams and tasks as priorities change.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working with numbers, data and financial records.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled productivity tools, with the ability to use them to improve process efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Clear written and spoken English, with good communication skills for working with stakeholders across several departments and regions.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines, such as month-end close.

DESIREABLE


  • Exposure to ERP or finance systems (e.g. Workday, Zip, SAP).
  • Internship or early experience in finance, accounting, operations or shared services.
  • Interest in automation, data and process improvement.
  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, IT or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).

title: Director, Process Owner - Provider Communications and Correspondence
description:
Position Purpose

Utilizes business expertise to facilitate, lead, and drive complex, large-scale work efforts across domains and cross-functional initiatives with matrixed team support. Provides enterprise end-to-end ownership and governance for Claims content in provider-facing materials and claims-related provider correspondence, including provider manuals, billing guides, operational notices, education materials, acknowledgements, appeals process letters, and other related content.

Ensures provider materials are accurate, current, consistent with claims policies and system configuration, and coordinated across products, markets, health plans, and communication channels. Establishes and maintains controlled processes for content development, review, approval, publication, distribution, and ongoing maintenance.

Analyzes and measures the effectiveness of existing business processes and develops sustainable, scalable, and quantifiable improvements. Researches industry best practices to support strategic planning, stakeholder collaboration, operational execution, compliance, and budget adherence. Delivers expertise in areas such as end-to-end process improvement, vendor management, technology, and scalability, with a focus on reducing conflicting provider guidance, billing errors, claim rework, provider abrasion, and compliance risk while improving the clarity and effectiveness of provider communications and education.

Key Responsibilities
