title: Research Laboratory Engineer - Energy Innovation Center
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
description:
Employment Terms

  • Scope: Full-time (100%)
  • Employment: By Energix
  • Location: Ramat Aviv (next to Tel Aviv University)


About the Role

Energix Renewables and the Iby and Aladar Fleischman Faculty of Engineering at Tel Aviv University are establishing Israel's first-of-its-kind Energy Innovation Center, combining deep academic research, energy industry expertise, and technology entrepreneurship to develop breakthrough solutions in energy, smart grids, power systems, intelligent control, and AI for Energy. The Center will operate at the intersection of energy and artificial intelligence, power grid optimization, and simulation and decision-support tools.

Our goal is to drive energy-tech researchers and startups to address the most pressing market challenges, grow the next generation of breakthrough technologies, advance their expansion into international markets, and nurture engineers who wish to specialize in the energy field.

We are looking for a Lab Engineer to join the Center's founding team, lead the engineering build-out and design of a lab, oversee ongoing research and operational activities, and work closely with start-ups and researchers using the laboratory.

This is a unique role that demands both deep technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills to run a lab and work closely with start-ups.


Role Description

In the first phase, the role will focus on planning, specifying, and establishing a Grid Emulator and Energy Intelligence Laboratory for smart electrical grid and energy systems. Subsequently, the role will transition to day-to-day operations and providing professional and operational support for all research activities in the lab - working closely with both researchers and start-ups who are using the research facility.

Building and Commissioning the Lab

  • Equipment Procurement & Specification - Technical support throughout procurement processes, specification review, vendor comparison, and conformance verification.
  • Installation & Commissioning - Commissioning of complex power system lab: AC amplifiers, bidirectional DC sources, real-time simulators, power converters, measurement systems, and more (in collaboration with the design and engineering team).
  • Technical Specification - Writing operating procedures, conducting acceptance tests (FAT/SAT), and detailed documentation of all systems.
  • Safety System Installation & Operation - E-Stop, LOTO, grounding, and safe working procedures

Lab Commercial Operations

  • Professional Support for Research Activities - meet with researchers Graduate students, and start-ups interested in using the lab and understand their projects. Help them define use-cases, set-up lab experiments, and provide hands-on guidance throughout testing.
  • Operation and maintenance of the grid emulation system, Power Hardware-in-the-Loop, and GPU server environments; defining test configurations, connecting equipment, troubleshooting; ongoing liaison with vendors for technical support, software updates, and calibration.
  • Professional Support for Center Users - Professional and technical service to researchers, companies, and startups using the Center's infrastructure; matching equipment usage to user needs and ensuring readiness; managing spare parts and consumables inventory.
  • Safety & Maintenance - Overall responsibility for laboratory safety - training, procedures, and electrical regulations; preventive and routine maintenance, fault documentation, and equipment calibration.
  • Additional tasks as required.


Requirements

Required

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, or a related or double-major degree with a focus on energy
  • Proven experience working in a power electronics laboratory (academic or industrial)
  • At least 3 years of experience working with power systems, power electronics, with extensive experience in software applications for the energy sector
  • In-depth understanding of three-phase power systems and power converters
  • Ability to work with programming and control environments (MATLAB/Simulink, Python)
  • Ability to read electrical schematics and design systems
  • Organized, capable of technical documentation, and able to work independently
  • High-level Hebrew and English
  • Strong service orientation and excellent interpersonal skills
  • Creative thinking, initiative, precision, and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to train others


Significant Advantage

  • M.Sc. or PhD in Electrical Engineering with a specialisation in power electronics or power systems
  • Experience in commissioning complex systems
  • Experience working with real-time simulators
  • Knowledge of Power Hardware-in-the-Loop systems
  • Familiarity with simulation software (ETAP, PSCAD, LabVIEW, or similar)


Why Join Us?

  • Unique opportunity - Build an innovative laboratory from the ground up with equipment not widely available today in Israel. Support and advance the energy technologies of tomorrow by working closely with start-ups and researchers developing cutting-edge energy-tech solutions.
  • Technological breadth - Hands-on experience with Deep Tech across power systems, smart grids, storage, real-time simulation, and AI applications in energy.
  • Leading academic environment - Work alongside senior researchers and gain exposure to cutting-edge energy research.
  • Impact - Direct contribution to research and the development of energy ventures in Israel.


About Energix

Energix is a global publicly traded renewable energy company and one of the largest in Israel. Energix operates in the United States, Poland, Lithuania, and Israel. The company is engaged in the initiation, development, construction, financing, management, and operation of solar, wind, and energy storage systems. The company operates on a fully vertically integrated (A to Z) model that ensures professionalism and optimization across the entire value chain.

title: Quality Assurance and Pharmacovigilance Associate
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
description:
About the job

We are looking for a Quality Assurance and Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our team at K.S.KIM International (SK Pharma) Ltd. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing support to the QA Manager in ensuring that the company is in full compliance with Israeli regulatory requirements, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and all relevant regulations.


Responsibilities:

• Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other documentation related to the company's activities as appropriate.

• Overall responsibility for assuring the quality of the products released in Israel.

• Ensure that import, transportation, receipt of products, storage, and distribution are following the required level of quality (e.g. GDP, GMP) and local regulations.

• Maintain a Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) system to monitor the implementation of any corrective or preventative actions resulting from the investigation of complaints, product rejections, non-conformances, recalls, deviations, audits, regulatory inspections and findings, and trends from process performance and product quality monitoring.

• Provide support to the Qualified Person (QP) with decisions related to the quality of the products at the suppliers, and customers, including receipt and return of the company’s products.

• Understand and keep updated with pharmaceutical regulations in Israel and updated SOPs published from time to time.

• Mediate between authorities and company management and manufacturing sites.

• Perform periodic Management Reviews and address any issues that may arise during the review.

• Ensure continual improvement of the quality system.

• Maintain packaging materials and all connected documents following Packaging Material S.O.P.

• Ensure that external audits are performed for the relevant functions.

• Control and investigate deviations regarding the products.


Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (Pharmacy, Chemistry, or Biology).

• Minimum 2 years of experience in quality assurance in a pharmaceutical company.

• Strong understanding of Israeli and European regulatory requirements.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office and quality management systems.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively.

title: Integration Technician
description:
Systems Integration Technician | Naval & Multidisciplinary Systems

Bring complex multidisciplinary systems together — from the integration lab to real-world field operations.

A leading defense organization in the Shfela region of Israel is looking for a hands-on Systems Integration Technician to support the assembly, integration, testing, and implementation of complex multidisciplinary systems.

The role combines practical engineering work, electrical and electronic systems integration, technical documentation, and collaboration with engineering teams and subcontractors.

You'll work in both laboratory and customer-site environments, supporting technical activities from system assembly through integration and field implementation.

Candidates with relevant technological experience from naval environments, including the Israeli Navy, are especially encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Perform assembly, installation, and integration of multidisciplinary systems.
  • Conduct integration activities in laboratories and at customer sites.
  • Prepare system and subsystem drawings.
  • Assist in preparing engineering and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and other technical professionals.
  • Coordinate and supervise subcontractors, from defining requirements through delivery and acceptance of their work.
  • Support system integration, testing, and implementation activities.
  • Work with electrical, electronic, and integrated technological systems.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering OR a Practical Engineering diploma in Electrical and Electronics.
  • Hands-on experience integrating multidisciplinary systems.
  • Willingness to travel internationally frequently.
  • Practical ability to work in technical and engineering environments.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to collaborate with technical stakeholders and subcontractors.
  • Strong organizational skills, responsibility, and attention to detail.

Advantages

  • Professional background in the Israeli Navy or familiarity with naval environments.
  • Significant military technical experience, including career military service or advanced technical positions.
  • Valid boat operator / skipper license.
  • Experience with or familiarity with unmanned systems.

Position Details

  • Location: Shfela Region, Israel
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Travel: Frequent international travel required
  • Professional Focus: Multidisciplinary Systems Integration, Electrical and Electronic Systems, Laboratory and Field Operations.

If you enjoy hands-on technical challenges and integrating complex systems in both laboratory and field environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Development, the Senior Gift Officer, Principal Gifts, will have primary responsibility for raising philanthropic support from major and principal gift prospects and donors. title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
About the Role:

Discure Technologies is seeking a highly motivated, hands-on QA Lead to join our team as we advance our implantable bioelectronic device toward a pivotal clinical study. This is a full-time, office-based position in Petah Tikva, BSR City, reporting to the Head of Quality Assurance. The QA Lead will implement and manage the quality system in a multidisciplinary development environment, with ownership of design controls, configuration and document control, quality records, suppliers, and equipment documentation. The role requires close collaboration with R&D, regulatory, manufacturing, and external partners.


Key Responsibilities

· Help implement and maintain the quality system within a multidisciplinary R&D environment

· Maintain the Design History File (DHF), ensuring complete, controlled, and traceable design records

· Manage product configuration, Device Master Records (DMR), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and manufacturing documentation

· Manage document control for procedures, specifications, forms, and related documentation

· Manage quality records and ensure appropriate retention, traceability, and accessibility

· Maintain the Approved Supplier List (ASL) and related supplier quality documentation

· Maintain equipment logs and associated calibration and maintenance records

· Collaborate with R&D, regulatory, manufacturing, and suppliers to integrate quality requirements into development activities


Qualifications and Requirements

· BSc or equivalent degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Quality, or another relevant technical or scientific field

· 2+ years of experience in quality assurance or a related role within a regulated medical device environment

· Experience with design controls, DHF, DMR, ECO/configuration management, and document control

· Familiarity with medical device quality management systems and applicable quality processes

· Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

· High level of ownership and ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams


About Discure Technologies

Discure Technologies is a clinical-stage medical device company developing a minimally invasive, bioelectronic implantable device for degenerative disc disease. The Discure System is designed to reduce pain, restore function, and modify the disease process, with the goal of reducing the need for opioids and invasive back surgery. The company has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and was named “Best New Technology in Spine Care” by the North American Spine Society. Discure is backed by leading medtech, venture, and strategic investors, including Johnson & Johnson, BOLD Capital, Supernova Invest, and Sanara Capital.

title: AI Solutions & Enablement Manager
description:
About us

At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. By embracing an innovative culture of excellence, we pride ourselves on designing, manufacturing and servicing some of the world’s most transformative products. From life-saving medical technology and mission-critical defense solutions to sophisticated industrial automation, we’re proud to partner with our customers to bring their complex ideas to market.

Living Our Values

With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do.


Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.


As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs.


About the Role


As part of our drive for excellence, and our evolution into fully connected Intelligent Factories, we are introducing this exciting new role to quickly accelerate our use of our AI toolsets. The role will be focused on scaling sustainable AI solutions to eliminate errors and maximize regional efficiency.

As our AI Solutions & Enablement Manager, you will work directly at the intersection of business operations, IT governance, and practical automation. You will serve as our regional champion: identifying workflow bottlenecks and areas for efficiency improvement, building intuitive low-code applications, deploying agentic workflows, and establishing the operational guardrails needed to scale modern AI tools safely across our EMEA operations.


We are looking for a pragmatic builder and problem-solver who understands how to analyse complex processes and data sets, and identify improvement opportunities; script automations, build lightweight apps, collaborate with IT/security teams, and guide operational staff through digital adoption with confidence and authority. With a solid AI background combined with experience in continuous improvement, operations, technical consulting, or systems support, you know how to turn manual friction into working solutions.


Key Responsibilities


  • Practical Solution & Agentic Delivery: Design, configure, and maintain rapid applications and automated workflows using Google AppSheet and Google Apps Script. Implement AI tools and agentic automation to eliminate front-end data bottlenecks, accelerate program data loading, and streamline change reviews.
  • Enterprise Data & Model Integration: Leverage clean data assets curated by our Data Integration Hub. Apply BigQuery decision and data drift models within safe guardrails to transform how operational and support teams work—delivering autonomous, closed-loop decision support.
  • AI Tool Adoption & Guardrails: Serve as the go-to authority on safe AI usage across our EMEA sites. Build an internal framework that encourages teams to leverage AI assistants while keeping company data, IP, and operational integrity strictly protected.
  • Bridge Operations and IT: Translate business and workflow requirements into compliant digital tools. Partner closely with central IT, Cloud Infrastructure, and Information Security teams to ensure solutions align with identity management, access controls, and network standards.
  • Upskilling & Championing: Establish and lead our internal EMEA AI & Digital User Network, delivering hands-on coaching, practical prompt guidance, and low-code training to regional staff and support functions.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Partner with cross-functional teams to eliminate repetitive manual tracking, reduce errors, and digitize legacy paper- and spreadsheet-based routines.

What You Bring


  • A demonstrable track record: Practical experience leading the integration of AI into business and/or or operational processes, creating meaningful business impact.
  • Low-Code & Scripting Proficiency: Hands-on experience building functional tools in Google AppSheet and writing custom automation scripts using JavaScript / Google Apps Script.
  • Cloud & IT Fundamentals: A solid baseline understanding of cloud environments (preferably Google Cloud Platform / GCP), access controls, and IAM to ensure secure deployment.
  • Operational Grounding: Experience analyzing and improving multi-stakeholder operational workflows, continuous improvement initiatives, or business systems.
  • Pragmatic Implementation Mindset: You prioritize delivering a working, secure app in two weeks over developing theoretical models over six months.
  • Credibility & Influence: The authoritative communication style needed to establish compliance standards, push back on unsafe shadow IT, and guide cross-functional teams through new ways of working.

Why Join Us?


  • High-Impact Regional Ownership: Direct, executive-backed sponsorship to define and execute our AI and Google Cloud tools roadmap.
  • Real-World Agentic Automation: Work directly with BigQuery data assets to build closed-loop decision support and automate real enterprise workflows.
  • Build a New Capability: Launch and lead the brand-new EMEA AI User Network, upskilling practitioners and cultivating a culture of data-driven operational excellence.
  • Enterprise Scope: Drive cross-functional influence across our entire EMEA network.

Your Rewards and Wellbeing

We believe in rewarding your contribution with a comprehensive package designed to support your life both inside and outside of work.

  • Growth: Bespoke development plans and volunteer time off
  • Health: Private medical insurance, Employee Assistance Program and vision care
  • Wealth: Enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, and group income protection
  • Lifestyle: Electric Vehicle and Cycle to Work schemes, plus 33 days of annual leave

The successful candidate will provide leadership for documentation teams, manage document production workflows, support continuous monitoring activities, and serve as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) supporting ongoing cybersecurity operations and compliance efforts.

  • Serve as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) supporting:
    • Continuous monitoring activities
    • Security impact analysis
    • Risk management activities
    • POA&M management and tracking

  • Support cybersecurity awareness and training initiatives through the development of user guides, training materials, and supporting documentation.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in cybersecurity governance, compliance, risk management, or cybersecurity program support.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies, plans, procedures, standards, and operational records across NIST SP 800-53 control families.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity governance frameworks and compliance requirements.
  • Extensive experience with technical writing and documentation management.
  • Demonstrated expertise in:
    • Document control processes
    • Revision history management
    • Controlled numbering systems
    • Configuration management practices
    • Approval and review workflows
    • Quality assurance for technical documentation
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) programs and authorization activities.
  • Experience serving as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or supporting ISSO functions.
  • Experience supporting:
    • Continuous monitoring programs
    • POA&M development and management
    • Security impact analyses
    • Compliance reporting and tracking
  • Experience planning and facilitating cybersecurity, incident response, and contingency planning tabletop exercises.

title: ELO-P/ACES Program Manager (2026-27 School Year)
description:
Summary:
Organizes, coordinates, and performs activities to support one or more after school instructional program leaders by assisting with age-appropriate learning/recreational activities and subject matter tutoring. Assists in development, and serves as a team leader for implementation of activities and materials to enhance student learning experiences.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates daily operations of dedicated space at one or more school sites used for after school programs. Organizes the assignments of ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders and provides assistance to support play-oriented learning and assure student safety.
  • Responsible for student safety, attendance reporting, and parent support.
  • Support Academic Programming; intervention, enrichment, and tutoring.
  • Maintains school site grant documentation.
  • Maintains school site inventory and ordering.
  • Plans and implements various programs, activities, and learning opportunities. Organizes games, activities, and learning exercises which supports the curriculum.
  • Meets with ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders, Mentors, Coordinators and/or Director to identify and set up goals, determine instructional assistance needs, and establish a basis for coaching. May meet with teachers to assist with developing learning plans.
  • May work on an in-depth basis with small peer groups and/or individual students on special subjects, exercises, and activities which support the curriculum.
  • Organizes play and exploration activities which support the curriculum. Observes and participates in games, play, and individualized activity to assure student safety.
  • May accompany students on district-sponsored field trips.
  • Coordinates age-grade appropriate instructional aids and exercises to support the curriculum Applies alternative lessons and learning strategies for maximizing learning experiences.
  • May assist Extended Learning Mentors, teachers, and ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders with preparation and presentation of subject matter in small group learning environments.
  • Meets with teachers, academic coaches, assistant principals, etc., to learn and coordinate individual and group educational goals and objectives. Assists with implementation of special activities.
  • Assists in training and provides input to ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders and other instructional assistants to administer learning exercises, tutor in selected subjects, and record attendance and achievement.
  • Monitors learning center activities when an ELO-P/Program Leader is absent from the environment.
  • Observes, monitors, and controls the behavior of students within approved procedures.
  • Applies positive reinforcement with students.
  • Uses appropriate discipline in accordance with grade level requirements and scope of authority.
  • May report student academic, behavior progress and performance to teachers.
  • Provides feedback to ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders and other school personnel concerning programs, activities and materials to meet student needs and interests. Alerts ELO-P/ACES Program Leaders to any special problems or information concerning students.

title: Radiology CT Tech- PRN
description:
Location:

Michiana Hematology Oncology

Hiring Range:

$26.26 - $39.81

Position Summary

The CT Technologist I (CT Tech) reports directly to the Radiology Team Lead. The CT Tech accurately interprets physician orders; administers contrast materials; and prepares and operates CT Scanner equipment to ensure proper images are obtained. Their primary duties include the acquisition of quality diagnostic CT images in accordance with written orders and standard operating procedures while ensuring safety in patient care through the consistent practice of ALARA principles and accepted standards of care. Image acquisition includes identifying the correct patient, escorting patients to the scan room, assisting patients onto the scanner table, positioning patients for image acquisition, acquiring diagnostically acceptable images and assisting the patients in exiting the scan room. The CT Tech provides and ensures an environment of caring, concern and support for patients, visitors, medical staff and co-workers on a consistent basis. They ensure the quality of image acquisition through the complete and accurate documentation of treatment records. They also recognize and document required deviations from prescribed scans and report all deviations to the Radiology Team Lead and/or interpreting Radiologist. The CT Tech uses effective communication techniques and interpersonal skills to adequately explain the CT scan procedure and its associated risks to patients and their family while referring medical questions to appropriate personnel. The CT Tech observes patients for expected and unexpected reactions to contrast injections and communicates this to appropriate staff members. The CT Tech properly documents all aspects of the image acquisition process within the patient’s record in the Practice EMR. The CT Tech also assists as needed in all image acquisition related procedures, including transporting patients, reviewing charts, and ordering supplies. They demonstrate the ability to recognize standard imaging artifacts and make the necessary to adjustments to ensure high quality scans. The CT Tech performs and documents daily and weekly QA checklists for all CT related equipment within the department. They notify appropriate clinical team members and document findings outside the normal range of operations. The CT Tech participates in programs to measure and improve the quality of care within the Department and uses critical thinking to trouble shoot and often fix common quality issues. They also capture and verify patient procedures performed and assist with the submission of Superbill charges.

Key Performance Areas

  • Inject contrast materials in accordance with SOP and standards of care.

  • Utilize CT Scanner to produce cross-section images of internal organs and tissues for the diagnosis of medical issues.

  • Maintain and perform Quality Control tests on CT Scanner.

  • Ensure accurate scanning of each patient by utilizing proper protocols.

  • Identify appropriate patients using the 2-method protocol.

  • Explain test procedures and safety precautions to patients and provide them with assistance during test procedures.

  • Prepare contrast adhering to safety standards.

  • Produce a computer-generated or film image for interpretation by a physician.

  • Coordinate and maintain patient schedules with Company coordinators.

  • Maintain an active CT certification (ARRT(CT)) and state license (if required). Maintain certifying and state requirements for CE Education Units.

  • Comply will all Federal and State laws and regulations pertaining to patient care, patient’s rights, safety, billing, and collections. Adhere to all Company and departmental policies and procedures, including IT policies and procedures and Disaster Recovery Plan.

  • Keep office and personal work area and records in a neat and orderly manner.

  • Ensure the physical building and all equipment are safe for use.

  • Maintain all company equipment in a safe and working order.

  • Maintain the confidentiality of all patient and employee information as required by HIPAA regulations at all times.

  • Assist in training new employees to related job duties.

  • Expected to work at any Company location to help meet the Company’s business needs.

  • Expected to work overtime when given sufficient notice of required overtime.

Qualifications

Education

  • Minimum – Graduate from an accredited School of CT Technology or similar.

  • Preferred – BS Degree in Radiology Technology or other related field.

Previous Experience

  • Minimum of one (1) year active experience as a CT Technologist is required.

  • Will consider recent graduate of accredited CT Technology program that is eligible to sit for their registry. Must pass CT Registry exam within 6 months of hire if recent graduate.

Licensure/Certification

  • Certified as a Registered CT Technologist by the ARRT.

  • Must have State CT license if applicable for locality.

  • Must have current CPR/BLS certifications.

Fluency in the English language as well as excellent oral and written communication skills is essential. Additionally, ability to communicate in Spanish is also desirable.

Travel: Rarely

Standard Work Days/Hours: Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm.

title: Director, Process Owner - Authorizations
description:
Position Purpose

Utilizes business expertise to facilitate, lead, and drive complex, large-scale work efforts across domains and cross-functional initiatives with matrixed team support. Provides single-threaded, end-to-end ownership and governance of the Claims administration of the authorization Requirements process and its integration with Claims and Configuration.

Aligns authorization policies, operational workflows, business and system requirements, handoffs, configuration, controls, and performance measures across operational, clinical, health plan, configuration, claims, compliance, and technology teams.

Analyzes and measures the effectiveness of existing business processes and develops sustainable, scalable, and quantifiable improvements. Researches industry best practices to support strategic planning, stakeholder collaboration, operational execution, compliance, and budget adherence. Delivers expertise in areas such as end-to-end process improvement, vendor management, technology, and scalability, with a focus on reducing authorization-related claim defects, rework, pends, denials, provider abrasion, and inconsistent outcomes while strengthening regulatory compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support strategy for complex business transformation priorities, with dedicated ownership of the end-to-end authorization process administration in the Claims systems and its downstream impact to claims processing and configuration.
  • Provide directional oversight for complex business cases and proposed initiatives, assessing feasibility, opportunities, risks, and return on investment while considering clinical, operational, claims, regulatory, technology, and provider impacts.
  • Lead the activation of strategic and policy guidance for assigned initiatives, ensuring authorization policies, workflows, system requirements, configuration, handoffs, controls, and performance measures are aligned from end to end.
  • Perform detailed analysis of data, workflows, policies, procedures, systems, and organizational responsibilities to identify gaps and root causes contributing to authorization-related claim defects, rework, pends, denials, provider abrasion, or inconsistent outcomes.
  • Collect and analyze process and performance data to develop and recommend business practices and procedures that improve effectiveness, productivity, and cost efficiency, including opportunities to reduce downstream claims impacts associated with authorization processes.
  • Collaborate directly with stakeholder SMEs across Clinical Operations, Claims, Configuration, Compliance, health plans, technology, and other impacted teams to support knowledge transfer, implementation, and ongoing process governance.
  • Establish and maintain end-to-end governance, standards, decision rights, accountability, and performance measures for the authorization process administration for Claims payment.
  • Identify and establish standardized authorization waiver rules and related governance to promote consistency, mitigate compliance risk, and reduce inappropriate variation across products, markets, and health plans.
  • Assess authorization-related regulatory changes for downstream impacts to claims policies, business rules, configuration, workflows, and operational processes, and coordinate implementation across impacted stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional consensus and confirm end-to-end process integrity through final recommendations and implementation, balancing clinical requirements, authorization policies, claims adjudication, configuration, regulatory requirements, operational effectiveness, and provider experience.
  • Establish monitoring, controls, escalation mechanisms, and continuous-improvement processes to identify authorization-related defects and drive timely corrective and preventive action.
  • Partner on timely communications to key stakeholders and contribute to executive-level presentations to support awareness, decision-making, and effectiveness of deliverables.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred. 7+ years of project management experience, including detailed understanding and experience applying project management methodologies and tools. 5+ years of Government Programs Managed Care experience in multiple areas of Operations (Claims, Provider/Mbr Services/Medical Management/ Network, etc). Medicaid Managed Care experience preferred.

title: Visual Arts Specialist- Queens
description:

New York Edge is the largest after-school and summer camp program provider in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs, including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access, help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

New York Edge is seeking passionate and enthusiastic people to fill the role of Visual Arts Specialist. In this role, you will organize, lead, and promote interest in performing arts activities. Instructors utilize and adapt the New York State Arts Learning Standards to create an engaging and awarding activity that encourages participation in New York Edge programs.

  • Organize, lead, and promote interest in arts activities such as visual art, fashion, painting, drawing, photography & digital media.

  • Organize performance groups and direct their rehearsals.

  • Establish clear objectives for all lessons, units, and projects, and communicate those objectives to students.

  • Ascertain and interpret group interests, evaluate equipment and facilities, and adapt activities to meet the student’s needs.

  • Prepare materials and classrooms for class activities.

  • Explain principles, techniques, and safety procedures to participants in the activities and demonstrate the use of materials and equipment.

  • Evaluate activities to determine if they are producing desired results.

  • Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet students' needs and interests.

  • Progressive development of student skills leading to a final project


REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Must be knowledgeable and skilled in various Visual Arts and have prior experience successfully teaching and instructing youth.

  • Must be able to follow a curriculum

  • Must be responsible, reliable, and punctual!

  • May be required to walk up and down stairs.

  • May have to lift or move objects/materials as needed.

  • Work is performed mostly within a New York City Public School but may be required to interact with the community at-large during trips or events.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent required; some college preferred

  • A minimum of one year of visual arts work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is required.

  • A minimum of one year of teaching/coaching experience is required.

  • Must have passion for New York Edge's mission and demonstrated interest in education and youth development.

  • Candidates qualified to lead instruction in more than one activity are also preferred.


WORK SCHEDULE

The Visual Arts Specialist will be required to report to the school building and interact with staff, students, parents, and school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and Department of Health.

description:

We maken producten met impact, samen met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor die impact.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Backend Developer ontwerp en implementeer je robuuste architecturen en API’s die naadloos integreren met bestaande platformen en native frontends. Je werkt hands-on met PHP en Node.js en bent bekend met moderne cloudtechnologie.

Binnen het team ben jij de backendexpert: analytisch sterk, op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen en in staat om snel goede technische beslissingen te nemen. Je begrijpt het verschil tussen wat noodzakelijk is en wat beter kan.

Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:

  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare backendarchitecturen voor onze digitale producten

  • Implementeren van API-integraties en server-side logica

  • Naadloos integreren met CMS-platformen, waaronder Sitecore, en Azure-services

  • Bijdragen aan architectuurkeuzes en de technische roadmap

  • Schrijven van unit- en functionele tests

  • Bewaken van kwaliteit en performance

  • Uitvoeren van code reviews

We werken met:

  • PHP, Python

  • SQL-databases zoals MariaDB en MySQL

  • Redis

  • AWS

  • Docker

  • TDD, unit testing en functioneel testen

  • Bash

  • CI/CD

  • Observability

  • Open Source libraries

Wie jij bent

Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als Backend Developer

  • Een bacheloropleiding of hoger hebt afgerond

  • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig bent en je kennis actief up-to-date houdt

  • Graag samenwerkt in een team, maar ook zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid kunt nemen

  • Proactief bent en ideeën kritisch durft uit te dagen

  • Vooroploopt door de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen backend development toe te passen om onze digitale producten naar een hoger niveau te tillen

  • Nederlands en/of Engels spreekt en schrijft

Over Framna

Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.

Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.

Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een eerlijk, marktconform salaris van €3.000 tot €5.300 o.b.v. je ervaring.

  • Pensioenbijdrage van 67%.

  • 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Een Macbook en telefoon om soepel samen te werken.

  • Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.

Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten die de wereld vooruit helpen? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen zeven werkdagen neemt Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Chips Talk, We Listen

proteanTecs is a game-changing startup that's giving advanced electronics the power to report on their own health. In a digital world built for autonomous driving, cloud computing, and AI, we depend on computing systems daily. But how can we guarantee their safety, reliability and functionality? proteanTecs is the first-ever company to provide visibility into next-gen chips while they are operating, based on the power of on-chip monitoring, machine learning, and data analytics.

Here at proteanTecs, you'll be part of a team that's unlocking deep insights to make electronics more reliable, efficient, and high-quality. We're trusted by industry leaders in data centers, automotive, communications, and consumer devices – we work with the world's largest and most notable companies in tech.

Why proteanTecs is a great place to work:

  • Fast-paced and impactful: We're a mission-driven startup, so you'll tackle new challenges daily, wear many hats, and see your work directly influence the future of electronics.
  • Supportive company culture: Learn from the best. Our 200+ team members are experts in their field with a proven track record of success, and they're committed to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • International presence: We're a multinational company with a diverse team across multiple locations around the globe. You'll collaborate on projects with international impact, gaining a global perspective of the tech industry.
  • Work with industry leaders: Our solutions are used by the biggest names in tech. You'll be part of the team creating the next generation of groundbreaking products.
  • Cutting-edge playground: We use the latest machine learning, platforms, and tools to push boundaries and achieve breakthroughs.
  • Real-world impact: Our work keeps data centers, cars, and other critical systems running smoothly. Your work will directly contribute to safer, more reliable electronics.
  • We are here for the win: Backed by industry veterans and leading investors, we offer a stable and secure work environment with plenty of room for growth.


proteanTecs is looking for an experienced Quality Manager to lead quality initiatives across our R&D organization, working closely with the Pre-Silicon team (IP chip design, Logic & verification, EDA tools and Application Engineering teams).

In this role you will own engineering quality across the IP design and development lifecycle, from design and verification through release. You will build and execute a practical quality improvement plan, strengthen development and verification practices, and drive escape analysis and corrective actions through to implementation. The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience in IP (chip) design environments with a pragmatic, incremental approach, and works in close alignment with management and engineering teams to promote a strong quality culture.


Position location: in our Haifa or TLV offices, at least one working day at the secondary site (Hybrid model)


Responsibilities:

  • Build and own a pre-silicon quality improvement plan with milestones, KPIs and targets. Execute it hands-on and report measurable progress to management regularly.
  • Define quality gates and release criteria, lead go/no-go reviews, and improve development, verification and release processes in steps that fit the organization's maturity.
  • Partner with Physical and Logic design, verification, EDA tools and Application Engineering teams on a shift-left approach that finds defects earlier, and promote a strong quality culture.
  • Lead escape analysis and root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to closure and verification.
  • Define and track quality KPIs and dashboards. Analyze defect trends and rank risks by customer and product impact.


Requirements:

  • B.Sc. or higher in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field;
  • 5+ years in engineering or product quality, including 2+ years in chip design and verification environments.
  • Proven hands-on record of building and executing quality improvement plans with milestones, KPIs and measured results.
  • Working knowledge of semiconductor lifecycles, IP design and development flows, EDA tools, and RTL, verification and validation methodologies.
  • Experience with quality gates, release criteria, defect lifecycle, escape analysis, CAPA, and defect analytics and dashboards.
  • Experience with Jira or similar, and test management tools (e.g., Xray).
  • Ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence without direct authority, aligned with management. Clear communication with engineers and executives.
  • Pragmatic, agile and flexible, with a can-do approach. Welcomes and acts on constructive input from colleagues and management.


Advantages

  • Firmware or embedded software quality experience
  • Verilog / SystemVerilog, UVM and EDA tools; good knowledge of electronics (circuits and electrical fundamentals)
  • Formal quality management system experience (e.g., ISO 9001)
  • Python or scripting, and experience with silicon, telemetry or reliability data
  • Experience working directly with customers (requirements gathering, escalations, onboarding, or support)

  • Työsuhde: Vakituinen (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva), kokoaikainen

  • Palkkaus: 17–21 €/h (Teknologiateollisuuden TES)

  • Edut: Epassi-henkilöstöetu

  • Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / mahdollisimman pian

Asiakkaastamme, kohteesta, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!

Jos koet, että osaamisesi täsmää tähän paikkaan, mutta mielessä on kysymyksiä, voit kysyä niistä suoraan Whatsappilla tai tavallisella tekstiviestillä. Numero on 050 542 1894.

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Backend Engineer (NestJS, Node.js, Typescript, PostgresSQL)
description:
Job Description:

Job Description: Backend Engineer

Tech Stack: NestJS | Node.js | TypeScript | Prisma ORM | PostgreSQL | Redis | Microsoft Azure | Docker


Total Exp : 6 - 8 Years

Notice Period : Immediate Joiners

Work Timings : 06.00 P.M. to 03.00 A.M


Role Overview

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong experience in NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of backend architecture, API design, database optimization, caching, asynchronous processing, cloud services, and production reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using NestJS, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Build modular backend architectures using NestJS modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, and middleware.
  • Design and optimize database schemas, queries, relationships, indexes, and transactions using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
  • Implement request validation, centralized error handling, consistent API responses, and API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Develop secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWT, RBAC, and permission-based access control.
  • Implement caching strategies using Redis and asynchronous processing using messaging queues and background jobs.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and external systems, handling authentication, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures.
  • Optimize API performance, database access, resource utilization, and application scalability.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and deploy backend services using Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement structured logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, health checks, and other observability practices.
  • Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and maintain technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers and other stakeholders to define API contracts and deliver end-to-end features.

Required Skills

Core Technologies and Architecture

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with NestJS is mandatory, including modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming, modular architecture, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.

Database and Caching

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience with Redis for caching, TTL management, cache invalidation, and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of database consistency, connection pooling, and efficient data-access patterns.

API Development and Security

  • Experience implementing DTOs, request validation, centralized error handling, and consistent API contracts.
  • Familiarity with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API security, rate limiting, and secure secrets management.
  • Experience handling pagination, filtering, API versioning, retries, and backward compatibility.

Cloud, Messaging, and Integrations

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms, with the ability to work with Azure services in production.
  • Familiarity with Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Cache for Redis.
  • Understanding of messaging queues, background jobs, event-driven architecture, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and handling asynchronous workflows.

Performance and Engineering Practices

  • Understanding of Node.js performance, concurrency, caching, database optimization, and scalability.
  • Familiarity with structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health checks, and monitoring tools such as Application Insights or OpenTelemetry.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing using Jest or equivalent tools.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests and debugging application issues across development and production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and clean architecture.
  • Familiarity with advanced messaging patterns, idempotency, dead-letter queues, and distributed system reliability.
  • Experience with GraphQL, webhooks, WebSockets, API gateways, or enterprise system integrations.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and Azure Functions.
  • Experience building enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, and role-based access control.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code for implementation, debugging, refactoring, and testing, with the ability to review and validate generated code.
  • Familiarity with monorepos, shared libraries, and CI/CD workflows.

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Writes clean, modular, secure, maintainable, and strongly typed code.
  • Understands the reasoning behind architectural, database, and performance decisions.
  • Takes ownership of features from design and development through testing and deployment.
  • Communicates effectively and collaborates with frontend engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams.

Experience: Mid-level to Senior, depending on technical depth and demonstrated ownership.

Core Stack: NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Git.

title: Safety Technical Support Specialist - Park Support
description:
Overview

The Safety Technical Support Specialist serves as the primary system administrator and technical coordinator for the Safety Department's incident management and training platforms. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Safety, this position is responsible for administering the Origami Risk safety reporting system and the HSI online learning management system, ensuring data integrity, system effectiveness, user support, and comprehensive reporting across all properties.

The Safety Technical Support Specialist provides technical expertise, training coordination, system oversight, and reporting support to enhance incident management, regulatory compliance, and workforce safety training. This role acts as a key liaison between corporate safety leadership, park personnel, software vendors, and safety committees to ensure safety technology platforms support organizational objectives.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Origami Safety Reporting System Administration

  • Serve as the primary corporate administrator for the Origami safety reporting and incident management system.
  • Monitor incident reports for completeness, accuracy, required documentation, and timely submission.
  • Review incident records to verify required attachments, investigations, corrective actions, and supporting documentation are included.
  • Identify and communicate reporting deficiencies to property personnel and support corrective follow-up.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to parks and users regarding Origami functionality, workflows, and reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate, document, and track system enhancement requests, workflow modifications, report development needs, and software updates.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between PSC Safety, operational users, and software vendors regarding system issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Support system testing, implementation, and deployment of new features and enhancements.
  • Maintain user access, security permissions, distribution lists, and system administration functions.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and analytics to support safety performance monitoring and decision-making.

HSI Training System Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator for the HSI online training and learning management system.
  • Manage user accounts, course assignments, training schedules, and system configurations.
  • Maintain and update training curricula within the learning management system.
  • Ensure training records are accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
  • Troubleshoot user access, enrollment, completion, and certification issues.
  • Coordinate with HSI representatives regarding system updates, enhancements, and support needs.

Safety Training Program Coordination

  • Develop, maintain, and periodically update the corporate safety training matrix for designated employee groups and departments.
  • Monitor compliance with required corporate safety training assignments.
  • Track individual, departmental, and property-level training completion rates.
  • Maintain the Six Flags Entertainment Corporation catalog of recommended safety courses.
  • Evaluate training needs and assist in identifying opportunities for additional learning resources and development programs.
  • Coordinate assignment of required and recommended safety training courses.
  • Ensure training requirements align with corporate standards, regulatory expectations, and operational needs.

Safety Training Workgroup Leadership

  • Lead and facilitate the multi-property Safety Training Workgroup.
  • Schedule and coordinate workgroup meetings and activities.
  • Develop agendas, meeting materials, and action-item tracking documentation.
  • Collaborate with safety professionals across operating locations to identify training needs, best practices, and program improvements.
  • Support implementation of corporate safety training initiatives and standardization efforts.

Reporting and Data Management

  • Maintain and validate incident reporting and training completion data.
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports related to incident management, safety performance, and training compliance.
  • Produce comprehensive training completion reports for parks, corporate leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Analyze training and incident trends and provide recommendations for improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare executive summaries, charts, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Assist in developing key performance indicators and metrics related to training and incident reporting effectiveness.

Administrative Support

  • Maintain system documentation, operating procedures, and user guides.
  • Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and requests related to safety reporting and training documentation.
  • Support special projects and strategic initiatives assigned by the Vice President of Safety.
  • Stay current on emerging learning management technologies, incident management systems, and safety training best practices.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience Required:

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Business Administration, Information Systems, Training and Development, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting software systems, training administration, safety programs, or related business operations.
  • Experience administering learning management systems (LMS), incident management systems, or enterprise software platforms preferred.
  • Experience managing data, reporting, and user support functions.
  • Experience coordinating training programs and compliance reporting preferred.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or corporate environment preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to administer enterprise software applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, pivot tables, reporting, and dashboard development.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to develop professional reports, metrics, and executive presentations.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to provide effective system training and technical support to users with varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of occupational safety principles, training administration, and compliance practices preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Accuracy and completeness of Origami incident reporting data.
  • Timeliness of incident report review and follow-up.
  • Responsiveness to system support requests.
  • Successful implementation and tracking of system enhancements and updates.
  • Accuracy of training records and compliance reporting.
  • Timely distribution of training completion reports.
  • Corporate training completion and compliance rates.
  • Effectiveness of Safety Training Workgroup coordination and outcomes.
  • User satisfaction with safety reporting and training systems.

Orthopedic Technician | Correll Pavilion


Bring your hands-on skills to a team focused on helping orthopedic patients heal, recover, and return to the activities that matter to them. As an Orthopedic Technician at Correll Pavilion, you’ll work alongside physicians and nurses to provide specialized orthopedic care in a fast-paced clinical environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Apply and assist with casts, braces, traction, and other orthopedic devices
  • Support wound care, aspirations, fracture reductions, and minor procedures
  • Fit patients for pre-operative and post-operative devices
  • Educate patients and families on cast, wound, pin, traction, and device care
  • Assist with patient intake and carry out delegated orthopedic care
  • Prepare exam rooms, clean equipment, and maintain clinical supplies
  • Communicate patient-care information to physicians and nurses while following HIPAA requirements

What You’ll Need

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Strong communication and patient-service skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with physicians, nurses, patients, and families
  • Comfort providing hands-on care in a busy clinical setting

If you enjoy hands-on patient care and want to build your skills in orthopedics, apply today to join the team at Correll Pavilion.

Core Competencies
These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment.


1. Patient-Centered Care – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high-quality care that prioritizes the well-being and satisfaction of patients and their families.
2. Integrity & Accountability – Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and accepts responsibility for actions, decisions, and outcomes.
3. Collaboration & Teamwork – Builds positive relationships, works effectively across departments, and supports colleagues to achieve shared goals.
4. Communication – Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with patients, families, colleagues, and leadership.
5. Respect & Inclusion – Creates an inclusive environment by valuing diversity, treating others with dignity, and ensuring equitable care and opportunities for all.
6. Quality & Safety – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes.
7. Adaptability & Resilience – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure.
8. Continuous Improvement – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
9. Leadership & Professionalism – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.
10. Employee Experience Focus – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care.


Grady Total Rewards
At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our Total Rewards package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

title: Bilingual Service Scheduler & Parts Coordinator (English / Spanish)
description:
About Your Future with SPI

Are you looking for a career with an industry leader that drives the future of energy-efficient insulation and building material products? Is being part of a company that is recognized as a “Great Place to Work” of value to you? Look no further! At SPI, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive team that reflects our values of integrity and innovation by delivering solutions that make a difference in the communities we serve. Here, you are part of a company that rewards your contributions and encourages you to take ownership of your career.

Job Description

Bilingual Service Scheduler & Parts Coordinator (English / Spanish)

About Us
Intech Equipment & Supply is a dedicated repair shop committed to high-quality workmanship and dependable customer service. We pride ourselves on keeping our operations running smoothly and treating every customer with honesty and respect.

Role Overview
We are looking for an organized, bilingual Service Scheduler & Parts Coordinator to serve as the central hub between our customers, our parts suppliers, and our repair technicians. In this role, you will manage the shop's repair schedule, research technical manuals to source and order parts, track inventory, and ensure customers stay informed every step of the way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Schedule Management: Coordinate and maintain the daily repair schedule for the shop, balancing technician availability with parts arrival times and customer deadlines.
  • Work Order Administration: Open, update, and close repair work orders accurately, ensuring all labor hours and parts used are properly documented for billing.
  • Parts Research & Ordering: Navigate technical manuals, schematics, and parts catalogs to identify, look up, price, and order the correct replacement parts for upcoming repairs.
  • Tracking & Record-Keeping: Maintain accurate logs of shop supplies, incoming parts, backorders, and estimated times of arrival (ETAs) to prevent repair delays.
  • Customer Communication: Proactively contact customers in both English and Spanish to confirm appointments, communicate repair estimates, provide updates on parts delays, and notify them when repairs are complete.
  • Counter & Shipping Support: Assist at the front counter as needed by answering incoming phone calls, greeting walk-in customers, processing payments, and packaging, shipping, or receiving parts.
  • Returns & Warranty Claims: Process core returns, defective part exchanges, and manufacturer warranty paperwork in a timely manner.

Required Qualifications

  • Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in both English and Spanish (verbal and written) to effectively assist all customers and translate technical repair updates clearly.
  • Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to read and navigate technical manuals, diagrams, and parts catalogs to accurately identify components.
  • Organizational Skills: High attention to detail with proven ability to track orders, manage inventory logs, and juggle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced shop environment.
  • Work Style & Adaptability: Able to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining flexible and adaptable within a collaborative team environment.
  • Safety Mindset: Safety-conscious approach to daily tasks, strictly following shop safety protocols and equipment handling guidelines.
  • Customer Service: Friendly, professional demeanor with strong phone etiquette, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to timely follow-ups.
  • Computer Literacy: Comfortable using scheduling software, inventory spreadsheets, point-of-sale systems, and online supplier portals.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Lifting & Mobility: Able to regularly lift, carry, or move products, parts, and shop supplies up to 60 pounds.
  • Work Setting: Comfortable working in an active, fast-paced environment that requires moving between indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Previous experience working in a repair shop, service department, dealership, or warehouse environment.
  • Familiarity with shipping and receiving procedures (e.g., UPS, FedEx, LTL freight).
  • Basic knowledge of Spray Foam Equipment.

Compensation Range

$13.00 - $30.00

To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation.

title: Dry Etch Equipment Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Dry Etch Equipment Engineer to join our team in Marcy NY. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, optimization, and development of dry etch equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. This role requires a solid understanding of etching processes, equipment functionality, and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Equipment Maintenance: Perform regular maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on dry etch tools to ensure optimal performance and minimize downtime.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze equipment performance data and metrics to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with process engineers, production, and quality teams to ensure equipment performance meets production requirements and standards.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of equipment maintenance, process recipes, and performance metrics in line with industry standards.
  • Compliance: Ensure that all processes and equipment adhere to safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.
  • Training and Support: Train and support technicians and operators on the operation and maintenance of dry etch equipment.
  • Project Management: Manage projects related to equipment upgrades, modifications, and new tool installations.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in semiconductor equipment engineering, specifically with dry etch processes.
  • Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of dry etch systems (e.g., ICP, RIE).Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing processes and cleanroom protocols.Proficiency in data analysis tools and equipment diagnostics.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with specific dry etch equipment manufacturers (e.g., Applied Materials).
  • Knowledge of CAD and simulation tools for equipment design and modification.
  • Understanding of statistical process control (SPC) and quality improvement methodologies.

title: Front Line Care Clinician - Scranton, PA
description:
Job Summary

Job Description

Own clinical support activities related to retaining and growing Medline Front Line Care business, including customer support, clinical troubleshooting, trial and implementation support, and clinical solutions execution while collaborating with OneMedline partners.


Objective of the Front Line Care team is to partner with health systems on improving outcomes of main Hospital Acquired Conditions (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI and Fall Prevention).


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Provide clinical subject matter expertise on clinical practice related to safe and effective use of products. Use strong clinical acumen to present and educate on the safe and effective use of Front Line Care products. Objective is to partner with health systems on key quality metrics related to nursing (CAUTI, CLABSI, HAPI, Fall Prevention).
  • Build and maintain strong account-level relationships with stakeholders involved in clinical decision-making, including but not limited to CNO, ACNO, ICU, key unit leaders, Infection Prevention, WOCN, Quality/Patient Safety, and other relevant clinical stakeholders.

  • Lead or attend local trade shows, educational dinners, chapter events or product events as needed.
  • Ensure an appropriate frequency of touchpoints with priority accounts.
  • Perform account activities including in-services, just-in-time education, clinical troubleshooting, bedside audits, trial support, clinical solutions workshops, and protocol reviews with clinical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer expectations, internal resources, clinical evaluations, implementation needs, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in Front Line Care Clinical business reviews.
  • Initiate and facilitate communication and collaboration among relevant internal stakeholders.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
Job Description:

This position is responsible for overseeing inventory management activities for assigned departments or clinical programs. Key duties include distributing and managing supplies to ensure that medical products, linens, and equipment are adequately stocked and ready for clinical use. The role also involves day-to-day management of inventory for the assigned department, facility, or clinical program, ensuring seamless operations and availability of necessary supplies.

Schedule: PRN

Hours: Vary(weekday coverage)


Essential Functions

  • Performs inventory control on stock and non-stock items (e.g., sets par levels, identifies and adjusts to trends) for assigned units. Keeps supplies binned and organized. Acts as liaison between Supply Chain and assigned department, facility, or clinical program.
  • Orders and delivers supplies for assigned department, facility, or clinical program using appropriate technology, systems, and suppliers.
  • Communicate information concerning supply levels, new products, standardization, and implementation relevant to the department staff. Troubleshoots issues for problem resolution.
  • Responsible for Par Location Management, PIRS Replenishment, Location Maintenance, Delivery, Label maintenance and Kanban visuals.
  • Monitors quantity on hand issues reconciling and solves any discrepancies.
  • Utilizes the SCIS system ensuring distribution, inventory, receiving, departmental files, and reports are managed in accordance with Auditing, Accounting, and other regulatory agencies.
  • Ensures compliance with policy and standard operating procedures.
  • Reviews daily, weekly and monthly reports for assigned locations.

Skills

  • Materials Management
  • Medical Supply Distribution
  • Supply Chain Processes
  • Warehouse Inventory Management
  • Warehouse Management System (WMS)
  • Excellent Team Player
  • Continuous Improvement (CI)

Required Qualifications

  • Six Months of related Materials Management experience.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and speak English clearly, follow verbal and written instructions, and understand customer communications.
  • Experience using basic word processing, spreadsheets, internet, e-mail, and scheduling applications.
  • Experience in a role requiring strong attention to detail, accuracy, and dependability.
  • Demonstrated ability to visually inspect boxes, packing slips, computed reports, and like objects.
  • Demonstrated ability to use a pallet jack and other materials handling equipment (e.g., hand truck, carts).
  • Experience in a role working with healthcare supplies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One year of healthcare related distribution experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, monitors, etc. and to identify equipment and supplies.
  • Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing, operating telephones, and other office equipment.
  • Expected to bend, lift, and carry patient files, documents, equipment, and supplies.
  • Remain sitting or standing for long periods of time while interacting with others or to perform work on a computer, telephone, or other equipment.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in delicate assemblies and adhesions, coupled with a passion for new technologies. The electro-optic integration Engineer will play a critical role in the development and optimization of our quantum computing systems, contributing to the advancement of our research and development efforts.

  • Stay current with advancements in quantum computing and electro-optic technologies, incorporating new techniques and methodologies to enhance our capabilities.

  • Proficiency in using laboratory equipment such as lasers, optical detectors, and optical power meters.
